ANStat's own IHPC bulletin, Tableau 1 header: "NOUVELLE NOMENCLATURE COICOP 2018" -- a documented change from the prior base-2014 series' WAEMU-derived NCOA-IHPC nomenclature.

_dropped.why: ANStat's own bulletin names a specific UEMOA Council of Ministers decision directly: "au cours de sa quatrieme session ordinaire pour l'annee 2024, tenue le 20 decembre 2024 a Bamako (MALI), le Conseil des Ministres de l'UEMOA a adopte les modalites d'elaboration, de calcul et de diffusion de l'Indice Harmonise des Prix a la Consommation (IHPC base 100 en 2023), telles que definies dans le guide methodologique." No title/number is given for that guide the way the base-2014 predecessor had one (Reglement N 03/2017/CM/UEMOA, per UEMOA's own April 2023 note). An AFRISTAT-authored guide with a different title was found and read but its evidenced base year (~2008, referencing the 1996 IHPC96 rollout) is a much earlier vintage -- not confirmed to be the same document.

Code de Prevoyance Sociale (Ordonnance n2012-03 du 11 janvier 2012), Art. 154: "un arrete du Ministre charge de la Prevoyance Sociale determine le niveau de revalorisation de la pension de retraite. La revalorisation doit tenir compte de l'evolution du cout de la vie..." -- the same 'cout de la vie' (cost-of-living) concept, not a titled CPI report, recurs for the minimum annual wage and already-liquidated annuities (Art. 95) and for family benefits (Art. 50). Mechanism is a ministerial decree, at minimum every two years for the minimum-pension floor (Art. 155) -- confirmed as discretionary rather than automatic by a October 2025 government decision explicitly framed as an 'exceptional' 100% revaluation of the minimum pension, outside the ordinary biennial mechanism. Initial pension calculation itself (Art. 150) is a wage-replacement-rate formula on the best 15 contributory years, with no CPI input.

Ordonnance n 2012-303 du 4 avril 2012 (CGRAE) and its 2017-107 amendment are only available as scanned, non-machine-readable PDFs (confirmed via two independent tools). Secondary reporting (CLEISS, non-primary) claims a cost-of-living-based revaluation shift parallel to CNPS's, but this could not be verified against primary text.

reports.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
reports.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services of urban households. Geographic coverage: regional capitals and conurbations. Base currently 2023=100; next base change planned for 2028 after the 10th EPF.
reports._notes: Flagship price statistic. Published on the 8th of each month (or previous business day). Directly used by the Banco Central de Chile for inflation monitoring and for the UF/UTM adjustment mechanisms. July 2026 monthly variation 0.1%.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Empleo (ENE) / National Employment Survey
reports.description: Continuous household survey producing the official labour-market indicators: employment, unemployment, labour force participation, informal employment, and related rates. Published as moving quarters.
reports._notes: Core labour survey. April–June 2026: national unemployment rate 9.4%; informal employment rate 27.0%. Microdata and detailed tables released regularly. Experimental dimensions (skill mismatch, etc.) recently added.

reports.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Chile
reports.publisher: Banco Central de Chile (with INE source data)
reports.description: Full system of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income, institutional sector accounts and related aggregates. Compiled by the Central Bank; many volume and price inputs from INE.
reports._notes: In Chile the central bank is the primary compiler of the national accounts, using extensive INE source statistics. Quarterly GDP and annual institutional accounts are the headline products.

reports.title: Índice de Producción Industrial (IPI) / Industrial Production Index
reports.description: Monthly volume index of industrial production (manufacturing, mining, electricity/gas/water). Principal short-term activity indicator for the industrial sector.
reports._notes: Core short-term industrial indicator. May 2026: +1.6% year-on-year. Complements the broader activity measures produced by the Central Bank.

reports.title: Medición de la pobreza por ingresos / Income poverty measurement
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia + INE + CEPAL technical support
reports.description: Official income-poverty measurement based on a basic food basket and non-food component, updated with methodological revisions (most recent major update process 2025). Uses household survey income data and IPC for price updating.
reports._notes: Headline social indicator. Methodology recently reviewed with CEPAL, INE and MDSF participation. Canasta Básica de Alimentos constructed from the EPF and updated with IPC food prices.

reports.title: Encuesta de Presupuestos Familiares (EPF) / Family Budget Survey
reports.description: Periodic household expenditure survey that supplies the weights and basket for the CPI and is a key input into the poverty-line construction. 10th round scheduled 2026–2027 for the 2028 CPI base change.
reports._notes: Structural survey underpinning both the CPI and the poverty methodology. Next round (10ª EPF) begins collection September 2026 and will drive the 2028=100 CPI base.

reports.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
reports.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys. Latest major census 2017; next cycle in preparation.
reports._notes: Foundational demographic product. Population projections and survey designs continuously reference the census baseline.

reports.title: Indicador de Actividad Económica Regional (INACER)
reports.description: Regional economic activity indicator produced by INE for the regions of Chile. Provides a geographic disaggregation of short-term activity.
reports._notes: Regional counterpart to the national activity measures. Useful for the later regional/metro hierarchy fill.
reports._domains_note: Tagged general-statistics (promoted into the Domain union 2026-08-18). This is a general multi-domain statistical compendium — a state/district yearbook or abstract — and its only original tag was a geographic or 'comprehensive' pseudo-tag that the 2026-08-18 domain pass dropped. Dropping 'comprehensive' was right for batch-meta nodes and wrong here: for a yearbook, 'covers everything' is a fact about the content. Asserting the individual domains it covers would be inventing them.

reports.title: Índice de Producción Minera (IPMin)
reports.description: Monthly volume index of mining production (metallic, non-metallic, energy resources). Component of the broader IPI. Critical for a mining-intensive economy.
reports._notes: Flagship mining volume indicator. June 2026: +6.0% year-on-year. Lithium carbonate and metallic mining frequently drive the swings. Direct input into national accounts and external-sector analysis.

reports.title: Índice de Producción Manufacturera (IPMan)
reports.description: Monthly volume index of manufacturing production. Component of the IPI.
reports._notes: Manufacturing counterpart to the mining index. June 2026: −3.2% year-on-year in one recent release window. Food processing and other divisions regularly detailed.

reports.title: Índice de Producción de Electricidad, Gas y Agua (IPEGA)
reports.description: Monthly volume index of electricity, gas and water production/distribution. Component of the IPI.
reports._notes: Utilities component of industrial production. Completes the three-pillar IPI structure (mining, manufacturing, EGA).

reports.title: Índice de Actividad del Comercio (IAC)
reports.description: Monthly index of commercial activity (wholesale, retail, automotive). Published at constant prices with electronic-commerce and supermarket sub-indices.
reports._notes: Principal short-term commerce indicator. Recent releases have shown solid retail and automotive contributions; electronic-commerce sub-index frequently grows double-digit.

reports.title: IMACEC — Indicador Mensual de Actividad Económica
reports.description: Monthly estimator of economic activity compiled by the Central Bank. Primary high-frequency GDP proxy, drawing on INE volume indicators and other sources.
reports._notes: Chilean counterpart to Argentina’s EMAE. Central Bank product that integrates the INE industrial, commerce and other monthly series into a single activity measure.

reports.title: Balanza de Pagos y Posición de Inversión Internacional
reports.description: Quarterly balance of payments and international investment position. Covers current account, capital/financial account, and the stock of external assets and liabilities.
reports._notes: Core external-accounts product. Q1 2026: current-account surplus of USD 1.9 bn (1.9% of GDP). Annual yearbook and detailed quarterly releases available.

reports.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
reports.publisher: Banco Central de Chile / Aduanas (with INE support)
reports.description: Monthly and quarterly statistics of exports and imports of goods, including copper and other mining products, by partner and by product.
reports._notes: Trade data feed both the balance of payments and the national accounts. Copper remains the dominant single export; lithium and other non-metallic minerals are rising.

reports.title: Base monetaria y agregados monetarios
reports.description: Regular statistics of the monetary base and broader monetary aggregates (M1, M2, etc.) published by the Central Bank.
reports._notes: Core monetary statistics. Published in the Central Bank’s statistical bulletins and database with clear definitions of the aggregates.

reports.title: Índices Nominales de Remuneraciones y de Costos Laborales
reports.description: Monthly indices of nominal wages and labour costs. Complement the ENE employment statistics with a price-of-labour measure.
reports._notes: Wage and labour-cost counterpart to the employment survey. June 2026: nominal remunerations +7.7% year-on-year; labour costs +8.4%.

reports.title: Encuesta de Caracterización Socioeconómica Nacional (CASEN)
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia (with INE methodological support)
reports.description: Periodic multi-purpose household survey that is the primary source for multidimensional and income poverty estimates, living conditions, and social-programme targeting.
reports._notes: Key social survey. Complements the income-poverty methodology that uses EPF and IPC. Provides the broader living-conditions picture used in policy evaluation.

reports.title: Región Metropolitana de Santiago (RMS) — core statistical region
reports.publisher: INE Chile + Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia
reports.description: Capital region and largest population concentration (~7.4–8.4 million depending on census vs survey frame). Primary domain for ENE, CASEN and many price/activity series. Lower income-poverty incidence than the national average.
reports._notes: Dominant metro node. CASEN 2024: income poverty 13.3% (vs national 17.3%); multidimensional poverty 19.7%. ENE regularly publishes RMS unemployment (recently ~9.6%). Censo 2024 population ~7.4 million in the region.

reports.title: Gran Santiago / continuous urban agglomeration
reports.description: Continuous urban fabric of the capital, spanning multiple communes of the Región Metropolitana. Functional metropolitan area for labour-market and price analysis.
reports._notes: Urban-agglomeration counterpart to the administrative Región Metropolitana. Commune-level census data (Puente Alto, Maipú, Santiago, La Florida, etc.) make the internal structure visible.
_referenced_by: Census geographic products and commune-level population
reports._domains_note: Tagged general-statistics (promoted into the Domain union 2026-08-18). This is a general multi-domain statistical compendium — a state/district yearbook or abstract — and its only original tag was a geographic or 'comprehensive' pseudo-tag that the 2026-08-18 domain pass dropped. Dropping 'comprehensive' was right for batch-meta nodes and wrong here: for a yearbook, 'covers everything' is a fact about the content. Asserting the individual domains it covers would be inventing them.

reports.title: ENE — resultados Región Metropolitana de Santiago
reports.description: Geographic cut of the National Employment Survey for the capital region, including provincial breakdowns inside the RMS.
reports._notes: Practical vehicle for metro labour analysis. Recent moving quarter: RMS unemployment 9.6% (slightly above national). Provincial variation inside the region is reported (Cordillera, Talagante higher; others lower).

reports.title: CASEN — resultados Región Metropolitana de Santiago
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia
reports.description: Regional cut of the CASEN survey providing income poverty, multidimensional poverty and living-conditions indicators for the capital region.
reports._notes: Shows the capital region as lower-poverty than the national average under the updated methodology (13.3% income poverty vs 17.3% national in 2024).

reports.title: Producción y exportaciones de cobre / Copper statistics
reports.description: Official and industry statistics of mine copper production (Codelco + private), exports, and contribution to fiscal revenues. Chile remains the world’s largest copper producer (~24% of global output).
reports._notes: Structural backbone of the Chilean economy and external accounts. 2024–2025 production in the 5.3–5.5 Mt range. Codelco ~24–29% of national output; private mining the rest. Copper is the dominant single export and a major fiscal contributor.

reports.title: Codelco — producción y aporte fiscal
reports.description: State copper producer. Statistical identity covering own production, total attributable production, EBITDA, and transfers to the Treasury.
reports._notes: Largest single mining entity. 2025 own production ~1.33 Mt fine copper; consolidated contribution to the fisco reported in the USD 1.7–1.8 bn range. Also entering lithium via joint venture in the Salar de Atacama.

reports.title: Producción de litio / carbonato de litio (Chile)
reports.description: Physical and value statistics of lithium carbonate and related lithium production, concentrated in the Salar de Atacama. Rising component of non-metallic mining and of fiscal revenues (Corfo contracts).
reports._notes: High-growth critical-mineral series. Visible in the IPMin (non-metallic mining) and in fiscal accounts (ingresos por litio de Corfo). Production in the hundreds of thousands of tonnes LCE; joint-venture developments continuing.

reports.title: Comisión Chilena del Cobre (Cochilco) — statistical publications
reports.description: Specialised public agency that compiles and disseminates copper and broader mining statistics, market analysis and production projections.
reports._notes: Authoritative specialised source for copper production, costs, markets and fiscal contribution. Complements the broader INE industrial indices and Central Bank external accounts.

reports.title: Estadísticas de finanzas públicas / Dirección de Presupuestos
reports.publisher: Dirección de Presupuestos (DIPRES) — Ministerio de Hacienda
reports.description: Official public-finance statistics covering central-government revenues (including copper and lithium), expenditure, and fiscal balance. Copper and lithium are explicitly tracked revenue lines.
reports._notes: Public-finance counterpart to the mining production and trade statistics. Copper (Codelco + private mining taxation) and lithium (Corfo) are material and volatile components of fiscal revenue.

reports.title: Censo 2024 — resultados Región Metropolitana
reports.description: Regional and commune-level results of the 2024 Population and Housing Census for the capital region.
reports._notes: Structural demographic baseline for the metro. Commune ranking (Puente Alto, Maipú, Santiago, La Florida, etc.) and ageing indices already published. Feeds survey frames and small-area estimation.

reports.title: Región de Antofagasta — core statistical identity (northern mining)
reports.description: Northern mining region, major copper and lithium production zone. Lower income-poverty incidence than the national average. Strong labour-market participation relative to southern regions.
reports._notes: Mining-specialised region. CASEN 2024 income poverty 16.4% (close to or below national). ENE recent unemployment ~7.2%. Hosts major copper operations and lithium activity in the broader northern corridor.

reports.title: Región de La Araucanía — core statistical identity (highest-poverty contrast)
reports.description: Southern region with the highest income-poverty incidence in the CASEN 2024 results. Tests the statistical hierarchy under higher marginalisation.
reports._notes: Poverty-contrast region. CASEN 2024: income poverty 28.6% (highest among the 16 regions); extreme poverty 13.0%. ENE still produces regular labour-force estimates (recent unemployment ~7.8%). National survey infrastructure reaches the region fully; local independent statistical density is thinner.

reports.title: Región de Valparaíso — core statistical identity
reports.description: Central coastal region, second-largest population after the Metropolitana. Income poverty close to the national average.
reports._notes: Intermediate region. CASEN 2024 income poverty 17.8% (slightly above national 17.3%). Useful bridge between the capital and the extremes.

reports.title: Región del Biobío — core statistical identity
reports.description: South-central region with significant industrial and forestry activity. Income poverty moderately above the national average.
reports._notes: CASEN 2024 income poverty 19.3%. Completes a central–south transect alongside Valparaíso, Maule and Araucanía.

reports.title: CASEN — pobreza por región (income and multidimensional)
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia
reports.description: Official regional tabulations of income poverty and multidimensional poverty from the CASEN survey. Primary source for the inter-regional poverty gradient.
reports._notes: Key homogeneity-test product. 2024 ranking (income poverty): Magallanes 9.9%, Metropolitana 13.3%, Antofagasta 16.4%, Valparaíso 17.8%, Biobío 19.3%, Los Ríos 22.3%, Maule 24.3%, Ñuble 23.9%, La Araucanía 28.6%.

reports.title: ENE — resultados Región de Antofagasta
reports.description: Regional cut of the National Employment Survey for the northern mining region.
reports._notes: Recent moving quarter: unemployment ~7.2%, participation relatively high (~65%). Informal employment lower than in southern agricultural regions.

reports.title: ENE — resultados Región de La Araucanía
reports.description: Regional cut of the National Employment Survey for the highest-poverty southern region.
reports._notes: Recent moving quarter: unemployment ~7.8%. Agriculture and public services are important employment absorbers. Demonstrates that the national labour survey reaches the high-poverty region with usable frequency.

reports.title: INACER — Indicador de Actividad Económica Regional (multi-region)
reports.description: Regional economic activity indicators produced for the 16 regions. Geographic counterpart to the national short-term activity measures.
reports._notes: Allows comparison of short-term activity across mining, capital, central and southern regions under a common methodology.
reports._domains_note: Tagged general-statistics (promoted into the Domain union 2026-08-18). This is a general multi-domain statistical compendium — a state/district yearbook or abstract — and its only original tag was a geographic or 'comprehensive' pseudo-tag that the 2026-08-18 domain pass dropped. Dropping 'comprehensive' was right for batch-meta nodes and wrong here: for a yearbook, 'covers everything' is a fact about the content. Asserting the individual domains it covers would be inventing them.

reports.title: Región de Magallanes y de la Antártica Chilena — low-poverty contrast
reports.description: Southernmost region with the lowest income-poverty incidence in CASEN 2024. Completes the geographic poverty gradient.
reports._notes: CASEN 2024 income poverty 9.9% — lowest of the 16 regions. Small population but useful as the opposite pole to La Araucanía.

reports.title: Región del Maule — secondary high-poverty node
reports.description: Central-south agricultural region with elevated income poverty (second-highest after Araucanía in recent CASEN).
reports._notes: CASEN 2024 income poverty 24.3%. Reinforces the central–south poverty gradient alongside Ñuble and La Araucanía.

reports.title: Ley Orgánica Constitucional del Banco Central de Chile (Ley 18.840)
reports.publisher: Poder Legislativo / Banco Central de Chile
reports.description: Constitutional organic law (1989, subsequently amended) that establishes the Central Bank’s autonomy, objectives (currency stability and normal functioning of internal and external payments), governance and powers, including reserve management and monetary-policy instruments.
reports._notes: Foundational static + recurring-citation node for the Chilean central bank — direct analogue of Argentina’s BCRA legal framework and of Mexico’s Banco de México organic law. Continuously cited as the source of the inflation-targeting mandate and of the Bank’s statistical and reserve-management powers.
_referenced_by: Every major BCCh policy and statistical publication
IPoM and financial-stability reports that cite the legal mandate
Academic and legal analyses of central-bank independence in Chile

reports.title: Informe de Política Monetaria (IPoM)
reports.description: Quarterly Monetary Policy Report of the Central Bank. Explains the inflation outlook, the medium-term analytical framework and the implications for the policy interest rate. Statutory reporting obligation to the Senate and the Minister of Finance.
reports._notes: Flagship policy communication product. Published after the March, June, September and December monetary-policy meetings. Central reference for inflation expectations and for the interpretation of the 3% inflation target.

reports.title: Reservas Internacionales del Banco Central de Chile
reports.description: Stock of international reserves managed by the Central Bank under the powers granted by the organic law. Published at high frequency and analysed in the Bank’s financial and external-sector reports.
reports._notes: Key external-vulnerability and monetary-policy indicator. Portfolio composition and investment policy are publicly described; reserves appear in the balance of payments (change in reserve assets) and in the IIP.

reports.title: Marco de metas de inflación (3%) y régimen de tipo de cambio flexible
reports.description: Operational monetary-policy framework: inflation targeting centred on 3% annual CPI inflation, complemented by a flexible exchange-rate regime. Derived from the organic-law mandate to preserve the stability of the currency.
reports._notes: Core policy-framework node. Continuously cited as the reference against which inflation outcomes and policy actions are evaluated. Static institutional commitment with high-frequency operational citation.
_referenced_by: Every IPoM and monetary-policy decision statement
IPC and inflation analysis that refers to the target
Academic and market commentary on Chilean monetary policy

reports.title: Unidad de Fomento (UF) y Unidad Tributaria Mensual (UTM)
reports.publisher: Banco Central de Chile / Servicio de Impuestos Internos
reports.description: Inflation-indexed units of account. The UF is adjusted daily with the IPC and is widely used in contracts, mortgages and financial instruments; the UTM is used for tax and administrative purposes.
reports._notes: Distinctive Chilean institutional feature. The UF links the IPC directly into the financial and contractual system; its daily value is a high-frequency official statistic derived from the consumer-price index.

reports.title: Estadísticas de matrícula del sistema escolar (MINEDUC)
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Educación — Centro de Estudios
reports.description: Official enrolment statistics of the Chilean school system by level, dependency (municipal, SLEP, subsidised private, private), nationality and special-needs status. Annual series.
reports._notes: Core education stock statistic. 2025 school enrolment ~3.54 million. Dependency structure and rising foreign-national share are regularly published. Complements CASEN and census education indicators.

reports.title: Sistema de Medición de la Calidad de la Educación (SIMCE)
reports.publisher: Agencia de Calidad de la Educación
reports.description: National standardised assessment of learning outcomes in language, mathematics and other subjects at key grades (4° and 8° básico, II medio). Annual or near-annual public results.
reports._notes: Flagship learning-outcome indicator. 2025 results show stabilisation/recovery after the post-pandemic drop. Gender gaps and socio-economic gradients are routinely analysed. Continuously cited in education-policy evaluation.

reports.title: Años de escolaridad promedio / educational attainment indicators
reports.publisher: INE / Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia / MINEDUC
reports.description: Average years of schooling of the adult population and related attainment rates, drawn from census, CASEN and administrative sources.
reports._notes: 2024 marked the first time average schooling of the population 18+ exceeded 12 years (the length of compulsory education). Long upward trend documented in CASEN and census series.

reports.title: Fondo Nacional de Salud (FONASA) — coverage and expenditure statistics
reports.description: Public health-insurance fund covering the large majority of the population. Publishes beneficiary counts, benefit expenditure, and modality-of-care statistics (institutional vs free-choice).
reports._notes: Dominant public insurer (~80% of the population in recent survey frames). Benefit expenditure and per-capita spending are key fiscal and health-system indicators. Copago-cero and GES/AUGE programmes are major policy overlays.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Salud (ENS) / National Health Survey
reports.description: Periodic population health survey measuring risk factors, chronic conditions, health-service use and related outcomes. Principal epidemiological input for health policy.
reports._notes: Structural health-status survey. Complements administrative FONASA and hospital statistics with population-based prevalence and risk-factor data.

reports.title: Gasto público en salud (DIPRES functional classification)
reports.description: Public expenditure on health as a share of GDP and in real terms, published in the functional classification of government spending. Includes FONASA, hospital networks and related programmes.
reports._notes: Health spending rose from 2.6% of GDP in 2005 to 5.3% in 2024 — the largest functional increase over the period. Central fiscal counterpart to the FONASA and provider statistics.

reports.title: Gasto público en educación (DIPRES functional classification)
reports.description: Public expenditure on education as a share of GDP and in real terms. Covers school system, higher education and related programmes.
reports._notes: Education spending rose from 3.2% of GDP in 2005 to 4.9% in 2024. Complements the enrolment and SIMCE statistics with the resource side of the education system.

reports.title: Clasificación funcional del gasto público (DIPRES)
reports.description: Official functional breakdown of central-government expenditure (health, education, social protection, etc.) as shares of GDP and in real terms. Used for long-term fiscal sustainability analysis.
reports._notes: Key analytical product for the composition of the state. Health and education have been the fastest-growing major functions over the last two decades; social protection remains the largest single block.

reports.title: Isapres — private health-insurance system statistics
reports.description: Regulatory and statistical reporting on the private health-insurance funds (Isapres): affiliation, premiums, benefits and financial indicators.
reports._notes: Complement to FONASA. Covers the minority but higher-income segment of the dual health-insurance system. Continuously cited in debates on system fragmentation and reform.

reports.title: Ley de Presupuestos / National Budget execution statistics
reports.description: Annual budget law and subsequent execution reports covering revenues (including copper and lithium) and expenditure by ministry and programme.
reports._notes: Operational fiscal framework. Links the copper/lithium revenue lines already captured with the functional spending on health, education and social protection.

_status: DRAFT, NOT IMPORTED. Cameroon researched as part of a push into CEMAC/Central-Africa-Sahel territory the branch's source docx had only described in undifferentiated bloc-level prose ("Central Africa & Sahel: Very limited national systems...") without naming individual countries. Sitting in src/data/research/ pending Thomas's review.
_note: The standout finding: INS Cameroon's own CPI methodology note names AFRISTAT and a CEMAC regulation directly and by number (Reglement N 03/21-CEMAC-UEAC-CM-36 du 27 janvier 2021) -- the CEMAC analogue of the ECOWAS HCPI guide that has failed independent verification three times in this branch's West Africa work. The regulation's own text was not independently opened, but a separate, genuinely opened CEMAC Commission document (its own 2024 regional inflation note, cemac.int) independently names INS-Cameroun as a data-contributing institute and reports Cameroon-specific IHPC statistics sourced from INS -- giving a clean, non-composite, both-sides-opened edge that the West Africa equivalent never achieved. Also notable: INS Cameroon's own document states plainly that Cameroonian wages are NOT indexed to prices ("les salaires ne sont pas indexes sur les prix"), offered by INS itself as the explanation for eroding purchasing power -- a rare case of an official statistics agency stating a non-indexation fact about its own economy as context for its own release.

_open_questions.question: Reglement N 03/21-CEMAC-UEAC-CM-36 du 27 janvier 2021 (the CEMAC harmonised-CPI regulation) is named by number and date in both INS Cameroon's own methodology note and the CEMAC Commission's 2024 inflation note, but its own text/URL was not located this session -- only citing documents were opened.

INS Cameroon has rebased to a new 2022 base year (per the CEMAC Commission's 2024 note), but the household expenditure survey underlying that rebasing was not identified this session -- the only named weight survey (ECAM3, 2007) belongs to the now-superseded 2011-base generation.

MINFI's own 'Pensions et rentes viageres' page, which likely holds administrative civil-service pension rules, refused both WebFetch (ROBOTS_DISALLOWED, then timeout) and direct curl (connection reset) on repeated attempts this session.

reports.title: Note mensuelle sur l'évolution des prix à la consommation finale des ménages au Cameroun
reports.publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Cameroun (INS)
reports.description: Cameroon's official consumer price index, produced monthly by INS. A mid-2025 hors-serie note describes the then-current base year as 2011 ("2eme generation", official since Jan 2012, COICOP-classified with no version stated, weights from the 2007 ECAM3 household survey). The May 2026 monthly note shows the index has since rebased to "Base 100 annee 2022", matching the CEMAC-wide harmonisation (IHPC) framework under CEMAC Reglement N 03/21-CEMAC-UEAC-CM-36 du 27 janvier 2021 (per the CEMAC Commission's own 2024 inflation note). INS's own methodology text: "La methodologie de l'IPC resulte des travaux et des arbitrages des experts nationaux et des organismes internationaux (AFRISTAT, CEMAC). Un reglement de la CEMAC definit tres precisement la maniere de calculer l'IPC et est partage avec les autres pays de la sous-region."
reports.cadence_note: "Une note mensuelle est editee et diffusee au plus tard le 15 de chaque mois pour chacune des villes de Yaounde et de Douala"; a national annual synthesis note follows within 40 days of year-end.

release_schedule.note: Nominally titled a 'Note mensuelle' (monthly note), but INS Cameroun's actual publication record shows severe, unpredictable backlogs rather than a fixed monthly cadence, so no computable next date exists. Evidence from the publisher's own site (ins-cameroun.cm/annee/2025/ and /annee/2026/): the January 2025 note was published 26 Feb 2025; the June 2025 note was published 22 Jul 2025 (normal ~1-month lag); but then the July, August, September, and October 2025 notes were ALL published together on the same day, 9 Dec 2025 (a 4-month data backlog cleared at once); the November 2025 note followed on 21 Jan 2026; and the next note (covering May 2026 data) was not published until 16 Jun 2026, a roughly 6-month gap from November. As of today (11 Aug 2026), no note covering June or July 2026 data has appeared on the site yet, i.e. nearly 2 more months with no release since the May 2026 note. Given this history of multi-month gaps and batched catch-up releases, no reliable 'next release' date can be computed.

reports.title: Note sur l'inflation dans les pays membres de la CEMAC
reports.description: The CEMAC Commission's own regional note on inflation across its six member states (Cameroon, Central African Republic, Chad, Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon), built on the harmonised CPI (IHPC) framework under Reglement N 03/21-CEMAC-UEAC-CM-36 du 27 janvier 2021: "Par Reglement N 03/21-CEMAC-UEAC-CM-36 du 27 janvier 2021... la Commission de la CEMAC a rendu obligatoire la publication reguliere et la diffusion de l'IHPC des 2022." Names INS-Cameroun directly as a national-institute contributor ("Source: INS des Etats membres") and reports Cameroon-specific IHPC database statistics (1,163 varieties, 9,000 outlets, rebased to 2022 alongside Chad while the CEMAC-wide aggregate stays on base 2019); Cameroon carries the largest weight (52.4%) of any member state in the CEMAC aggregate index.

reports.title: Cameroon: Eighth Reviews Under the Extended Arrangement Under the Extended Fund Facility and the Arrangement Under the Extended Credit Facility, and Third Review Under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility Arrangement
reports.description: IMF Country Report No. 25/222 (August 2025). Its Technical Memorandum of Understanding requires monthly, disaggregated CPI data from INS as an IMF program-monitoring input: "Consumer price indices disaggregated by city, product and at the national level. INS Monthly 6 weeks." Separately documents that civil-service pension reform is unresolved as of mid-2025 (2024 actuarial study completed, IMF technical-assistance report just submitted, no adjustment mechanism yet established).

dependencies.basis: CEMAC Commission's own 2024 inflation note names "INS- Cameroun" as a country contributor (p.29, "CONTRIBUTION A LA PRODUCTION DE LA NOTE") and presents Cameroon-specific IHPC database statistics with "Source : INS des Etats membres" (p.5, Tableau 1).
IMF Country Report No. 25/222, Technical Memorandum of Understanding, Table 1 (p.95): "Consumer price indices disaggregated by city, product and at the national level. INS Monthly 6 weeks."

_dropped.edge: cm-ins-cpi -> general wage level (Cameroon nominal wages indexed to CPI)
_dropped.why: INS's own hors-serie note states plainly: "Il y a lieu de souligner que les salaires ne sont pas indexes sur les prix ; ce qui est une cause de l'erosion du pouvoir d'achat des populations concernees" (p.1, INTRODUCTION) -- an explicit denial of wage-CPI indexation in Cameroon, offered by INS itself.

Decret n 74-733 du 19 aout 1974, Art. 37 (in CNPS's own 2021 compendium of base texts): pension revaluation coefficients are fixed by ministerial order "chaque fois qu'intervient une mesure generale d'augmentation des salaires des travailleurs soumis au Code du Travail" -- tied to general wage increases, not CPI/inflation. A regional CIPRES directive (Directive N 001/CM/CIPRES, Art. 54) separately names "le cout de la vie" as only one of several non-exclusive factors (alongside wages and "any other relevant parameter") a discretionary regulatory act may consider -- a concept, not a titled CPI report, so no edge is minted from that directive either. Individual historical revaluations found (Arrete 006/1983: +16%; Arrete 037/1984: +15%) are flat, ad hoc, discretionary coefficients with no CPI calculation shown.

Decret N 2016/034 du 21 janvier 2016, Art. 1er: family allowances revalued to a flat "2.800 francs par enfant a charge et par mois" by presidential decree, with no CPI or cost-of-living formula stated in the decree text.

_dropped.edge: CNPS occupational-injury annuities (rente d'accident du travail) -> cm-ins-cpi
_dropped.why: Decret n 74-733 du 19 aout 1974, Art. 24: "Les montants des paiements periodiques en cours, attribues au titre de rente d'accident du travail peuvent etre revalorises par decret" -- no criterion at all is stated, not even cost of living.

_dropped.edge: World Bank Cameroon Social Safety Nets cash transfer amount -> cm-ins-cpi
_dropped.why: World Bank Social Safety Nets for Crisis Response Additional Financing PAD (P164830, 2018), para 51: "The current design of the transfer, notably amount and frequency, will be maintained" -- amount held fixed, with no CPI/inflation-indexation language found in this document or the companion Adaptive Safety Nets and Economic Inclusion Project appraisal document.

IMF Country Report No. 25/222, Supplementary MEFP para 26: civil-service pension reform is explicitly described as unresolved and in-progress as of mid-2025, with no adjustment mechanism documented yet. MINFI's own 'Pensions et rentes viageres' page, which likely holds the administrative rules, could not be retrieved this session (see cm-minfi-pensions-page-unreachable).

_dropped.edge: cm-ins-cpi -> CEMAC Reglement N 03/21-CEMAC-UEAC-CM-36 du 27 janvier 2021
_dropped.why: Named directly, by number and date, in both INS Cameroon's own methodology note ("AFRISTAT, CEMAC... Un reglement de la CEMAC definit tres precisement la maniere de calculer l'IPC") and the CEMAC Commission's own 2024 inflation note. The regulation's own text/URL was not independently located this session -- only citing documents were opened, consistent with this branch's standing caution about regional HCPI framework instruments (three prior failed attempts on the West Africa/ECOWAS equivalent).

reports.title: Regulations for the Implementation of the Statistics Law of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Administrative regulations issued pursuant to the Statistics Law. Detail the organisation and management of statistical surveys, approval and filing of statistical survey projects, statistical standards, data quality control, publication of statistical data, and statistical supervision. Clarify responsibilities of statistical institutions at various levels and the obligations of survey respondents. Current version adopted 2017 and effective from 1 August 2017; operationalises the legal framework for NBS and other government statistical work.

reports.title: China Statistical Yearbook (中国统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Flagship annual statistical compendium comprehensively reflecting China's economic and social development. Covers national and provincial-level data for the preceding year across approximately 28 chapters including general survey, population, national accounts, employment and wages, prices, people's livelihoods, government finance, resources and environment, energy, fixed-asset investment, international trade, agriculture, industry, construction, wholesale and retail, transport, finance, real estate, science and technology, education, health, culture and sports. Includes historical series for key indicators and selected data for Hong Kong SAR, Macao SAR and Taiwan Province. Published in Chinese and English; typically released in September. Serves as the primary official reference volume for a wide range of indicators.

reports.title: Statistical Communiqué of the People's Republic of China on the National Economic and Social Development
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Authoritative annual overview of major economic and social developments for the preceding year. Released in late February. Covers GDP and industrial structure, agriculture, industry, investment, domestic trade, foreign trade and economic cooperation, public finance, banking, transport, post and telecommunications, tourism, education, science and technology, culture, health, social services, population, people's living standards, social security, resources, environment and safety. Provides preliminary annual figures that are later refined in the China Statistical Yearbook and final national accounts verification. Primary high-visibility official summary of national performance.
title_aliases: 国民经济和社会发展统计公报

reports.title: Gross Domestic Product and National Accounts (GDP)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Core national accounts framework compiled in accordance with China's System of National Accounts (CSNA 2016), aligned with the United Nations SNA 2008. Produces annual and quarterly GDP by production approach (value added of primary, secondary and tertiary industries, with finer industry breakdowns), expenditure approach components, and related aggregates. Quarterly GDP released approximately 15 days after quarter-end on a discrete basis (since 2015). Annual figures undergo preliminary accounting followed by final verification. Historical series revised after major censuses (most recently the Fifth National Economic Census for 2023). Constant-price series use a fixed base (currently 2020). Serves as the central macroeconomic aggregate for China.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) (居民消费价格指数)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Official measure of changes in the prices of a fixed basket of consumer goods and services purchased by urban and rural households. Compiled as a chained Laspeyres index. Base year updated every five years (most recent rotation to 2025, with first releases under the new base in early 2026). Covers eight major categories and approximately 268 basic classes. Prices collected from roughly 120 000 outlets and over 600 000 representative specifications nationwide. Monthly releases typically around the 9th–10th of the following month. Urban and rural sub-indices and detailed category breakdowns published. Primary indicator of consumer inflation used for policy analysis and indexation.

reports.title: Value-added of Industry (Industrial Production) above Designated Size
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Key high-frequency indicator of industrial output measuring the year-on-year growth rate of value added of industrial enterprises above designated size (principal business revenue threshold). Covers mining, manufacturing, and production and supply of electricity, heat, gas and water. Monthly releases typically mid-month for the preceding month, with cumulative year-to-date figures. Sectoral and ownership breakdowns (state-owned, private, etc.) and selected high-tech/equipment manufacturing series provided. Major input into quarterly and annual national accounts production-side estimates and short-term economic monitoring.

reports.title: National Population Census (and 1% Population Sample Surveys)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) / Office of the Leading Group of the State Council for the National Population Census
reports.description: Decennial full-enumeration population census providing comprehensive data on population size, structure (age, sex, ethnicity, education, employment, household type), distribution, urban-rural composition and migration. Seventh National Population Census conducted with reference time 00:00 hours on 1 November 2020; main results released May 2021. Supplementary 1% National Population Sample Surveys conducted in inter-censal years (most recent 2025). Governed by the Regulations on National Population Census. Results form the benchmark for annual population estimates, demographic analysis and many socio-economic indicators published in the Statistical Yearbook and Communiqué.

reports.title: Household Income and Expenditure / People's Livelihoods Statistics
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Recurring household survey-based statistics on per capita disposable income, consumption expenditure, income distribution, poverty-related indicators and living conditions of urban and rural residents. Principal source for the 'People's Livelihoods' chapter of the China Statistical Yearbook and for key figures in the annual Statistical Communiqué. Provides the expenditure weights used in CPI basket construction and informs national accounts household consumption estimates. Data released quarterly and annually with urban/rural and regional breakdowns.

reports.title: Money Supply and Financial Statistics (M0, M1, M2 and related)
reports.description: Monthly monetary aggregates and related financial statistics compiled and released by the People's Bank of China. Core series include currency in circulation (M0), narrow money (M1 – revised definition from January 2025 to include personal demand deposits and non-bank payment institution client reserves), and broad money (M2). Accompanying data cover RMB and foreign-currency loans and deposits, aggregate financing to the real economy (social financing scale), and selected central-bank balance-sheet items. Released in the monthly Financial Statistics Report. Primary high-frequency monetary indicator set for China.

reports.title: Balance of Payments (国际收支平衡表)
reports.description: Quarterly and annual balance-of-payments statistics compiled according to BPM6 standards. Covers the current account (goods, services, primary income, secondary income), capital account and financial account, together with the international investment position. Preliminary quarterly data released approximately 6–8 weeks after quarter-end; annual data and revisions follow. Detailed time-series and analytical reports (China's Balance of Payments Report) published on the SAFE website. Complements NBS external-trade and national-accounts data and forms the official external-sector accounts for China.

reports.title: Producer Price Index for Industrial Products (PPI) (工业生产者出厂价格指数)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly index measuring changes in the ex-factory prices of industrial products. Covers mining, manufacturing and utilities. Includes means of production and consumer goods sub-indices, as well as the related Purchasing Price Index for Industrial Producers. Compiled from surveys of approximately 50 000 enterprises. Base year currently 2020 (updated every five years in parallel with CPI). Released around the 9th–10th of the following month. Key leading indicator of inflationary pressure and industrial cost conditions; input into national accounts and industrial analysis.

reports.title: Investment in Fixed Assets (excluding rural households)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly cumulative series measuring capital expenditure on construction and purchase of fixed assets by enterprises, institutions and government units (excluding rural household investment). Broken down by industry (primary/secondary/tertiary), ownership, region, and selected infrastructure categories. Includes intellectual-property-products investment. Major high-frequency indicator of domestic demand and capital formation; feeds into GDP expenditure-side estimates and quarterly national accounts. Released mid-month for the preceding cumulative period.

reports.title: Total Retail Sales of Consumer Goods
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly indicator of domestic consumption measuring the sum of retail sales of consumer goods sold by all sectors to urban and rural residents and social groups. Includes breakdowns by urban/rural area, goods vs catering, online retail sales of goods and services, and enterprises above designated size. Key high-frequency proxy for household consumption and domestic demand. Released mid-month together with industrial production and fixed-asset investment.

reports.title: Investment in Real Estate Development
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly series on investment by real-estate development enterprises, floor space under construction, newly started and completed, sales of commercial buildings (area and value), and sources of funds. Distinct from the broader Fixed-Asset Investment series; property investment is a major and often volatile component of overall FAI. Critical for monitoring the property sector, which has been a significant drag on recent investment growth. Released mid-month.

reports.title: China Energy Statistical Yearbook (中国能源统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) – Department of Energy Statistics
reports.description: Annual comprehensive compilation of energy production, consumption, conversion efficiency, investment, balance tables (national and regional), and related indicators. Covers primary energy total and by fuel (coal, oil, gas, electricity including hydro, nuclear, wind, solar), industrial terminal consumption by sector, and energy intensity relative to GDP. Principal official source for detailed energy balances and long-term energy series. Published by China Statistics Press; data typically lag the reference year by one year. URL upgraded round 45 (2026-09-10) from the bare host https://www.stats.gov.cn/ to this publication's own page on NBS's 统计出版物 listing, which records its compiling department, ISBN, edition and contents — a bare homepage is an index page under §7a and evidences nothing.

reports.title: Bulletin on the National Grain Production
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Annual (and seasonal) official bulletin reporting total grain sown area, yield per unit area and total production, with breakdowns by season (summer grains, early rice, autumn grains) and major cereals (rice, wheat, maize). Based on nationwide surveys across all 31 provinces. Released in December for the calendar year. Core agricultural output indicator used in the Statistical Communiqué, Yearbook and national accounts primary-industry estimates. Complements broader agricultural statistics systems.

reports.title: Customs Statistics on Imports and Exports of Goods
reports.publisher: General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China (GAC)
reports.description: Monthly and annual merchandise trade statistics compiled on a customs basis. Covers total import and export values (in RMB and USD), trade by regime (ordinary trade, processing trade, etc.), partner countries/regions, and major commodity categories. Released monthly with detailed tables; annual reviews also published. Primary source for China's goods trade data used in Balance of Payments (goods account), national accounts net exports, and the Statistical Communiqué / Yearbook. Distinct from BOP ownership-transfer adjustments.

reports.title: National Expenditures on Science and Technology / R&D Expenditure Statistics
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) jointly with Ministry of Science and Technology and Ministry of Finance
reports.description: Annual statistical communiqué and detailed tables on research and experimental development (R&D) expenditure, intensity (R&D/GDP), breakdown by activity type (basic research, applied research, experimental development), by performing sector (enterprises, government research institutes, higher education), by region and by high-technology industries. Also covers national fiscal science and technology expenditure. Released typically in September–October for the preceding year (preliminary estimates earlier). Principal official measure of China's innovation investment effort.

reports.title: China Ecological and Environmental Statistical Yearbook / Status Bulletin and Statistical Annual Report
reports.publisher: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) jointly with National Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: Recurring official environmental statistics covering air quality (PM2.5, good-air days), surface-water quality (proportion of Grade I–III sections), coastal waters, soil, solid waste, natural ecology (forest coverage, grassland), pollution emissions (COD, ammonia nitrogen, SO2, NOx, particulates), environmental investment, and carbon-related indicators. Includes the annual China Ecological and Environmental Status Bulletin and the more detailed Ecological and Environmental Statistical Annual Report / Yearbook. Provides the core data for environmental chapters of the China Statistical Yearbook and for green-development monitoring.

reports.title: Energy Production (monthly)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly release of major energy production indicators including raw coal, crude oil, natural gas and electricity generation (thermal, hydro, nuclear, wind, solar). Part of the regular mid-month economic data package. Provides high-frequency monitoring of energy supply that complements the annual Energy Statistical Yearbook balances and feeds into industrial and GDP analysis.

reports.title: Gross Regional Product (Provincial GDP) Series
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Annual (and in some cases quarterly) series of Gross Regional Product for the 31 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government. Compiled under the unified national accounts framework (CSNA). Since around 2019 NBS has strengthened central coordination of provincial GDP to reduce discrepancies with national totals. Published in the China Statistical Yearbook, National Data platform and provincial communiqués. Provides the official provincial-level aggregate for vertical comparison with national GDP and for regional analysis.

reports.title: Guangdong Statistical Yearbook (广东统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Guangdong Provincial Bureau of Statistics / NBS Guangdong Survey Office
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook of Guangdong Province, the largest provincial economy by GDP. Covers provincial and municipal/county data on national accounts, population, employment, investment, foreign trade, industry, energy, prices, living standards, agriculture and social statistics. Continuously published since the mid-1980s; electronic version released on the provincial statistics website. Principal official reference for Guangdong’s economic and social development and a key high-output coastal node.

reports.title: Jiangsu Statistical Yearbook (江苏统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Jiangsu Provincial Bureau of Statistics / NBS Jiangsu Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Jiangsu Province, one of China’s largest and most developed coastal economies. Systematically records provincial and prefecture-level data on national accounts, population, employment, prices, living standards, fixed-asset investment, foreign trade, energy, industry, agriculture, science and education. Continuously published for four decades; electronic edition released on the official statistics portal. Core high-output eastern provincial node.

reports.title: Zhejiang Statistical Yearbook (浙江统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical publication reflecting Zhejiang’s economic and social development. Covers provincial and city/county data across national accounts, population, employment, investment, foreign trade, industry, private-sector activity, living standards and social indicators. Zhejiang is a major coastal manufacturing and private-economy province; the Yearbook is the primary official statistical reference for the province.

reports.title: Shandong Statistical Yearbook (山东统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Shandong Province, a large coastal industrial and agricultural economy. Contains provincial and prefecture-level series on GDP and industrial structure, population, employment, fixed-asset investment, foreign trade, energy, industry, agriculture and social development. Serves as the principal official data source for Shandong’s regional accounts and sectoral performance.

reports.title: Beijing Statistical Yearbook (北京统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Beijing Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Beijing Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Beijing Municipality. Provides detailed data on national accounts, population and employment, prices, living conditions, government finance, energy and environment, fixed-asset investment and real estate, industry, services, science and technology, education and health. Reflects the capital’s high-income, service-oriented and innovation-intensive economy. Continuously published; electronic version available on the municipal statistics site.

reports.title: Shanghai Statistical Yearbook (上海统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Shanghai Survey Office
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook of Shanghai Municipality. Covers national accounts, population, employment, prices, living standards, investment, foreign trade and economic cooperation, industry, finance, real estate, science and technology, education and social statistics. Captures China’s leading international financial and trade centre. Primary official reference for Shanghai’s economic structure and high per-capita income profile.

reports.title: Sichuan Statistical Yearbook (四川统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Sichuan Province, the largest economy in western China and a major inland industrial and agricultural base. Records provincial, prefecture and county-level data on national accounts, population, employment, investment, energy, resources and environment, agriculture, industry, construction, trade, science and education. Provides the principal official statistical picture of a high-output inland province for contrast with coastal peers.

reports.title: Henan Statistical Yearbook (河南统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Henan Province, a major central-China agricultural and industrial province with large population. Covers provincial and local data on GDP and industrial structure, population, employment, investment, agriculture (including grain), industry, living standards and social indicators. Serves as the core official statistical source for Henan and as a central-region contrast node.

reports.title: Guizhou Statistical Yearbook (贵州统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Guizhou Province, a relatively lower-income western province that has experienced rapid growth from a lower base. Systematically presents provincial, prefecture and county data on national accounts, population, employment, investment, foreign trade, energy, resources and environment, agriculture, industry, living conditions and minority nationality areas. Provides the official statistical baseline for western inland contrast with high-output coastal provinces.

reports.title: China City Statistical Yearbook (中国城市统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) – Department of Urban Socio-economic Surveys
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook covering socio-economic development of Chinese cities. Contains data for prefecture-level and above cities and for county-level cities on population, resources and environment, economic development (including GDP), science and technology innovation, public services and infrastructure. Distinguishes ‘whole city’ (including counties under jurisdiction) from ‘urban districts’ (shiqu). Principal national-level source for comparable city statistics; published by China Statistics Press. URL upgraded round 45 (2026-09-10) from the bare host https://www.stats.gov.cn/ to this publication's own page on NBS's 统计出版物 listing, which records its compiling department, ISBN, edition and contents — a bare homepage is an index page under §7a and evidences nothing.

reports.title: Guangzhou Statistical Yearbook (广州统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Guangzhou Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Guangzhou Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Guangzhou, the provincial capital and major economic centre of Guangdong and the Pearl River Delta. Systematically records city-wide and district-level data on national accounts (regional GDP), population, employment, investment, industry, trade, living standards and social statistics. Continuously published; electronic editions available on the municipal statistics website. Key municipal node under the Guangdong provincial layer.

reports.title: Shenzhen Statistical Yearbook (深圳统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Shenzhen, one of China’s leading special economic zones and high-tech / manufacturing hubs. Covers municipal and district data on GDP and industrial structure, population, employment, fixed-asset investment, foreign trade, industry, science and technology, and living standards. Official recurring publication of the Shenzhen statistics authority; electronic version released on the municipal government / statistics portal.

reports.title: Hangzhou Statistical Yearbook (杭州统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Hangzhou Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Hangzhou Survey Team
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Hangzhou, capital of Zhejiang and a major Yangtze River Delta digital-economy and manufacturing centre. Contains city-wide and district/county data across 13 chapters including comprehensive indicators, population and employment, industry and energy, investment, trade, finance, urban construction, science and education, and living standards. Primary official statistical reference for Hangzhou.

reports.title: Chengdu Statistical Yearbook (成都统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook of Chengdu, the largest city and economic centre of Sichuan and a major western China hub. Records city and district/county data on regional GDP, population, employment, investment, industry, trade, science and education, and social development. Provides the official municipal statistical picture under the Sichuan provincial layer and serves as the principal western inland city contrast node.

reports.title: Nanjing Statistical Yearbook (南京统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Nanjing Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Nanjing Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Nanjing, capital of Jiangsu and a major Yangtze River Delta industrial, educational and transport centre. Covers municipal and district data on national accounts, population, employment, investment, industry, trade, science and technology, education and living standards. Official recurring product of the Nanjing statistics system; supports vertical analysis under the Jiangsu provincial layer.

reports.title: Suzhou Statistical Yearbook (苏州统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Suzhou Municipal Bureau of Statistics / NBS Suzhou Survey Office
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Suzhou, one of China’s largest prefecture-level economies by GDP and a leading manufacturing and foreign-investment centre in the Yangtze River Delta. Systematically presents city-wide and district data on regional GDP, population, employment, investment, foreign trade, industry and living standards. Primary official statistical reference for Suzhou under the Jiangsu provincial accounts framework.

reports.title: China / NBS Contribution to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: NBS role as data contributor and periodic compiling institution for the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication (JSP) and its Snapshot editions. China has led compilation in multiple years (including the 2011 and 2022 issues). Supplies national series on population, national accounts, prices, labour and living standards, industry, energy, agriculture, external sector and related domains that feed the comparable tables of the JSP. Not a separate statistical survey; it is the institutional contribution channel linking the Chinese statistical system to the BRICS NSO work programme.

reports.title: PBOC Payment System Report (支付体系运行报告)
reports.description: Recurring official report on the operation of China’s payment systems. Covers bank accounts, non-cash payment instruments, volume and value of transactions processed by PBOC CNCC systems (HVPS, BEPS, IBPS, CFXPS), commercial-bank systems, UnionPay, NetsUnion and related platforms. Since the expansion of the e-CNY pilot, successive editions and quarterly updates have included cumulative and period statistics on digital yuan (e-CNY) transaction volumes, wallet openings and application scenarios. Primary official statistical vehicle for e-CNY activity figures released by the central bank.
reports.cadence_note: Annual full report plus quarterly updates

reports.title: Digital RMB (e-CNY) Transaction and Wallet Statistics
reports.description: Official statistics on the digital yuan (e-CNY / digital RMB). Includes cumulative and periodic transaction volumes and values, number of personal and institutional wallets opened, number of authorised operating institutions, pilot locality coverage, and selected application scenarios (retail, public services, wages, taxes, cross-border pilots). Data are released primarily through the PBOC Payment System Report series, dedicated briefings by PBOC governors/deputy governors, and occasional special announcements on operator expansion. Not a standalone yearbook; the recurring statistical content is embedded in the payment-system reporting framework.
reports.cadence_note: Embedded in quarterly/annual Payment System Reports; additional ad-hoc releases on major expansions

reports.title: China County Statistical Yearbook (中国县域统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS) – Department of Rural Socio-economic Surveys
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook covering China’s county-level and township-level administrative units. Published in two volumes: (1) County/City volume (县市卷) covering ~2 000+ counties, banners, county-level cities and reporting urban districts with indicators on population, regional GDP, fiscal revenue/expenditure, agriculture, industry, education, health and social security; (2) Township volume (乡镇卷) covering ~30 000 townships with basic data on area, population, industrial enterprises and commercial outlets. Primary official source for statistical data on settlements in the ~50 000-population range and the broader county tier. Data exclude Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan Province. URL upgraded round 45 (2026-09-10) from the bare host https://www.stats.gov.cn/ to this publication's own page on NBS's 统计出版物 listing, which records its compiling department, ISBN, edition and contents — a bare homepage is an index page under §7a and evidences nothing.

reports.title: China Mineral Resources Report / National Mineral Resources Reserves Statistics (中国矿产资源报告 / 全国矿产资源储量统计)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Natural Resources of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Official annual (or periodic) report and accompanying statistical tables on China’s mineral resources. Covers discovered mineral types, remaining recoverable reserves of energy minerals (coal, oil, natural gas, etc.), metallic minerals (iron, copper, rare earths, tungsten, tin, molybdenum, gold, etc.) and non-metallic minerals. Includes production rankings, changes in reserves, exploration progress, mine ecological restoration and policy updates. Complements the NBS Energy Statistical Yearbook by providing the reserves and resource-base side of China’s dual role as major producer and consumer of critical minerals.
reports.cadence_note: Annual report; reserves tables updated with reference-year lag

reports.title: China Natural Resources Bulletin (中国自然资源公报)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Natural Resources of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Annual official bulletin summarising the state of China’s natural resources. Includes land, mineral, water, forest and other resource statistics, with a dedicated section on major mineral-resource reserves and changes. Provides high-level official numbers that are consistent with the more detailed Mineral Resources Report and the national energy/mineral statistical system.

reports.title: Urban Surveyed Unemployment Rate and Related Labour-Force Indicators
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Monthly and annual surveyed urban unemployment rate (城镇调查失业率) released by NBS, together with related labour-market indicators including rates for local vs non-local household registration, 31 major cities, age groups, average weekly hours worked, and annual migrant-worker totals. Principal official high-frequency labour-market series under the labour-force survey framework. Published in monthly national economy press releases and annual statistical communiqués / yearbooks.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly rate; annual averages and migrant-worker stock in year-end releases

reports.title: National Education Development Statistical Bulletin (全国教育事业发展统计公报)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Annual official statistical bulletin on the development of education at all levels in China. Covers number of schools, educational personnel, full-time teachers, student enrolments by type and level (pre-primary, compulsory, senior secondary, higher education, special education, vocational), non-government education, and related indicators. Primary titled recurring product of the Ministry of Education statistical system; detailed tables also released as educational statistics data series.

reports.title: China Health Statistical Yearbook (中国卫生健康统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Health Commission of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook on the development of China’s health sector and the health status of the population. Systematically compiles national and provincial data on medical and health institutions, health personnel, health facilities, health expenditure, medical services, primary health care, traditional Chinese medicine, maternal and child health, disease control, causes of death, medical security and related indicators. Principal official health-statistics yearbook.
title_aliases: 中国卫生健康统计年鉴

reports.title: China Rural Statistical Yearbook (中国农村统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook systematically recording national and provincial rural socio-economic data. Covers rural basic conditions and production conditions, agricultural ecology, rural investment, gross output value and value-added of agriculture/forestry/animal husbandry/fishery, major crop and livestock production, rural markets and prices, agricultural product trade, costs and returns, rural income and consumption, rural culture/education/health and social services, state farms, and regional rankings. Complements the grain-production bulletin and county-level yearbook with a full rural–agricultural statistical picture.
