reports.title: Ministry of Finance Public Finance / Budget Execution Statistics (财政收支与预算执行统计)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China
reports.description: Official fiscal statistics compiled and released by the Ministry of Finance. Include monthly and annual general public budget revenue and expenditure (central and local), government-managed funds, state capital operations budget, national and central government deficit/balance figures, and SDDS-aligned general government operations tables. Primary source for China’s public-finance aggregates; data appear in monthly fiscal releases, annual budget execution reports to the National People’s Congress, and SDDS tables.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly fiscal revenue/expenditure releases; annual budget execution report and SDDS tables

reports.title: Wuhan Statistical Yearbook (武汉统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Wuhan, the largest city in Central China and a major Yangtze River economic, transport and higher-education hub. Covers municipal and district data on regional GDP, population, employment, industry, investment, trade, science and education, and living standards. Primary official statistical reference for Wuhan under the Hubei provincial framework.

reports.title: Chongqing Statistical Yearbook (重庆统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Chongqing, a province-level municipality and the largest city by administrative area in China. Records city-wide and district/county data on regional GDP, population, employment, industry, investment, trade and social statistics. Because Chongqing is a province-level municipality its yearbook simultaneously serves municipal and provincial roles; the dual ‘whole city / urban districts’ coverage is especially important given the large rural counties included in headline aggregates.

reports.title: Xi’an Statistical Yearbook (西安统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Xi’an, the capital of Shaanxi and the principal economic and cultural centre of Northwest China. Covers municipal and district data on national accounts, population, employment, industry, investment, trade, science and education. Provides the key western inland city node complementary to Chengdu.

reports.title: China Contribution and Host-Country Role in the New Development Bank
reports.publisher: Government of the People’s Republic of China / People’s Bank of China / Ministry of Finance
reports.description: China’s role as founding member, equal shareholder and host country of the New Development Bank (NDB). Encompasses the Headquarters Agreement (Shanghai), capital subscription and paid-in contributions, the large China country portfolio (sovereign and non-sovereign operations), local-currency (RMB) lending share, and ongoing coordination through the Ministry of Finance and PBOC. Not a separate statistical survey; it is the institutional contribution and host-country channel linking Chinese fiscal/monetary authorities to the NDB work programme and annual reporting.
reports.cadence_note: Continuous; reflected in NDB annual reports and China portfolio evaluations

dependencies.basis: The National Accounts chapter of the China Statistical Yearbook presents the annual GDP series, industry value-added breakdowns and related aggregates that are the final verified outputs of the national accounts compilation process.
The Prices chapter of the Yearbook compiles and presents the annual CPI series and related price indices that originate from the monthly CPI releases.
Population totals, age/sex structure, urban-rural and other demographic indicators in the Yearbook are benchmarked to the most recent population census and inter-censal sample surveys.

The People's Livelihoods chapter draws directly on the household income and expenditure survey results for per-capita disposable income, consumption expenditure and related living-standard indicators.

The opening General Outlook section of each annual Statistical Communiqué presents the preliminary annual GDP figure and growth rate that are the product of the national accounts preliminary accounting.
Industrial production and value-added growth rates reported in the Communiqué are drawn from the monthly industrial value-added series.
Annual average CPI and related price movements summarised in the Communiqué are aggregated from the monthly CPI releases.
Quarterly and annual GDP by production approach incorporates industrial value-added growth as a major component of secondary-industry estimates.

CPI expenditure weights are derived from household consumption patterns measured in the household income and expenditure surveys; the five-year base-year rotation updates the basket and weights from the latest survey results.
dependencies.evidence_quote: CPI的权数主要根据国家统计局开展的全国住户收支与生活状况调查中居民消费支出资料计算

dependencies.basis: Household final consumption expenditure in the national accounts is informed by the household survey data on consumption expenditure.
The Implementation Regulations specify survey management, standards and publication rules that govern production of the Yearbook and other NBS outputs.
Annual average or year-end PPI movements summarised in the Statistical Communiqué are aggregated from the monthly PPI series.
Fixed-asset investment growth and structure reported in the Communiqué draw directly from the monthly FAI releases.
Total retail sales of consumer goods and online retail figures in the Communiqué are compiled from the monthly retail-sales series.
Grain output and agricultural production figures in the Communiqué are taken from the National Grain Production Bulletin and related agricultural surveys.
Merchandise trade totals and growth rates in the Communiqué are based on Customs statistics.
The Prices chapter of the Yearbook presents annual PPI series derived from the monthly industrial producer price indices.
Energy production, consumption and intensity tables in the China Statistical Yearbook draw on the detailed balances and series compiled for the Energy Statistical Yearbook.
Resources and Environment chapters of the Yearbook incorporate air, water, waste and ecological indicators from MEE/NBS environmental statistics.
Gross fixed capital formation in the national accounts is informed by the Fixed-Asset Investment series (with conceptual and coverage adjustments).
Household final consumption expenditure estimates draw on retail sales and household survey data as key source indicators.
Net exports of goods in the expenditure-side national accounts are derived primarily from Customs merchandise trade statistics (with BOP adjustments).
The goods account of the Balance of Payments is compiled from Customs trade data, adjusted for coverage, valuation and ownership-transfer differences under BPM6.
Industrial value-added at current prices incorporates producer price movements; constant-price industrial growth uses PPI deflators among other price indicators.
Real-estate development investment is a major component of overall Fixed-Asset Investment; the dedicated real-estate series provides the detailed property-sector contribution to FAI.
R&D investment intensity is explicitly defined as the ratio of R&D expenditure to GDP; intensity figures are therefore calculated from the national accounts GDP series.
The National Accounts and regional tables of the China Statistical Yearbook present the official provincial Gross Regional Product series compiled under the national accounts framework.
Selected city indicators and urban development data in the China Statistical Yearbook draw on the more detailed city-level series compiled for the China City Statistical Yearbook.
Many of the detailed national series published in the China Statistical Yearbook are the same series supplied in summarised form to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.
Selected county-level aggregates and rural indicators appear in summarised form in the China Statistical Yearbook regional and rural chapters.
Labour-force and unemployment series appear in the employment and population chapters of the China Statistical Yearbook.

reports.title: 住户收支与生活状况调查方案 (Scheme for the Survey of Household Income, Expenditure and Living Conditions)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS scheme governing China's integrated urban-rural household survey — the instrument under which NBS's provincial and municipal survey teams draw the sample areas and sample dwellings, and collect household income, expenditure and living-conditions data by diary and questionnaire. It is the source instrument behind the household chapters of the national, provincial and municipal statistical yearbooks, which report disposable income and consumption expenditure per capita from it. Reissued annually; the edition read for this round covers the 2025 annual report and the 2026 periodic reporting forms.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic reporting forms.

reports.title: 工业生产者价格统计调查制度 (Industrial Producer Price Statistical Survey System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS survey system governing China's industrial producer price statistics — both the ex-factory price of industrial products at first sale (PPI) and the purchasing price of raw materials, fuel and power bought as intermediate input. It prescribes the combination of key-unit and typical-unit survey methods, the online direct-reporting route by which selected enterprises submit prices for designated representative products, and the weights (industrial sales value, input-output data, enterprise product weights) used to compute the indices. Reissued annually; the edition read for this round covers the 2026 periodic reporting forms.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one year's periodic statistical reporting forms.

reports.title: 固定资产投资统计报表制度 (Fixed Asset Investment Statistical Reporting System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system governing China's fixed-asset investment statistics — the instrument that sets the reporting thresholds, the project-based unit of collection, the treatment of real-estate development and rural household investment, and the indicator set every level of the statistical system reports against. Revisions to it propagate directly into what the national, provincial and municipal yearbooks are able to publish: the round that minted this node found Xi'an's yearbook explaining that indicators it used to carry were withdrawn because NBS revised this instrument. Reissued annually; the edition read for this round covers the 2025 annual report and the 2026 periodic reporting forms.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic reporting forms.

Shape declared plainly so a reviewer can weigh it: this is a TABLE NOTE, not a chapter 简要说明, and it is admitted on §7a's caption-equivalence ruling (a source line under a table or figure is a citation of the same standing as body-text prose, grading A) — which is narrower than it sounds here, because the note names the ARTEFACT rather than the collecting agency, and states a dependency rather than a status (rule 19). It is NOT the settled ‘a Chapter 10 table ROW alone is not enough’ case: no indicator row is being read as evidence. Note the title is written without 《》 here, in running prose after the agency name. Do not conflate the two industry titles — that is the same trap the Jiangsu/Wuhan 农业产值 titles set. Xi'an also names two SHAANXI PROVINCIAL instruments by title (《陕西省统计局关于非公有制经济增加值测算的暂行办法（修订版）》 in part 3, and a Shaanxi third-agricultural-census revision scheme in part 11); Shaanxi has no node of any kind in the corpus, so those are a scope question for Thomas before a research one.

_status: NEW 2026-08-13. The corpus's first China nodes, opening the `CN` colour family that has sat reserved and unstaffed since the RU/CN branch was promised on the roadmap. Two building blocks only: the NBS's monthly CPI release (with its standing indicator-explanation page folded in) and the annual Budget Report to the NPC, which carries the central-to-local transfer-payment figures including the 均衡性转移支付 (equalization transfer) line. A third node, the 2026 Government Work Report, carries the year's CPI target and ties it explicitly to monetary policy. Deliberately narrow and, this round, deliberately edge-less: every candidate dependency this session went looking for — Budget Report to the 1994 tax-sharing decision, Budget Report to the equalization-measures formula document, Government Work Report to NBS by name, Budget Report to a standalone Budget Law node — failed on genuine access or verification grounds and is recorded in `_dropped` rather than drawn or invented. The formula behind China's largest fiscal-transfer line (the 标准财政收入/标准财政支出 calculation in 中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法) is NOT in this corpus: the document exists (MOF lists it by title and date) but its text could not be retrieved this session (502/403 on yss.mof.gov.cn, repeated). The 1994 foundational tax-sharing decision (国发〔1993〕85号) is similarly absent: the correct scanned Gazette PDF was located but has no text layer and was not OCR'd. Both are the headline negative findings of this opening round, on the same pattern as Brazil's FPM slice naming its agency and not its statistic.
_note: Researched via direct curl navigation of stats.gov.cn, npc.gov.cn, gov.cn and mof.gov.cn (WebSearch was unavailable this session; generic search engines returned JS-shell/blocked responses to non-browser requests), reconstructing each site's internal listing/search structure by hand. Every URL below was independently fetched and its HTTP status verified in this session, not accepted from an AI-summarized fetch. All access failures recorded in `_dropped` are real HTTP responses (502 Bad Gateway with a genuine CDN x-via header, and 403 with a live WAF block page reading '抱歉，您的请求被阻断了'), captured via verbose curl on repeated retries, not silent or fabricated failures. reports.title: 居民消费价格指数 (Consumer Price Index, CPI) monthly release
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China, NBS)
reports.description: NBS's monthly national CPI release — the July 2026 edition read directly is titled 《2026年7月份居民消费价格同比上涨0.5%》 ('Consumer Prices Rose 0.5% Year-on-Year in July 2026'), headline quote: '2026年7月份，全国居民消费价格同比上涨0.5%。' Definition, from the release's own 指标解释 section: '居民消费价格指数（Consumer Price Index，简称CPI）是度量居民生活消费品和服务价格水平随着时间变动的相对数，综合反映居民购买的生活消费品和服务价格水平的变动情况。' ('The Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures how the price level of consumer goods and services purchased by residents changes over time, comprehensively reflecting price-level movements.') Basket, quoted verbatim: '居民消费价格统计调查涵盖全国城乡居民生活消费的食品烟酒及在外餐饮、衣着、居住、生活用品及服务、交通通信、教育文化娱乐、医疗保健、其他用品及服务等8大类、268个基本分类的商品与服务价格。' (8 major categories, 268 basic classifications: food/tobacco/alcohol & dining out, clothing, housing, household goods & services, transport & communication, education/culture/recreation, healthcare, other goods & services.) Sampling method, quoted verbatim: '采用抽样调查方法抽选确定调查网点，按照"定人、定点、定时"的原则，直接派人到调查网点或从互联网采集原始价格。数据来源于全国31个省（区、市）约500个市县、近12万家价格调查点，包括商场（店）、超市、农贸（生鲜）市场、服务网点和互联网电商等。' (Sampling, 'fixed personnel, fixed location, fixed time' principle, enumerators on-site or online collection; ~500 cities/counties across 31 provinces/regions/municipalities, nearly 120,000 price-survey points, covering malls, supermarkets, farmers' markets, service outlets and e-commerce.) Base-period rotation, quoted verbatim: '按照统计制度安排，2026年1月起，我国CPI开始编制和发布以2025年为基期的价格指数...本次基期轮换对CPI各月同比指数的影响平均约为0.06个百分点。' (Per the statistical system's schedule, from January 2026 China's CPI began being compiled/published on a 2025 base period; the rebasing affects the year-on-year index by an average of ~0.06 percentage points — the release names its own internal '统计制度安排' for this but does not cite an external legal document by title.) NBS's separate standing 指标解释 (Indicator Explanation) reference page (https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zbjs/202302/t20230202_1897106.html, category 价格/Price) restates the same concept in its own words, quoted verbatim: '居民消费价格指数　是反映一定时期内城乡居民所购买的生活消费品和服务项目价格变动趋势和程度的相对数，是对城市居民消费价格指数和农村居民消费价格指数进行综合汇总计算的结果。' (CPI is a relative measure reflecting the trend/extent of price changes in goods and services purchased by urban and rural residents; it is the aggregated result of the urban CPI and rural CPI.) Folded into this single node rather than split into a second, since the indicator-explanation page restates the same definition rather than adding a distinct dependency or methodology fact.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly, confirmed by the existence of a sequential monthly release directory at stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/.

reports.title: 政府工作报告 (Government Work Report), 2026
reports.publisher: 国务院 (State Council), delivered by Premier 李强 (Li Qiang) to the 全国人民代表大会 (National People's Congress, NPC)
reports.description: The State Council's annual report to the NPC, delivered March 5, 2026 at the 4th Session of the 14th NPC, setting the year's headline economic targets including the CPI target. Target, quoted verbatim: '今年发展主要预期目标是：经济增长4.5%－5%...居民消费价格涨幅2%左右...' ('This year's main targets are: economic growth of 4.5–5%... CPI increase of around 2%...'). Rationale, quoted verbatim, explicitly tying the CPI target to price-level policy: '居民消费价格涨幅2%左右，考虑了预期引导和现实可能，我们将通过改善总供求关系，推动价格总水平由负转正、消费价格合理温和回升，促进经济良性循环。' ('A CPI target of ~2% factors in expectation-guidance and feasibility; we will improve the aggregate supply-demand relationship to turn the general price level from negative to positive and encourage a modest, reasonable price recovery.') The monetary-policy paragraph ties the same target to monetary policy explicitly, quoted verbatim: '把促进经济稳定增长、物价合理回升作为货币政策的重要考量...使社会融资规模、货币供应量增长同经济增长、价格总水平预期目标相匹配。' (Promoting stable growth and a reasonable price recovery is stated as an important consideration for monetary policy, matching social-financing and money-supply growth to the growth and price-level targets.) Full-text read this session found no citation of the National Bureau of Statistics (国家统计局) by name anywhere in the document — see `_dropped`.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, delivered at each year's NPC session (early March).

reports.title: 关于2025年中央和地方预算执行情况与2026年中央和地方预算草案的报告 (Report on the 2025 Execution of the Central and Local Budgets and the 2026 Draft Central and Local Budgets)
reports.publisher: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance), delivered on behalf of the 国务院 (State Council) to the 全国人民代表大会 (National People's Congress, NPC)
reports.description: The annual budget report delivered to the NPC alongside the Government Work Report (same session, March 5, 2026), carrying the scale of central-to-local fiscal transfer payments including the equalization-transfer line. 2026 planned figures, quoted verbatim: '中央对地方转移支付安排104150亿元、增长2.2%，其中，均衡性转移支付安排28340亿元、增长3.7%，县级基本财力保障机制奖补资金安排4895亿元、增长2.1%。' (Central-to-local transfer payments for 2026 budgeted at RMB 10.415 trillion, +2.2%, of which equalization transfer payments are RMB 2.834 trillion, +3.7%, and county-level basic fiscal-capacity guarantee reward/subsidy funds are RMB 489.5 billion, +2.1%.) 2025 actual execution, quoted verbatim: '中央对地方转移支付具体情况是：一般性转移支付92475.98亿元，完成预算的98.3%...专项转移支付9449.16亿元，完成预算的101.6%...' (General transfer payments were RMB 9.248 trillion, 98.3% of budget; special-purpose transfer payments were RMB 944.9 billion, 101.6% of budget.) The report cites the Budget Law (预算法) as governing framework, quoted verbatim: '根据预算法规定，预算年度开始后，在全国人民代表大会批准本预算草案前，可安排下列支出...对下级政府的转移性支出...' (Per the Budget Law, before the NPC approves the draft budget, certain expenditures — including transfers to lower-level governments — may be provisionally arranged.) This is a real, quoted citation to 预算法, but the Budget Law's own full text was not independently read or verified this session (only this reference to it, inside the Budget Report), so no separate Budget Law node is minted this round — see `_dropped`. Full-text read this session found no citation, by name or number, of the 1994 tax-sharing decision (国发〔1993〕85号) or of the '中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法' (equalization-measures document) anywhere in this report — the only explicit legal citation found is to 预算法. MOF's own transfer-payment taxonomy platform (http://www.mof.gov.cn/zhuantihuigu/cczqzyzfglbf/, verified live HTTP 200) independently confirms 均衡性转移支付 is filed as a sub-category of 一般性转移支付, and its equalization sub-page (http://www.mof.gov.cn/zhuantihuigu/cczqzyzfglbf/ybxzyzf_7774/jhxzyzf/, verified live HTTP 200) lists the governing MOF notices by title and date, including '财政部关于印发《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》的通知' (dated 2022-04-28 and, an earlier version, 2019-06-11) and an annual run of disbursement notices 2018–2023 — confirming the taxonomy and that these notices exist, but not supplying any formula content, since their own full text was inaccessible this session (see `_dropped`).
reports.cadence_note: Annual, delivered at each year's NPC session (early March), alongside the Government Work Report.

_dropped.edge: cn-npc-budget-report -> 中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法 (equalization transfer measures, the document that would carry the 标准财政收入/标准财政支出 formula)
_dropped.why: REASSESSED 2026-08-13 (BRICS/G.2): the document was found, and the edge is now a CONFIRMED NEGATIVE rather than an access failure. The 办法 is `cn-mof-equalization-transfer-measures` (财预〔2022〕58号) in `cn-g2-budget-law-equalization.json`, carrying the full 标准财政收入/标准财政支出 formula verbatim. G.1 could not reach it for a reason worth recording: the State Council notice page's HTML body contains only the covering letter, and the 办法 itself is an UNLINKED `.docx` attachment (the `yss.mof.gov.cn` 502 was a per-path CDN failure, not a blanket block — that host returns a real 19KB body alongside its 502 status). With the document in hand, the proposed edge was tested and does NOT exist: a literal scan of the full Budget Report text returns 0 hits for 办法 and 0 for 财预. The report states only the outcome, 「均衡性转移支付安排28340亿元、增长3.7%」. So G.1's suspicion that this edge might exist behind the access wall was wrong; the wall was hiding a document, not an edge. ORIGINAL BLOCKER, kept: MOF's own transfer-payment taxonomy pages (mof.gov.cn/zhuantihuigu/cczqzyzfglbf/, live HTTP 200) confirm this document exists, name it by title ('财政部关于印发《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》的通知') and date both a 2022-04-28 and a 2019-06-11 version, and confirm 均衡性转移支付 sits as a sub-category of 一般性转移支付. But the document's actual text — which per the task brief should contain the 标准财政收入/标准财政支出 formula — is hosted on yss.mof.gov.cn (MOF's Budget Department subdomain) and could not be retrieved: http://yss.mof.gov.cn/ybxzyzf/jhxzyzf/202204/t20220428_3807232.htm returns HTTP 502 Bad Gateway on repeated retries (5 attempts, minutes apart, verified via verbose curl with a real CDN x-via header — not a fabricated page); the same URL over HTTPS returns HTTP 403 with a genuine WAF block page ('抱歉，您的请求被阻断了' / 'Sorry, you have been blocked'); the 2019 version (.../201906/t20190611_3275005.htm) fails identically (502). This is a genuine, reproducible access failure on MOF's own subdomain, not a silent drop. No node is minted for this document and no formula content is asserted anywhere in this corpus.

_dropped.edge: cn-npc-budget-report -> 国务院《关于实行分税制财政管理体制的决定》(国发〔1993〕85号, the 1994 tax-sharing foundational decision)
_dropped.why: REASSESSED 2026-08-13 (BRICS/G.2): the document was found and minted as `cn-statecouncil-tax-sharing-decision-1993`, and the edge is a CONFIRMED NEGATIVE. G.1 recorded it as available only as an un-OCR'd scan; a clean full-TEXT version exists and needed no OCR — though only on a provincial `.gov.cn` republication, not a State-Council-operated host, which is recorded as a standing caveat on the node. The proposed edge does not exist: the Budget Report's full text returns 0 hits for 国发. Nor does any other document in the corpus cite it — notably the 2022 equalization measures operate its 税收返还 mechanism by name (第五条（二）「…税收返还及固定补助、体制结算补助等。」) without ever naming the decision itself. No edge may be drawn on mechanism-name overlap. ORIGINAL BLOCKER, kept: The commonly-cited founding document of China's tax-sharing system, State Council 'Decision on Implementing the Tax-Sharing Fiscal Management System' (国发〔1993〕85号, dated 1993-12-15), was located in its correct container — the State Council Gazette's 1993 archive index (https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2011-11/09/content_2619445.htm, verified live) links to the scanned PDF issue (https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/shuju/1993/gwyb199331.pdf, verified downloadable, HTTP 200, 160 pages) — but that PDF is an image scan with no text layer: pdftotext extraction returned only 160 bytes of whitespace, and pdfinfo shows Producer 'CNKI®ReaderEx', consistent with a scanned reprint with no OCR text. Extracting a verbatim quote would require OCR, which was not performed this session. No other government-hosted HTML reproduction of the decision was located within the time available (gov.cn's policy-library search API ignores query parameters entirely, returning the same 'latest by date' result set regardless of the search string tried). No node is minted for this decision and its content is not summarized or assumed anywhere in this corpus — the current Budget Report's own text does not cite it by name or number either, which is the separate finding recorded below.

_dropped.edge: cn-npc-budget-report -> a standalone 预算法 (Budget Law) node
_dropped.why: RESOLVED 2026-08-13 (BRICS/G.2): 预算法 is now minted as `cn-budget-law` and the edge named in this note's endpoints is live. The deferral is closed in the strongest possible way — the Budget Law turned out to be the hub of the entire Chinese slice, cited by name and in operative voice by FOUR separate corpus documents: this Budget Report, the MOF equalization measures, the annual central final accounts, and Ningxia's provincial equalization measures. The decisive line here is operative rather than decorative, being the legal authority for spending before the NPC has approved the budget: 「根据预算法规定，预算年度开始后，在全国人民代表大会批准本预算草案前，可安排下列支出…根据上述规定，结合中央部门和地方实际支出需要，中央财政安排了部分本级支出及对地方转移支付。」 This also PARTLY CORRECTS G.1's broader finding that the Budget Report cites nothing by name — it cites 预算法 four times. G.1's neighbouring findings about 国发〔1993〕85号, the 办法 and NBS all stand and were re-verified. ORIGINAL BLOCKER, kept: The Budget Report quotes the Budget Law (预算法) as its governing framework for provisional pre-approval spending, including transfers to lower-level governments — a real, explicit citation, recorded in prose in the cn-npc-budget-report node's own description. But the Budget Law's own full text was not independently located, read, or verified this session — only this one reference to it, inside the Budget Report that cites it. Minting a Budget Law node on the strength of a citation to it, without having read the statute itself, would be exactly the kind of unverified node this corpus's evidence standard exists to prevent. Left as a lead for a future China-branch session, on the same pattern as Brazil's Budget Law counterpart (LC 101/2000) being minted only once its own articles were read directly.

Scan over 20,624 extracted characters: 国家统计局 0 hits, 统计局 0 hits, and only 3 generic hits for 统计 (「完善统计、财税、考核等制度」, 「碳排放统计核算」, 「加强财会监督和统计监督」), none naming NBS or any statistical publication. The CPI target remains stated with no attribution: 「居民消费价格涨幅2%左右」. The report does cite two documents by exact title — 《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议》 and 《中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要（草案）》 — but both are Party/national-plan instruments rather than recurring statistical or fiscal publications. This same silence was found in the PBoC's Monetary Policy Report and in the Bank of Russia's key-rate releases this round: a recurring BRICS pattern in which monetary and fiscal authorities use the national statistical office's output as ambient fact rather than as a cited source. ORIGINAL FINDING, kept: Full-text read of the 2026 Government Work Report this session found no citation of the National Bureau of Statistics (国家统计局) by name anywhere in the document, despite the CPI figures it uses being self-evidently NBS-sourced. This is a genuine NOT FOUND for an explicit inter-document citation, not an oversight — searched directly via full-text grep of the fetched document. No edge is drawn between the Government Work Report and the NBS CPI release on the strength of the shared subject matter alone; only a document naming the other would justify one, and none does.

The report names neither instrument by title or number and makes no reference to NBS or to consumer prices at all. Its only trace of the equalization mechanism is the figure 「均衡性转移支付安排28340亿元、增长3.7%」. This entry records a separate negative finding about the Budget Report's own text: full-text read of the 2026 Budget Report found it does NOT cite the 1994 tax-sharing decision by name or number, and does NOT cite the '中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法' by name anywhere — the only explicit legal citation found in the report is to 预算法 (the Budget Law). _status: NEW 2026-08-13. China's second slice, and the round that takes this branch from ZERO edges to a connected fiscal chain. `cn-cpi-transfers.json` (BRICS/G.1) minted three real nodes but drew no dependencies at all, because every candidate target hit what was recorded as a genuine access wall. Two of those three walls were misdiagnoses -- see `_note` -- and the third finding (that the Budget Report cites nothing by name) turns out to be PARTLY WRONG: it does cite the Budget Law, operatively. Nine new nodes here, organised around the hub this round identified: 中华人民共和国预算法 (the Budget Law), which is cited by name and in operative voice by four separate documents in this corpus. The chain now runs central-to-provincial: the Budget Law is cited by the MOF's equalization-transfer measures (whose full 标准财政收入/标准财政支出 formula this round recovered verbatim, closing G.1's single biggest China blocker), by the annual Budget Report, by the annual central final accounts, and by a provincial instrument -- Ningxia's own equalization measures -- which cites BOTH the Budget Law AND the central 办法 by exact title in one sentence, and then replicates the central formula. That provincial-cites-central edge is the shape BRICS/G.1's own hand-off hoped a later round would find. This file also adds China's link into this project's supranational-influence objective: 中国国民经济核算体系（2016）states in its own text that it was revised to align with the UN's System of National Accounts 2008, giving a documented edge into the existing `sna-2008` node. Three deliberate NEGATIVES are recorded rather than forced -- the PBoC's Monetary Policy Report, the Government Work Report and the Budget Report all use CPI figures without ever naming the National Bureau of Statistics, each verified by exhaustive full-text scan rather than assumed.
_note: ACCESS AND VERIFICATION. Every source in this file is TIER A -- plain curl, genuine HTTP 200, real document bytes on a government host. No rendering proxy was used, because none was available: `r.jina.ai`, this project's standing TIER B fallback, is currently behind a Cloudflare challenge and returned HTTP 403 on every attempt. THREE ACCESS DIAGNOSES THAT OVERTURN ROUND 1, all reusable: (1) `yss.mof.gov.cn` returning 502 is NOT a blanket block. It is a per-path CDN failure, and the root page serves a real 19KB document body ALONGSIDE the 502 status -- so a status-code-only check reports the host dead when it is not. Deep paths on that subdomain do genuinely fail, but the same documents are served at TIER A from `www.mof.gov.cn/zhengwuxinxi/...`, `www.mof.gov.cn/gp/xxgkml/yss/...` and `www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/...`. (2) `npc.gov.cn` fails TLS with `sslv3 alert handshake failure` but works perfectly over PLAIN HTTP. This is NOT the trust-store gap the sibling Russia research found -- `openssl s_client` shows a valid re-signed chain -- it is a ClientHello rejection, a different failure with a different fix. (3) THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT ONE, and the reason G.1 could not find the equalization formula: the State Council policy-library notice page for the 均衡性转移支付办法 contains ONLY the covering letter in its HTML body. The 办法 itself, with every formula in it, is an UNLINKED-FROM-TEXT `.docx` ATTACHMENT. It was retrieved by fetching the attachment URL directly and extracting `word/document.xml` with python's `zipfile`. A session that reads only the rendered page will conclude, correctly and uselessly, that the formulas are not there. ONE FURTHER TRAP: the official government search API at `sousuo.www.gov.cn` returns HTTP 200 with populated results, but its RANKING IGNORES THE QUERY -- searches for 分税制财政管理体制的决定 returned unrelated 2023-2026 documents. It is unusable for discovery and its 200 status makes that easy to miss. HOST CAVEAT recorded honestly: 国发〔1993〕85号 was found as clean full TEXT (no OCR needed, superseding G.1's scanned-PDF-only conclusion) but only on a PROVINCIAL `.gov.cn` republication, not on a State-Council-operated host -- treat the text as reliable and the host as secondary. Every `basis` below is this session's own read of the underlying research.

reports.title: 中华人民共和国预算法 (Budget Law of the People's Republic of China)
reports.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of the National People's Congress)
reports.description: China's foundational budget statute, and the hub of this entire slice -- four separate documents in this corpus cite it by name in operative voice, which is what promotes it from BRICS/G.1's `deferred` note to a node. Enactment and amendment history, verbatim from the NPC's own page header: 「（1994年3月22日第八届全国人民代表大会第二次会议通过　根据2014年8月31日第十二届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第十次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国预算法〉的决定》第一次修正　根据2018年12月29日第十三届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第七次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国产品质量法〉等五部法律的决定》第二次修正）」. Commencement, 第一百零一条: 「本法自1995年1月1日起施行。1991年10月21日国务院发布的《国家预算管理条例》同时废止。」 The transfer-payment article, 第十六条, quoted in full because it is the statutory basis the whole Chinese fiscal-transfer chain rests on: 「国家实行财政转移支付制度。财政转移支付应当规范、公平、公开，以推进地区间基本公共服务均等化为主要目标。财政转移支付包括中央对地方的转移支付和地方上级政府对下级政府的转移支付，以为均衡地区间基本财力、由下级政府统筹安排使用的一般性转移支付为主体。按照法律、行政法规和国务院的规定可以设立专项转移支付，用于办理特定事项。建立健全专项转移支付定期评估和退出机制。市场竞争机制能够有效调节的事项不得设立专项转移支付。上级政府在安排专项转移支付时，不得要求下级政府承担配套资金。但是，按照国务院的规定应当由上下级政府共同承担的事项除外。」 ("The State implements a fiscal transfer payment system … with equalisation of basic public services across regions as the principal objective … with general transfer payments — used to equalise basic fiscal capacity across regions and arranged at the discretion of the lower-level government — as the main body…"). Also load-bearing for the central/local architecture, 第六条: 「中央一般公共预算包括中央各部门（含直属单位，下同）的预算和中央对地方的税收返还、转移支付预算。…中央一般公共预算支出包括中央本级支出、中央对地方的税收返还和转移支付。」 Fetched TIER A over plain HTTP from the NPC's own portal (HTTPS fails on that host with a ClientHello rejection -- see `_note`); completeness verified by confirming the extracted text runs from 第一条 through 第一百零一条, all 101 articles across 11 chapters.
reports.cadence_note: A standing statute, amended rather than reissued (enacted 1994, first amended 2014, second amended 2018) -- the same convention this corpus applies to statutes elsewhere, e.g. `br-lc-62-1989` and `ru-subsistence-minimum-law-134fz`.

reports.title: 中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法 (财预〔2022〕58号) — Measures for Equalization Transfer Payments from the Central Government to Local Governments
reports.description: The document BRICS/G.1 recorded as its single biggest China blocker -- the instrument carrying the 标准财政收入 / 标准财政支出 (standard fiscal revenue / standard fiscal expenditure) formula. It was never behind the 502 wall G.1 diagnosed; it is a `.docx` attachment on a State Council policy-library page whose HTML body carries only the covering letter (see `_note`). Publication metadata verbatim from the page: 发文机关 财政部, 发文字号 财预〔2022〕58号, 成文日期 2022年04月13日, 公文种类 通知. It supersedes its own predecessor, 第十四条: 「本办法自发布之日起施行。《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》（财预〔2019〕108号）同时废止。」 A targeted check of MOF's own topic page for the series found no instrument superseding 财预〔2022〕58号 -- it is current. THE MASTER FORMULA, 第四条, verbatim: 「均衡性转移支付资金分配选取影响财政收支的客观因素，按照各地标准财政收入和标准财政支出差额及转移支付系数计算确定。其中，标准财政收入反映地方收入能力，根据工业增加值等因素及全国平均有效税率计算确定；标准财政支出旨在衡量地方支出需求，考虑人口规模、人口密度、海拔、温度、少数民族等成本差异计算确定。各地享受均衡性转移支付用公式表示为：某地区均衡性转移支付=(该地区标准财政支出-该地区标准财政收入)×该地区转移支付系数+增幅控制调整+省对下均等化努力程度奖励资金」. The eligibility rule, 第三条: 「中央财政按照测算办法，对标准财政支出大于标准财政收入的省、自治区、直辖市、计划单列市、新疆生产建设兵团（以下统称省）安排均衡性转移支付。」 The coefficient, 第七条: 「某省均衡性转移支付系数=（均衡性转移支付总额÷标准财政收支缺口总额）×权重+某省困难程度系数×权重…困难程度系数=标准化处理后（基本公共服务必保支出÷地方标准财政收入）×55%+标准化处理后（标准财政收支缺口÷标准财政支出）×45%」. The expenditure-side cost-difference coefficient, 第六条, is unusually granular, weighting population scale at 0.85 and area at 0.15 and then adjusting for remoteness, winter and summer temperature, altitude, road conditions, ethnic-minority status and poverty-alleviation status. The annual operating cycle is fixed by 第十一条: 「财政部于每年10月31日前，提前向省级财政部门下达下一年度均衡性转移支付预计数。」 ("Before 31 October each year, the Ministry of Finance shall issue in advance to provincial finance departments the estimated equalization transfer payment figures for the following year.") Fetched TIER A from `www.gov.cn`.
reports.cadence_note: A standing instrument, periodically revised (财预〔2019〕108号 superseded by 财预〔2022〕58号), which drives an ANNUAL allocation cycle stated in its own text: 「财政部于每年10月31日前，提前向省级财政部门下达下一年度均衡性转移支付预计数。」 `releases_per_year` is set to 1 for that annual cycle; the instrument itself is amended rather than reissued on a schedule.

reports.title: 自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法 — Measures for Equalization Transfer Payments from the Autonomous Region to Cities and Counties (Ningxia)
reports.publisher: 宁夏回族自治区财政厅 (Department of Finance, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region)
reports.description: A provincial-tier equalization instrument, and this round's best single find for China: it cites BOTH the Budget Law AND the central MOF measures by exact bracketed title, in one sentence, in its own operative first article -- exactly the provincial-document-citing-the-central-formula shape BRICS/G.1's hand-off hoped a later round would locate. 第一条, verbatim: 「为加快建立现代财政制度，建立权责清晰、财力协调、区域均衡的政府间财政关系，推进基本公共服务均等化，根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》，特制定自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法。」 ("…in accordance with the Budget Law of the People's Republic of China and the Measures for Equalization Transfer Payments from the Central Government to Local Governments, these Measures … are formulated.") The covering notice states it a second time: 「为进一步规范自治区对市县均衡性转移支付制度，推进基本公共服务均等化，根据《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》等有关规定，经报请自治区人民政府研究同意，自治区财政厅修订了…」 It does not merely cite the central method, it REPLICATES it, verbatim: 「某县标准收支缺口财力补助=（市县标准收入-市县标准支出）×补助系数」 -- structurally the same standard-revenue-minus-standard-expenditure-times-coefficient form as the central 第四条. Supersession, 第九条: 「本办法自印发之日起实行，《自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法》(宁财预发〔2022〕544号)不再执行。」 Publisher byline verbatim: 「宁夏回族自治区财政厅　2023年11月4日」, 来源：预算处. Fetched TIER A from the Ningxia Department of Finance's own host. NOTE ON SELECTION: Guangdong and Sichuan equivalents were searched for as the more obvious large-province examples; Ningxia was the one that surfaced with a fetchable full text on a government host. A Guangdong instrument was located at `www.gd.gov.cn` but not fetched -- a clean lead for a future round wanting a second provincial instance.
reports.cadence_note: A standing provincial instrument, periodically revised rather than reissued on a cadence -- the 2023 measures replaced 宁财预发〔2022〕544号, mirroring the central instrument's own 2019-to-2022 revision pattern.

reports.title: 国务院关于实行分税制财政管理体制的决定 (国发〔1993〕85号) — Decision of the State Council on Implementing the Tax-Sharing Fiscal Management System
reports.description: The 1994 tax-sharing decision -- the foundational instrument of China's modern central-local fiscal relationship, and a document BRICS/G.1 could locate only as an un-OCR'd scan. A clean full-TEXT version exists and no OCR was needed; G.1's scanned-PDF-only conclusion is superseded. HOST CAVEAT, recorded honestly and repeated here because it matters: the only reachable full text is a republication on a PROVINCIAL `.gov.cn` host (the Health Commission of Jilin Province), not a State-Council-operated one; `www.gov.cn/gongbao/` and `www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/` were not successfully searched for it, partly because the official government search API is relevance-broken (see `_note`). The text is reliable, the host is secondary. Effective date, verbatim: 「国务院决定，从1994年1月1日起改革现行地方财政包干体制，对各省、自治区、直辖市以及计划单列市实行分税制财政管理体制。」 THE REVENUE SPLIT, 三、（二）, verbatim in the part that matters: 「中央与地方共享收入包括：增值税、资源税、证券交易税。增值税中央分享75%，地方分享25%。资源税按不同的资源品种划分，大部分资源税作为地方收入，海洋石油资源税作为中央收入。证券交易税，中央与地方各分享50%。」 -- shared revenues are VAT (75% central / 25% local), resource tax, and securities transaction tax (50/50), alongside enumerated fixed central revenues (customs duties, consumption tax, central enterprise income tax) and fixed local revenues (business tax, local enterprise income tax, individual income tax, property tax, stamp duty, deed tax, land VAT). THE TAX-REBATE FORMULA, 三、（三）, verbatim: 「中央财政对地方税收返还数额以1993年为基期年核定。…1993年中央净上划收入，全额返还地方，保证现有地方既得财力，并以此作为以后中央对地方税收返还基数。1994年以后，税收返还额在1993年基数上逐年递增，递增率按全国增值税和消费税的平均增长率的1：0．3系数确定，即上述两税全国平均每增长1%，中央财政对地方的税收返还增长0．3%。」 -- rebates are fixed on a 1993 base year and grow at a 1:0.3 coefficient against national VAT-plus-consumption-tax growth. The decision is also where the transfer-payment concept itself originates, 一、: 「科学核定地方收支数额，逐步实行比较规范的中央财政对地方的税收返还和转移支付制度；建立和健全分级预算制度，硬化各级预算约束。」 STILL OPERATIVE: the 税收返还 line item it created appears by name inside the 2022 equalization measures (第五条（二）: 「…税收返还及固定补助、体制结算补助等。」). NO EDGE was drawn from that overlap -- see `_dropped`; the later instrument names the MECHANISM, never the DOCUMENT.
reports.cadence_note: Not a recurring release -- a one-off standing foundational instrument, effective 1 January 1994, qualifying under this corpus's rule for standing instruments that define a method (here, the revenue split and the rebate escalation formula).

reports.title: 国务院关于2025年中央决算的报告 (Report of the State Council on the 2025 Central Final Accounts)
reports.publisher: 国务院 / 财政部 (State Council / Ministry of Finance)
reports.description: The executed counterpart to `cn-npc-budget-report` -- where the Budget Report is presented to the full NPC each March, the final accounts are delivered to the NPC Standing Committee each June. Byline verbatim: 「——2026年6月23日在第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十三次会议上　财政部部长　蓝佛安　全国人民代表大会常务委员会：我受国务院委托，向全国人大常委会提出2025年中央决算报告和中央决算草案，请审查。」 It cites the Budget Law operatively as the authority for its accounting treatment: 「按照预算法和国务院有关规定，对2025年中央财政部分收支事项实行权责发生制核算，有关具体情况向全国人大常委会专门报告。」 ("In accordance with the Budget Law and relevant State Council provisions, certain central fiscal revenue and expenditure items for 2025 are accounted for on an accrual basis…"), corroborated twice more in compliance language: 「（六）坚持依法理财，自觉接受人大监督。深入贯彻预算法及其实施条例，严格落实全国人大批准的预算。」 and 「一是狠抓预算执行和政策落地。严格落实预算法等财经法律法规，加强财政支出管理。」 It also names the audit institution as a processing step: 「2025年中央一般公共预算、政府性基金预算、国有资本经营预算、社会保险基金预算的预算数、决算数及其对比分析，详见中央决算草案。草案已经审计署审计。」 ("The draft has been audited by the National Audit Office.") -- an agency-level reference with no corpus node to point at, recorded in `_dropped`. A full citation scan of the extracted text returned 3 hits for 预算法, 4 for 决算草案, and 0 for 国家统计局. Fetched TIER A from `www.mof.gov.cn`.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, delivered to the NPC Standing Committee each June -- evidenced by the year in the title and by the dated address line in the report's own byline («2026年6月23日在第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十三次会议上»). Distinct in both timing and audience from the Budget Report, which goes to the full NPC session each March.

reports.title: 中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展统计公报 (Statistical Communiqué of the People's Republic of China on National Economic and Social Development)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics)
reports.description: NBS's flagship annual communiqué, and by a distance the richest source-attribution document located anywhere in the Chinese corpus -- it carries an explicit itemised 资料来源 (Sources) block naming roughly forty supplying bodies, each in the form "X data come from Y". Masthead verbatim: 「中华人民共和国2025年国民经济和社会发展统计公报[1]　国家统计局　2026年2月28日」. Data status, verbatim endnote [1]: 「本公报中数据均为初步统计数。各项统计数据均未包括香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区和台湾省。部分数据因四舍五入的原因，存在总计与分项合计不等的情况。」 ("The data in this Communiqué are all preliminary statistics. All statistics exclude the Hong Kong SAR, the Macao SAR and Taiwan Province…"). The sources block, extract verbatim: 「资料来源：本公报中城镇新增就业、养老保险、失业保险、工伤保险、中等职业教育中的技工学校数据来自人力资源和社会保障部；外汇储备、汇率数据来自国家外汇管理局；…货物进出口数据来自海关总署；…财政数据来自财政部；减税降费及退税数据来自国家税务总局；货币金融、公司信用类债券数据来自中国人民银行；…其他数据均来自国家统计局。」 An internal note additionally pins the vintage of its fiscal figures to MOF final accounts rather than to budget figures: 「注：图中2021年至2024年数据为全国一般公共预算收入决算数，2025年为执行数。」 ("figures for 2021-2024 in the chart are final-account figures for national general public budget revenue; 2025 is the execution figure") -- which is what lets one of this file's edges point at the final-accounts node specifically rather than at the Ministry of Finance generically. The remaining ~18 attributions in the block all name ministries and agencies without titled publications and are recorded in `_dropped` rather than forced into edges. Fetched TIER A from `www.stats.gov.cn`; extracted text 56,213 characters including all 90 endnotes.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, published in late February for the preceding year (the 2025 communiqué is dated 2026年2月28日). Evidenced by NBS's own standing annual series index at `https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/tjgb/ndtjgb/qgndtjgb/index.html` (全国年度统计公报) and by the year-in-title convention.

reports.title: 中国国民经济核算体系（2016） (China's System of National Economic Accounting (2016)), 国统字〔2017〕115号
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics)
reports.description: China's standing national-accounts methodological system, and this file's contribution to the project's documented-supranational-influence objective set out in REPORTS.md: it states in its own text that it was revised specifically to align with the United Nations' System of National Accounts 2008. Verbatim: 「2009年，联合国等五大国际组织颁布了国民经济核算新的国际标准——《国民账户体系2008》（以下简称2008年SNA）。目前，绝大部分发达国家和部分发展中国家已经开始执行2008年SNA。我国国民经济核算体系也需要做出相应的修订，使之与新的国际标准相衔接，提高国际可比性。」 ("In 2009, the United Nations and four other major international organisations promulgated the new international standard for national economic accounting — the System of National Accounts 2008 … China's national economic accounting system also needs to be revised accordingly, so as to align with the new international standard and improve international comparability.") The operative opening clause states the same intent constitutively: 「为加强和改进宏观经济调控…实现与国民经济核算新的国际标准相衔接，按照党的十八届三中全会关于加快建立国家统一的经济核算制度的要求，我国对中国国民经济核算体系进行了全面系统的修订。」 Publication metadata verbatim: 文号 「国统字〔2017〕115号」, publisher line 「国家统计局　2017年7月13日」. It also cites its own State Council authorisation by document number -- 「根据《国务院关于中国国民经济核算体系（2016）的批复》（国函〔2017〕91号）精神，现将《中国国民经济核算体系（2016）》…印发给你们，请认真贯彻落实。」 -- a named instrument that was not fetched this round and is recorded as a lead in `_dropped`. Fetched TIER A from `www.stats.gov.cn`.
reports.cadence_note: A standing methodological instrument, revised generationally rather than on a cadence (the 2002 system was superseded by the 2016 system, promulgated by 国统字〔2017〕115号 in July 2017).

reports.title: 中华人民共和国统计法 (Statistics Law of the People's Republic of China)
reports.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of the National People's Congress)
reports.description: The standing statute that assigns China's statistical standard-setting authority, in its 2024 revision. 第一条 verbatim: 「为了科学、有效地组织统计工作，保障统计资料的真实性、准确性、完整性和及时性，加强统计监督，发挥统计在了解国情国力、服务经济社会高质量发展中的重要作用，推动全面建设社会主义现代化国家，制定本法。」 The methodological hook, 第十九条: 「国家制定统一的统计标准，保障统计调查采用的指标涵义、计算方法、分类目录、调查表式和统计编码等的标准化。国家统计标准由国家统计局制定，或者由国家统计局和国务院标准化主管部门共同制定。」 ("The State formulates unified statistical standards … National statistical standards are formulated by the NBS, or jointly by the NBS and the standardisation authority of the State Council.") And the national-accounts mandate that underpins `cn-nbs-national-accounts-system-2016`, 第二十条: 「国家实施统一的国民经济核算制度。国家统计局统一组织和实施地区生产总值核算工作。」 ("The State implements a unified system of national economic accounting. The NBS uniformly organises and implements the accounting of gross regional product.") MINTED WITHOUT EDGES, deliberately and with the negative recorded: this round specifically tested whether NBS's monthly CPI release cites a statutory basis and found that it does not -- see `_dropped`. The statute is a real, verified, load-bearing instrument and is minted on that basis, in line with the observation in BRICS/G.1's own hand-off that an opening round's nodes often precede the edges that will later connect them. Fetched TIER A from `www.stats.gov.cn`.
reports.cadence_note: A standing statute, amended rather than reissued; this is the 2024 revision.

reports.title: 中国货币政策执行报告 (China Monetary Policy Report)
reports.publisher: 中国人民银行货币政策分析小组 (Monetary Policy Analysis Group, People's Bank of China)
reports.description: The PBoC's quarterly monetary-policy report -- minted as a node, and notable in this corpus chiefly for a NEGATIVE that this round verified exhaustively rather than assumed. Cover byline verbatim: 「中国人民银行货币政策分析小组　2026年5月11日」. The report uses consumer price data throughout -- 「（三）居民消费价格涨幅扩大，生产价格连续回升。居民消费价格涨幅继续扩大。一季度，居民消费价格（CPI）同比涨幅为0.8%，比上季度提高0.2个百分点，月度涨幅分别为0.2%、1.3%和1.0%。…扣除食品和能源的核心CPI同比上涨1.2%…」 -- but NEVER ATTRIBUTES IT. A whitespace-stripped full-text search across all 55 pages, run twice (plain `pdftotext` and `pdftotext -layout`), returned 0 hits for 国家统计局, 0 for 统计局 and 0 for 海关总署, while all 17 occurrences of 数据来源 ("data source") resolve to 中国人民银行 or 中国货币网 and none to NBS. The dependency plainly exists in substance -- the PBoC cannot have computed the CPI itself -- but the document's own text does not name it, and under this project's evidence standard that means no edge. See `_dropped`. Fetched TIER A from `www.pbc.gov.cn`; the PDF carries a real text layer (99,241 characters extracted), so no OCR was involved.
reports.cadence_note: Quarterly. Evidenced by the edition title itself (「2026年第一季度」) and by the PBoC's own series index at `https://www.pbc.gov.cn/goutongjiaoliu/113456/113469/`, which lists one report per quarter.

dependencies.basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A. The measures name the Budget Law in their own constitutive first article: 「为加快建立现代财政制度，建立权责清晰、财力协调、区域均衡的中央和地方财政关系，推进基本公共服务均等化，根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及其实施条例，制定《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》。」 ("…in accordance with the Budget Law of the People's Republic of China and its Implementing Regulations, these Measures … are formulated.") Corroborated a second time in 第十三条: 「依照《中华人民共和国预算法》及其实施条例、《财政违法行为处罚处分条例》等国家有关规定追究相应责任。」 TENSE: 「根据 … 制定」 is present and constitutive, not a past-tense acknowledgement -- unambiguous. `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on`: the Budget Law establishes the transfer-payment system and its equalisation objective (第十六条) but supplies no calculation method; every formula in this chain is the measures' own. That is the same distinction `br-ipca-fpe.json` draws when typing `br-fpe-dn-tcu -> br-lei-8443` as `cites` while typing the formula statute as `methodology_depends_on`.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, and a correction to BRICS/G.1, which recorded that the Budget Report cites no document by name. It does cite the Budget Law, operatively -- this is the legal authority for spending before the NPC has approved the budget, not decorative compliance language: 「根据预算法规定，预算年度开始后，在全国人民代表大会批准本预算草案前，可安排下列支出：上一年度结转的支出；参照上一年同期的预算支出数额安排必须支付的本年度部门基本支出、项目支出，以及对下级政府的转移性支出；法律规定必须履行支付义务的支出，以及用于自然灾害等突发事件处理的支出。根据上述规定，结合中央部门和地方实际支出需要，中央财政安排了部分本级支出及对地方转移支付。」 ("In accordance with the provisions of the Budget Law, after the budget year begins and before the NPC approves this draft budget, the following expenditures may be arranged: … In accordance with the above provisions … the central finance authority has arranged part of its own-level expenditure and transfer payments to localities.") Corroborated in weaker compliance voice: 「认真落实预算法和人大预算审查监督有关要求」 and 「坚持预算法定，硬化预算约束，进一步全面深入实施好预算法」. A literal regex scan of the full extracted report text returned 4 hits for 预算法. TENSE: present and operative. NOTE that G.1's finding was only PARTLY wrong -- the same scan returned 0 hits for 国发, 0 for 办法 and 0 for 国家统计局, so its conclusions about the tax-sharing decision, the equalization measures and NBS all stand (see `_dropped`).

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A. The final-accounts report names the Budget Law as the authority for its accounting treatment, which is operative rather than decorative: 「按照预算法和国务院有关规定，对2025年中央财政部分收支事项实行权责发生制核算，有关具体情况向全国人大常委会专门报告。」 ("In accordance with the Budget Law and relevant State Council provisions, certain central fiscal revenue and expenditure items for 2025 are accounted for on an accrual basis, with the specific circumstances reported separately to the NPC Standing Committee.") Corroborated twice: 「深入贯彻预算法及其实施条例，严格落实全国人大批准的预算。」 and 「严格落实预算法等财经法律法规，加强财政支出管理。」 A citation scan of the full text returned 3 hits for 预算法. `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on`: the accrual treatment is authorised by the law jointly with unspecified State Council provisions, and the law is not quoted as supplying the accounting method itself.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, and the strongest single edge found for China this round. Ningxia's own first article names the central measures by exact bracketed title: 「为加快建立现代财政制度…推进基本公共服务均等化，根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》，特制定自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法。」 Restated in the covering notice: 「根据《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》等有关规定，经报请自治区人民政府研究同意，自治区财政厅修订了…」 `methodology_depends_on` rather than `cites`, because the provincial instrument does not merely reference the central one -- it REPLICATES its formula: Ningxia's own 「某县标准收支缺口财力补助=（市县标准收入-市县标准支出）×补助系数」 is structurally the central 第四条's standard-expenditure-minus-standard-revenue-times-coefficient form, re-expressed one tier down. That is genuine method inheritance, the same distinction `br-ipca-fpe.json` uses to type `br-fpe-dn-tcu -> br-lc-62-1989` as `methodology_depends_on`. TENSE: 「根据 … 特制定」 is present and constitutive.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, from the same single sentence as the edge above -- Ningxia's 第一条 names both instruments together: 「…根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》，特制定自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法。」 `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on` for the same reason as the central measures' own edge to the Budget Law: the statute establishes the transfer-payment system and its equalisation objective but supplies no calculation method. Worth recording that this makes the Budget Law's authority visible at two tiers of government from documents' own text, which is the shape this corpus exists to draw.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 根据《中华人民共和国预算法》及《中央对地方均衡性转移支付办法》，特制定自治区对市县均衡性转移支付办法。

dependencies.basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, and a documented instance of the supranational-to-national dependency REPORTS.md's own secondary objective is looking for -- a national statistical system stating, in its own text, that it was revised to conform to an international standard. Verbatim: 「2009年，联合国等五大国际组织颁布了国民经济核算新的国际标准——《国民账户体系2008》（以下简称2008年SNA）。目前，绝大部分发达国家和部分发展中国家已经开始执行2008年SNA。我国国民经济核算体系也需要做出相应的修订，使之与新的国际标准相衔接，提高国际可比性。」 ("In 2009, the United Nations and four other major international organisations promulgated the new international standard for national economic accounting — the System of National Accounts 2008 … China's national economic accounting system also needs to be revised accordingly, so as to align with the new international standard and improve international comparability.") The operative clause repeats the intent constitutively: 「实现与国民经济核算新的国际标准相衔接…我国对中国国民经济核算体系进行了全面系统的修订。」 TENSE NOTE, flagged because the sentence mixes them: the promulgation of the 2008 SNA is described in the past, but the alignment is stated in present-constitutive voice (「使之与新的国际标准相衔接」 — "so as to align it with the new international standard"), and the revision it justifies is the instrument being issued. The edge is sound on the alignment clause, not on the historical one. Unlike most China edges this round, the target is named by exact title AND edition year, so there is no version ambiguity of the kind that blocked the COICOP edge (see `_dropped`).

_dropped.edge: cn-nbs-cpi -> un-coicop-2018 (or un-coicop-hbs-1999) — the UN classification the CPI basket is built against
_dropped.why: A real, verbatim, primary-source citation of COICOP that nevertheless cannot become an edge, because it names no EDITION and this corpus carries two. NBS's own CPI methodology page states: 「具体来说，国家统计局参照联合国统计委员会《按目的划分的个人消费支出分类标准（COICOP）》及我国《居民消费支出分类》，结合全国城乡居民家庭消费支出的抽样调查资料，统一确定了"篮子"中所包含的商品和服务类别，分别是食品烟酒、衣着、居住、生活用品及服务、交通通信、教育文化娱乐、医疗保健、其他用品及服务共8个大类，268个基本分类。」 ("the NBS, referring to the UN Statistical Commission's Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) and China's own Classification of Resident Consumption Expenditure … has uniformly determined the categories … 8 major categories and 268 basic classes"). The corpus holds `un-coicop-2018` and `un-coicop-hbs-1999`; pointing at either would assert an edition the source does not state. Two further reasons for caution, recorded so a future session does not simply overrule this: the citation says 参照 ("with reference to") rather than a conformity claim, and China's 8 major categories do not map one-to-one onto COICOP's divisions, so the relationship is looser than the AF-branch cases where a national office states COICOP 2018 conformity outright. RESOLVABLE CHEAPLY: 《居民消费价格调查方案》 or 《居民消费支出分类》 would very likely name the edition. Note also the scoping question flagged by the research and left unresolved here: this methodology page may be the same source BRICS/G.1 folded into `cn-nbs-cpi`'s own description, in which case these are edges out of the existing node; if a future round decides it is separable, a `cn-nbs-cpi-methodology` node would be the cleaner home for both this and the household-survey citation below.

_dropped.edge: cn-nbs-cpi -> 全国住户收支与生活状况调查 (the NBS household survey supplying the CPI weights)
_dropped.why: A named, real input with no node to point at. NBS's CPI methodology page states it verbatim: 「在编制全国CPI时，权数资料主要根据国家统计局开展的全国住户收支与生活状况调查中城乡居民家庭消费支出资料计算，同时用其他部门的行政资料、部分典型调查和专项调查资料予以补充，并辅以专家评估进行完善。」 ("The weight data are calculated primarily from urban and rural household consumption expenditure data in the National Household Income, Expenditure and Living Conditions Survey conducted by the NBS…"). The survey is named by title but was not located as a published release this round. Worth noting the exact structural parallel in the sibling Russia slice, where Приказ Росстата № 915 names «выборочное обследование бюджетов домашних хозяйств» as its CPI weights source and hits the same wall -- two BRICS statistical offices, the same dependency shape, the same missing node.

_dropped.edge: cn-nbs-cpi -> cn-statistics-law (or any titled statutory instrument governing the CPI)
_dropped.why: NOT FOUND, tested directly rather than assumed. The monthly CPI release's own 附注 (explanatory notes) are complete and genuinely methodological -- they set out the indicator definition, the 8大类/268个基本分类 scope, and the sampling design 「数据来源于全国31个省（区、市）约500个市县、近12万家价格调查点」 -- but they name no statute and no titled instrument anywhere. The only quasi-citation is the bare, untitled phrase 「按照统计制度安排」 ("in accordance with the arrangements of the statistical system"), used to introduce the 2025 base-period rotation. That is not a document citation and no edge is drawn from it. `cn-statistics-law` is minted in this file on its own merits and is currently unconnected, which is the honest state of the evidence. DATING INCONSISTENCY worth flagging for a future round: the NBS methodology page states 「根据调查方案规定，每五年更换一次"篮子"，本轮CPI的"篮子"固定在2020年」 while the July 2026 release states the base period rotated to 2025 from January 2026 -- the two NBS pages disagree, and the release is the more recent.

_dropped.edge: cn-mof-equalization-transfer-measures -> 国家统计局 / 统计年鉴 (the NBS data behind standard fiscal revenue)
_dropped.why: AGENCY ONLY, and a class-level publication reference -- two near misses in the same instrument, neither pointing at a titled release. The agency-level citation, 第五条（一）3.: 「个人所得税标准财政收入（地方分享部分）。按照税目分别计算。其中，工资薪金所得税税基采用国家统计局提供的各地在岗职工平均工资、各地区就业人数、各地城镇居民人均可支配收入等，税率按照全国平均有效税率分类计算确定；」 ("the tax base for wage-and-salary income tax uses, as provided by the National Bureau of Statistics, each locality's average wage of employed staff, each region's number of employed persons, and each locality's per-capita disposable income of urban residents"). The class-level one, 第十条, which comes closer but stops short of a title: 「均衡性转移支付测算所需资料原则上来源于统计年鉴等公开资料和相关部门提供的数据。」 ("The materials required for calculating equalization transfer payments shall in principle come from statistical yearbooks and other publicly available materials, and from data provided by the relevant departments.") The three named series (在岗职工平均工资, 就业人数, 城镇居民人均可支配收入) are all carried in the China Statistical Yearbook and in `cn-nbs-statistical-communique`, so the natural target exists in substance -- but 「统计年鉴等」 ("statistical yearbooks etc.") is a class, not a title, and the corpus has no China Statistical Yearbook node. Minting one and re-testing this edge is a clean, high-value lead: it would connect China's fiscal chain to its statistical chain, which is currently the branch's main structural gap.

_dropped.edge: cn-nbs-statistical-communique -> 财政部 / 中国人民银行 / ~18 further ministries (the itemised 资料来源 block)
_dropped.why: AGENCY ONLY, in bulk -- the richest attribution block found anywhere in the Chinese corpus, and none of it edge-qualifying as it stands. Every clause takes the form "X数据来自Y" naming a ministry rather than a publication: 「财政数据来自财政部」, 「货币金融、公司信用类债券数据来自中国人民银行」, 「货物进出口数据来自海关总署」, 「减税降费及退税数据来自国家税务总局」, and roughly eighteen more (人力资源和社会保障部, 国家外汇管理局, 商务部, 教育部, 中国气象局, 应急管理部, 国家医疗保障局, 民政部, 国家金融监督管理总局, 中国证券监督管理委员会, 自然资源部, 生态环境部, 农业农村部, 交通运输部, 工业和信息化部, 住房和城乡建设部, 国家知识产权局), closing with 「其他数据均来自国家统计局。」 ONE OF THESE IS ALMOST RESCUABLE and is the best lead in this entry: the communiqué's own chart note pins the vintage of its fiscal figures to final accounts rather than to budget figures -- 「注：图中2021年至2024年数据为全国一般公共预算收入决算数，2025年为执行数。」 -- which points at `cn-mof-central-final-accounts` specifically rather than at the Ministry of Finance generically. It was NOT minted because the 资料来源 clause and the chart note are separate statements and joining them is inference, not citation: the note explains a chart's vintage, it does not say the communiqué draws its fiscal data from the final-accounts REPORT. A future round that finds either statement made in one breath gets the edge immediately.

NOT FOUND, and BRICS/G.1's finding on this point is CONFIRMED CORRECT rather than overturned. A literal regex scan of the full extracted Budget Report text returned 0 hits for 办法 and 0 for 财预 -- it never names the equalization measures, by title or by document number. It reports only the outcome: 「均衡性转移支付安排28340亿元、增长3.7%」 (equalization transfers of RMB 2.834 trillion, +3.7%). A figure produced by a formula is not a citation of the instrument carrying the formula, and no edge is drawn from the numeric relationship. Recorded explicitly because this round DID overturn G.1's neighbouring claim that the report cites nothing at all -- it cites the Budget Law -- and the two findings must not be collapsed into one another.

_dropped.edge: cn-npc-budget-report -> cn-statecouncil-tax-sharing-decision-1993, and any edge at all into the 1993 decision
_dropped.why: NOT FOUND in either direction, confirming BRICS/G.1. The Budget Report's full text returned 0 hits for 国发. More interestingly, the 2022 equalization measures do NOT cite it either, despite operating the mechanism it created: 第五条（二） lists 「…税收返还及固定补助、体制结算补助等。」 as a component of standard fiscal revenue, so the 1993 decision's tax-rebate line item is still live by name thirty-two years on -- but the later instrument names the MECHANISM, never the DOCUMENT. NO EDGE MAY BE DRAWN ON MECHANISM-NAME OVERLAP; that is precisely the "comparable with"-shaped inference this project's evidence standard exists to refuse. The node is minted as a genuine standing instrument with, so far, no documented inbound dependency -- an honest and slightly striking result for what is generally treated as the foundational document of Chinese fiscal federalism.

NOT FOUND, and this was the round's single most-hoped-for China edge, tested to destruction before being abandoned. A whitespace-stripped full-text search across all 55 pages of the Q1 2026 report, run twice with different extraction settings (`pdftotext` and `pdftotext -layout`), returned 0 hits for 国家统计局, 0 for 统计局 and 0 for 海关总署. All 17 occurrences of 数据来源 ("data source") in the document resolve to 中国人民银行 or 中国货币网; not one names NBS. The report nonetheless uses CPI heavily and unattributed -- 9 hits for CPI and 3 for 居民消费价格, e.g. 「一季度，居民消费价格（CPI）同比涨幅为0.8%，比上季度提高0.2个百分点」. The dependency exists in substance and cannot not exist; the document simply does not state it. This is the same shape as the Bank of Russia's key-rate releases in `ru-g2-rosstat-equalization.json`, which likewise never name Rosstat -- a recurring BRICS pattern worth watching: central banks in this branch treat the national statistical office's output as ambient fact rather than as a cited source, which is exactly the case a citation-based graph cannot represent.

NOT FOUND, re-tested this round against the authoritative State Council Gazette text and confirming BRICS/G.1. Scan results over 20,624 extracted characters: 国家统计局 0 hits, 统计局 0 hits, and only 3 generic hits for 统计 (「完善统计、财税、考核等制度」, 「碳排放统计核算」, 「加强财会监督和统计监督」), none naming NBS or any statistical publication. The CPI target is stated with no attribution whatever: 「今年发展主要预期目标是：经济增长4.5%—5%…居民消费价格涨幅2%左右」 and 「居民消费价格涨幅2%左右，考虑了预期引导和现实可能，我们将通过改善总供求关系，推动价格总水平由负转正、消费价格合理温和回升，促进经济良性循环。」 The report does cite two documents by exact title -- 《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议》 and 《中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要（草案）》 -- but these are Party and national-plan instruments rather than recurring statistical or fiscal publications, and are noted here rather than pursued.

NOT FOUND, judged too weak rather than merely unlocated. The final-accounts report is by construction the executed counterpart to the budget the Budget Report presents, and it does refer to 「十四届全国人大三次会议审查批准的预算」 ("the budget examined and approved by the third session of the 14th NPC") -- but that names the BUDGET INSTRUMENT approved by the legislature, not the REPORT DOCUMENT this corpus carries as `cn-npc-budget-report`. A scan for 预算草案的报告 as a titled citation returned 0 hits. The distinction is exactly the one this project's scope rule turns on -- a node is a document, and a reference to the thing a document describes is not a reference to the document -- so no edge is drawn.

AGENCY ONLY. The final-accounts report names the audit institution as a processing step its own draft passed through: 「2025年中央一般公共预算、政府性基金预算、国有资本经营预算、社会保险基金预算的预算数、决算数及其对比分析，详见中央决算草案。草案已经审计署审计。」 ("…see the draft central final accounts. The draft has been audited by the National Audit Office.") It names an agency and an act of auditing, not a titled audit publication, and the corpus has no 审计署 node. The National Audit Office publishes a recurring annual audit report on central budget execution which would be a strong node in its own right and would likely close this -- a clean lead for a future China round, and one that would give this branch its accountability tier, which the AF and EU branches both have.

_dropped.edge: 《中华人民共和国2025年全国预算执行情况2026年全国预算（草案）》 as a node (the Budget Report's detail annex)
_dropped.why: Cited TWICE by exact bracketed title in the Budget Report as the place the underlying detail lives -- 「以上预算执行的具体情况及相关说明见《中华人民共和国2025年全国预算执行情况2026年全国预算（草案）》。」 and 「预算具体安排及相关说明见《中华人民共和国2025年全国预算执行情况2026年全国预算（草案）》。」 -- and an annually published companion volume, so it would qualify as a recurrent node. No free-standing URL was located this round; the volume is tabled at the NPC session rather than published as a discrete web document. Not minted, because this corpus requires a node to have a URL of its own rather than existing solely on the strength of a citing document. This is the best-evidenced missing node in the Chinese corpus: the citation is exact, doubled, and by title.

_dropped.edge: 《居民消费价格调查方案》 and 国函〔2017〕91号 as nodes
_dropped.why: Two instruments named by exact title in documents this file mints, neither retrievable this round. (1) 《居民消费价格调查方案》 (Consumer Price Survey Scheme) is named as the governing instrument for the CPI's scope and calculation method: 「中国CPI编制工作由国家统计局组织实施。国家统计局负责全国CPI的编制及相关工作，制定《居民消费价格调查方案》，对CPI的统计范围、计算方法、统计口径和填报目录等作出统一规定…」. It could not be fetched; the related 流通消费价格调查制度 page returned a hard 404 (555 bytes). Finding it would give `cn-nbs-cpi` the governing-instrument edge that the monthly release's bare 「按照统计制度安排」 cannot support. (2) 国函〔2017〕91号, the State Council reply approving the 2016 national accounting system, is cited by number inside that system's own promulgation notice: 「根据《国务院关于中国国民经济核算体系（2016）的批复》（国函〔2017〕91号）精神…」. Not fetched this round.

meta.source: research round 2026-09-09 (round 36) — Hunan minted and wired; Fujian unreadable; the minting run's real yield
meta.note: First round of the provincial minting run (8 probed-and-nodeless provinces). ONE province landed. THE FINDING: 'the host answers a probe' is a much weaker signal than the tracker's 200s imply — every one of the eight answers on some scheme, and that says nothing about whether the yearbook is locatable or readable. Two distinct new failure modes were found in one round and both are recorded in _dropped. HUNAN'S ROUTE IS THE REUSABLE PART: nothing under tjj.hunan.gov.cn serves the yearbook. Its own landing page for 湖南统计年鉴2025 carries no link in the HTML curl sees, and CLIENT-SIDE navigates a browser to http://222.240.193.190/2025tjnj/zk/indexch.htm — the yearbook is served from a BARE IP, in the same FrontPage frameset shape as Shandong and Xi'an. Reproduced twice in Chrome. That is why three curl-based path guesses found nothing: no hostname path exists to find. **When a provincial yearbook cannot be located by path, open the edition's landing page in a browser and watch where it goes.** A TRAP WORTH THE ROUND: this edge first graded **B on reason `inferred`** — not because of the document, but because the BASIS PROSE below originally contained the sentence "the edition is stated, not inferred". `WEAK_BASIS_PATTERNS` matches the word on the basis text and has no notion of negation, exactly as the quote guard has none, so saying an edge is NOT inferred capped it at B. Reworded and it graded A `quote-found-artefact-named` with nothing else changed. **Do not use the guard's own trigger words in a basis, even to deny them** — consistent with, comparable to, aligned with, presumably, likely, appears to, seems to, suggests that, implies, inferred, inference, by implication, paraphrase. Hunan also names its chapter notes zbNN.pdf (主要统计指标解释), not smNN.pdf — the filename convention is per-province, so glob for *.pdf under the frameset's html/ rather than assuming sm.

reports.title: Hunan Statistical Yearbook (湖南统计年鉴)

Fujian's yearbook was found cleanly — 福建统计年鉴2025 at https://tjj.fujian.gov.cn/tongjinianjian/dz2025/zk/indexch.htm, the same frameset shape as Shandong, with 21 chapter notes at html/smNN.pdf. The cause is the font structure — the only /Subtype values are Type1 and XML, there is **no /ToUnicode map anywhere in the file**, and poppler additionally errors on a malformed /OCProperties. Chinese text drawn from a custom-encoded Type1 font with no Unicode mapping cannot be extracted by any parser; it would need OCR, which caps at B. Contrast Hunan and Shandong, whose notes use CID TrueType Identity-H with uni=yes and extract cleanly — and note the SAME /OCProperties error appears on Hunan's files, which extract fine, so **that error is a red herring and not the diagnosis**. meta.note: Opens the China seam. The China Statistical Yearbook and every provincial yearbook put a 简要说明 (Brief Introduction) at the head of each chapter whose stated purpose is to disclose that chapter's data sources, scope and method, and it names the NBS instruments BY TITLE. reports.title: 国民经济行业分类 (Industrial Classification for National Economic Activities), GB/T 4754-2017
reports.publisher: 中国国家标准化管理委员会 (Standardization Administration of China)
reports.description: China's mandatory national standard for classifying economic activity, GB/T 4754-2017, replacing GB/T 4754-2011. Proposed by the National Bureau of Statistics (本标准由国家统计局提出) and issued 2017-06-30, effective 2017-10-01. Its own 前言 states it was drafted by the redrafting method with reference to the UN Statistical Commission's ISIC Rev.4, records its degree of correspondence to ISIC Rev.4 as 非等效 (NEQ, non-equivalent), and carries a full ISIC concordance as 附录 G. It is the classification every Chinese statistical yearbook, national and provincial, declares its industry breakdowns follow, which makes it the hub through which China's subnational statistics reach an international standard.
reports.cadence_note: Not a periodic release. A standing national standard revised roughly every 6-10 years: 1984, 1994, 2002, 2011, 2017, plus 第1号修改单 (Amendment 1) incorporated in the 2025 reissue read for this round.
