meta.source: research round 2026-09-09 (round 37) — the CN provincial minting run finished: five provinces minted, two NBS standard hubs minted, five edges
meta.note:
SECOND AND LAST ROUND OF THE PROVINCIAL MINTING RUN. Round 36 left seven provinces with no node (Hubei, Yunnan, Fujian, Xinjiang, Jilin, Xizang, Hainan). Five now have one. THE ONE FINDING THAT PAYS FORWARD: **a small body is a JS redirect — READ IT.** Round 36 recorded Hubei's /tjsj/sjkscx/tjnj/ as 'HTTP 200 with a 71-BYTE body, an empty shell' and stopped there. The 71 bytes are ``, and that directory is the yearbook listing — fifteen editions of it. The same shape then turned up twice more in one round: Xinjiang's /tjj/tjsj/jump.shtml is a 954-byte shell carrying `

/tjj/zhhvgh/list_nj1.shtml

` in a display:none div, and NBS's own /sj/tjbz/ is a 625-byte shell redirecting to ./gjtjbz/ — the national statistical-standards listing, which is where both hubs minted here came from. Round 36's Hunan lesson (open the landing page in Chrome and watch the address bar) was right about the SYMPTOM and expensive about the cure: three of these four were solved by reading the body. **Curl the shell and cat it before reaching for a browser.** SECOND FINDING, and it cost a code change: the grader's zip branch walked html/txt/csv/md ONLY, so a yearbook shipped as a zip of .docx chapter notes extracted to NOTHING. Hubei ships 21 `第N章指标解释.docx`; Yunnan ships 18 `主要指标解释.docx` plus the whole 512-page book as one PDF; neither publishes them at any other URL, so Thomas's 2026-09-08 ruling that a first-party zip IS a direct read could not actually be exercised on either. `extractZipDocs` in scripts/grade-evidence.ts now takes a second pass over .docx and .pdf entries AFTER the existing markup pass, so the byte budget is spent in the old order first and every already-committed zip record (Guangdong's CD edition is the one that exists) extracts byte-for-byte what it did before — the new pass can only add text, never displace it, which is what keeps it from writing a grade down. THIRD: the 编者说明 / 简要说明 / 主要统计指标解释 distinction is a red herring, and what matters is only that SOME per-chapter prose exists. Hubei, Yunnan and Jilin all publish 指标解释 (indicator definitions) rather than 简要说明 (chapter scope notes), and the GB/T 4754 sentence sits in the 综合 chapter's 指标解释 in both Hubei and Jilin — word for word the same sentence Hunan carries in its zb01. FOURTH: filename conventions are per-province yet again. Jilin names its chapter notes `ml/zbjsN.html` — 19 of them, chapter 20 having none — which is neither Shandong's `smNN.pdf` nor Hunan's `zbNN.pdf`. Glob, never assume. NOT MINTED: Xizang and Hainan, both in _dropped with what was actually established rather than 'not found'.

reports.title: Hubei Statistical Yearbook (湖北统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Hubei Province, a 58-million-person central-China economy. Published as a first-party zip archive of per-chapter Excel tables with one 指标解释 (explanation of indicators) document per chapter — 21 chapters in the 2025 edition, and that is where its methodology disclosures sit. It carries no 编者说明 at all. The publisher's own listing runs back to the 2011 edition (2013-2023 as .rar, 2012 and 2024-2025 as .zip). Its capital Wuhan has a separate city-yearbook node that is already wired, and the two publish quite differently.
reports.cadence_note: One edition per reference year. The 2025 edition's zip was last modified 2026-01-14 and sits under a 202601 path; the 2024 edition sits under 202501 and the 2023 edition under 202402, so publication is January-ish with at least one edition slipping later. Read 2026-09-09.

reports.title: Yunnan Statistical Yearbook (云南统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Yunnan Province, a 47-million-person south-western border economy. Published as a first-party zip holding the whole 512-page book as one InDesign-produced PDF, a table-of-contents PDF, per-chapter Excel tables, and per-chapter 主要指标解释 documents in Chinese and in English — 18 chapters in the 2025 edition. Its methodology disclosures sit in those 指标解释 documents and in the notes under individual tables, both of which are bilingual. The listing runs back to the 2010 edition alongside the 2020 population-census and 2023 economic-census yearbooks.
reports.cadence_note: One edition per reference year, published in the first half of the following year: the 2025 edition's landing page is dated 2026-05-07, the 2024 edition 2025-05-23, the 2023 edition 2024-03-29. Read 2026-09-09.

reports.title: Jilin Statistical Yearbook (吉林统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Jilin Province, a 24-million-person north-eastern economy, published bilingually (中英文对照). Served as a FrontPage-era frameset per edition — an enter page, then a left TOC frame and a right content frame — with 20 chapters of HTML tables and a per-chapter 主要统计指标解释 at ml/zbjsN.html; there are 19 of those, chapter 20 (市州和县市概况) having none. Its 编者说明 at ml/sm.htm names no instrument, which is the ordinary case. The publisher's own section carries every edition from 2011 to 2025.
reports.cadence_note: One edition per reference year; the section lists 2011 through 2025 as one directory each, with no dated landing page to read a publication month from. Read 2026-09-09.

reports.title: Fujian Statistical Yearbook (福建统计年鉴)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of Fujian Province, a 42-million-person coastal economy. Served as a frameset in the same shape as Shandong's, with 21 chapter notes at html/smNN.pdf. MINTED WITHOUT EDGES ON PURPOSE: the yearbook is located and fetchable but its text cannot be extracted by any parser — the chapter-note PDFs carry only Type1 fonts and no /ToUnicode map anywhere in the file, so the Chinese has no Unicode mapping at all (established round 36; the full diagnosis is in cn-hunan-2026-09-09.json's _dropped). The publication is real and first-party and only its machine-readability fails; OCR would cap any edge off it at B.
reports.cadence_note: One edition per reference year; the 2025 edition is served under a dz2025 path. No dated landing page was read, so no publication month is claimed. Read 2026-09-09.

reports.title: Xinjiang Statistical Yearbook (新疆统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: Statistics Bureau of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, a 26-million-person north-western economy. Published on the bureau's own site as per-chapter HTML listings of individual tables — 22 chapter sections, including 各地州市主要经济指标排序 and 各省市区主要经济指标排序 — reached through a JS redirect shell rather than a link. MINTED WITHOUT EDGES: the online presentation is tables only, with no 简要说明 or 指标解释 page under any chapter, so nothing on the bureau's site names an instrument. Note also that the newest edition served online is the 2021 one, its table pages dated March 2022; the print series continues past it.
reports.cadence_note: One edition per reference year in print. Online publication lags badly: the newest edition on the bureau's own site is 2021, with table pages dated March 2022. Read 2026-09-09.

reports.title: 统计上大中小微型企业划分办法（2017） (Measures for Classifying Large, Medium, Small and Micro Enterprises for Statistical Purposes (2017))
title_aliases: 统计上大中小微型企业划分办法
统计上大中小微型企业划分办法(2017)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS measure that decides which enterprises count as large, medium, small and micro in Chinese official statistics, by industry, headcount, operating revenue and total assets. Issued 2017-12-28 as a revision of the 2011 measure, re-cut against the 2017 edition of the industrial classification. After the industrial classification itself it is one of the most frequently named instruments in Chinese yearbooks — the national, Jiangsu and Yunnan yearbooks all name it by title.
reports.cadence_note: Not a recurring release. Issued once and revised when the industrial classification underneath it is: the 2011 measure was superseded by this 2017 one.

reports.title: 关于市场主体统计分类的划分规定 (Provisions on the Statistical Classification of Market Entities)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The joint NBS / State Administration for Market Regulation rule fixing the registration-type categories market entities are counted under in official statistics — state-owned, collective, private, Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan-invested, foreign-invested and the rest. Issued 2023-01-31 as 国统字〔2023〕14号, revising the 2011 provisions on enterprise registration types (国统字〔2011〕86号). Provincial yearbooks cite it in the notes under their legal-person unit tables.
reports.cadence_note: Not a recurring release. Issued once, revising the 2011 provisions it replaced.

dependencies.basis: SELF-DECLARED: the 综合 chapter's 指标解释 states that from the 2017 annual report and the 2018 periodic returns onward the yearbook uses the new 《国民经济行业分类》, and gives the edition by its standard number in the same sentence — 自2017年年报和2018年定期报表开始使用新的《国民经济行业分类》(GB/T 4754-2017) — then repeats title-plus-number when giving the revision's structure (20 门类, 97 大类, 473 中类, 1382 小类). A NOTE ON THE ROUTE ITSELF: the grader's zip branch walked html/txt/csv/md only and therefore read this archive as empty; it now takes a second pass over .docx and .pdf entries, added this round. HOW THE ARCHIVE WAS FOUND: the bureau's own 统计年鉴 link returns a 71-byte body, and those 71 bytes are a JS redirect to ./qstjnj/ — round 36 recorded the byte count without reading the content. NOT WIRED from the same sentence, deliberately: it also names 《全部经济活动的国际标准产业分类》(ISIC/Rev.4), but only to say what GB/T 4754 was revised against, which is the existing cn-gbt-4754-2017 edge restated by a third document rather than a Hubei dependency.

_dropped.why: XIZANG / TIBET — NOT MINTED 2026-09-09, and this is an ANSWER rather than a time-out. The bureau's own homepage (tjj.xizang.gov.cn) carries four data sections — 最新发布, 统计信息, 统计数据, 统计公报 — and no yearbook section at all. The 统计年鉴 label round 36 saw is an HTML COMMENT: the markup reads 统计数据, a commented-out placeholder left over from the template the site was built from, which is why it looked like a javascript:; stub. /xxgk/tjxx/ itself returns no links. There is therefore nothing on the issuing bureau's site to mint a node against and the §7c bar is not met. Re-openable if the bureau publishes a yearbook section, or against the autonomous region's own government portal.

HAINAN — NOT MINTED 2026-09-09, and the lead is live and specific. The BUREAU site (stats.hainan.gov.cn) publishes only its 经济普查年鉴2023 — the economic census yearbook, a different publication — at /tjj/2023hnnj/indexce.htm; its 年度数据 section at /tjj/tjsu/ndsj/ returns no entries, and /tjj/tjnj/ 302s to 404.html. Six sibling-directory guesses in the census yearbook's own style all 302'd to 404. BUT the PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT portal carries a 统计年鉴 listing at https://www.hainan.gov.cn/hainan/tjnj/list3.shtml, and that is where the next round should start. It was not readable this round: 503 to the cloud container over both schemes across four retries, unreachable from the device VM (whose egress does not reach .gov.cn at all), and Chrome would not hold the navigation — the tab reverted to newtab twice. That is a claim about three machines on one day, not about the site.

YUNNAN NAMES NO INDUSTRIAL-CLASSIFICATION EDITION — searched 2026-09-09, and this is the answer rather than a gap. Round 36 recorded this pair in cn-hunan-2026-09-09.json as unreadable-source on the grounds that the yearbook had not been located. It has now been located, downloaded and read in full — 18 chapter 指标解释 documents plus the whole 512-page book — and it names the classification only as 执行新的国民经济行业分类标准 in the 农业和农村 chapter, with no 《》 and no GB/T number. That is the ordinary §7a refusal: naming a standard generically does not name the artefact, and supplying the 2017 edition ourselves is exactly the inference the corpus does not make. Yunnan IS wired to two other instruments this round, off citations that do carry titles.

(1) 《中国统计摘要》 — Yunnan's table note 注：本表全国数据主要来自《中国统计摘要(2024)》 is the first citation found that says a yearbook takes DATA from it rather than merely pointing readers at it, and it carries an edition year; four yearbooks now name it (national, Jiangsu, Shandong, Yunnan) and NBS still has no landing page for it. (2) 《统计用产品分类目录》 — Yunnan's agriculture chapter; NBS HAS a section for it at /sj/tjbz/tjypflml/, so this one is mintable the moment a round wants it. (3) 《关于统计上划分城乡的规定（试行）》（国统字[1999]114号） — Yunnan's population table note. NBS's listing carries a 统计上划分城乡的规定 page (t20230213_1902742.html), but that is the LATER measure without 试行: do NOT wire the 1999 trial version to it, this is the same trap as the three different 农业产值 titles. (4) 《三次产业划分规定》 — Jilin, bare with no year; NBS has two pages and the Jilin edge's basis says why neither was picked. (5) Cross-ministry instruments each needing their own publisher's page: 《全国文化文物和旅游统计调查制度》 (Yunnan, MCT), 《广播电视人口覆盖率统计技术标准和方法》 (Hubei, NRTA), 《对外承包工程管理条例》 (Hubei, MOFCOM), 《公路工程技术标准》 (Hubei and Yunnan, at two different vintages — JTJ 01-88 and JTG B01-2003 — so read the number before wiring). AND THE PORTAL THAT MAKES SEVERAL OF THESE CHEAP: NBS's 国家统计标准 listing at https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/ (three pages — index_1.html and index_2.html carry the rest) has a landing page per standard: 三次产业划分规定, 统计上划分城乡的规定, 统计单位划分及具体处理办法, 文化及相关产业分类, 高技术产业（制造业/服务业）分类, 战略性新兴产业分类, 数字经济及其核心产业统计分类, 节能环保清洁产业统计分类, 农业及相关产业统计分类, and more. It is the 统计标准 counterpart of the 统计制度 listing at /sj/tjzd/ that round 30 found, and it was not in the tracker's portal section.

meta.source: research round 2026-09-09 (round 38) — the two hub nodes minted in round 37 re-swept against yearbooks already read, plus the national yearbook's SECOND chapter-note layer, which no earlier round had opened
meta.note: THE FINDING THAT PAYS FORWARD: **the national yearbook publishes TWO per-chapter note layers and every round so far read only one.** left.htm lists html/smNN.htm (简要说明, 29 of them) AND html/zbNN.pdf (主要统计指标解释, 27 of them). The tracker's portal section names only the smNN.htm layer, and all 21 live edges off the national yearbook cite either that layer or the bare /sj/ndsj/ index. The zb layer was fetched and swept in full this round for the first time and it names eleven 《》-titled instruments the sm layer does not, two of which have an NBS landing page and are minted here. The lesson generalises past China: a yearbook that publishes 简要说明 may ALSO publish 指标解释 under a different filename in the same frameset, and round 37 already found the reverse (Hubei, Yunnan and Jilin publish 指标解释 and no 简要说明 at all). Read left.htm's whole href list, not the pattern you expected. SECOND: the zb PDFs are two-column, and pdftotext without -layout interleaves the columns mid-title — 《文化及相关产业分类管理（经部门审批并领取营业性演出许可证），有观众席、(2018)》 is two columns spliced, not a title. Run both renderings before reading a title as garbled. THIRD, and it is the round-37 re-sweep HANDOFF §3 asked for: cn-nbs-sme-classification-2017 was named by title in the national and Jiangsu yearbooks all along and only Yunnan was wired to it; both are wired here off documents already fetched in earlier rounds. NOT DONE: the same re-sweep against Shandong, Wuhan and Xi'an — their chapter notes were swept in rounds 31/35 and none of the recorded 《》 titles is either hub, so there is nothing to re-read there.

reports.title: 文化及相关产业分类（2018） (Classification of Culture and Related Industries (2018))
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS standard fixing which industrial activities count as cultural for statistical purposes, cut against the 2017 edition of the industrial classification. Issued 2018-05-09 as a revision of the 2012 classification. It is what decides the scope of the 规模以上文化制造业企业 and 规模以上文化服务业企业 populations the national yearbook's culture chapter reports on, and the yearbook says so in its own indicator definitions. The landing page carries the classification itself as an attached .doc.
reports.cadence_note: Not a recurring release. Issued once and revised when the industrial classification underneath it is: the 2012 classification was superseded by this 2018 one. Landing page dated 2018-05-09, read 2026-09-09.

reports.title: 统计用产品分类目录 (Product Classification Catalogue for Statistical Purposes)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS catalogue that names and codes the products Chinese official statistics count output in, chapter by chapter — agricultural products, forestry products, farmed animals, fishery products, mined products, manufactured goods and services. Published on the bureau's own site as one section per chapter under a 2010 path. It is the product-side counterpart of GB/T 4754, which classifies the industries rather than what they make, and it is what the national yearbook says it applied when it revised its 2009 agricultural and forestry output values.
reports.cadence_note: Not a recurring release. The edition served on the bureau's site sits under a 2010 path and NBS publishes no later one; the national yearbook dates its own application of it to 2010. Read 2026-09-09.

meta.note: ROUND 40. THREE FINDINGS AND ONE CORRECTION OF A RULING MADE THE DAY BEFORE. (1) **THE zb SECOND LAYER IS NOT A NATIONAL-YEARBOOK QUIRK — Shandong, Xi'an and Fujian all publish one, and nobody had fetched any of them.** Round 38 found the national yearbook's left.htm listing html/smNN.htm AND html/zbNN.pdf side by side and swept the zb layer for the first time; its own meta then said of Shandong, Wuhan and Xi'an that 'their chapter notes were swept in rounds 31/35 and none of the recorded 《》 titles is either hub, so there is nothing to re-read there.' That was wrong, and the way it was wrong is the lesson: it re-checked the TITLES ALREADY RECORDED instead of re-reading the TOC to see whether a whole layer had gone unopened. Shandong's left.htm lists 21 zbNN.pdf beside the 25 smNN.pdf round 35 swept (plus three w25NN.pdf appendix files); Xi'an's lists 22 beside 22; Fujian's lists 19 beside 21. **Re-read left.htm's href list for every yearbook already 'done'** — the question is not what the notes said, it is which files were never fetched. (2) **《关于工资总额组成的规定》 IS AN NBS INSTRUMENT AND ROUND 38 FILED IT UNDER THE WRONG PUBLISHER.** Round 38 listed it among 'EIGHT [that] NEED A NON-NBS PUBLISHER'S OWN PAGE FOUND', which is why nobody looked on stats.gov.cn. It is 国家统计局令第1号, approved by the State Council 1989-09-30 and issued by NBS on 1990-01-01, and NBS publishes its full text. Minted here and wired to THREE independent yearbooks. **And finding it exposed a THIRD NBS listing the method file does not name**: `https://www.stats.gov.cn/zs/flfg/tjlydnfghflfg/` (统计领域的法规), alongside the known 统计制度 (`/sj/tjzd/`) and 统计标准 (`/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/`) listings. It carries 15 instruments including 全国人口普查条例, 全国经济普查条例 and 中华人民共和国统计法实施条例 — two of which are standing nodeless leads. (3) **A PROVINCIAL BUREAU PUBLISHES A 年定报制度目录 — A CATALOGUE OF EVERY REPORTING SYSTEM IT ADMINISTERS, ONE LANDING PAGE AND ONE FIRST-PARTY PDF EACH.** Shanghai's is at `/ndbzdml/index.html`, 20 instruments for the 2025 年报/2026 定报 cycle. This is a new portal SHAPE, not a Shanghai fact: it is where a province's instruments live, and it is what finally produced pages for the two hubs below. **THE CORRECTION, AND IT OVERTURNS ROUND 39's HEADLINE RULE.** Round 39 read Shanghai's yearbook saying 上海市统计局制定的《固定资产投资统计报表制度》 and 上海市统计局制定的《房地产开发统计报表制度》, concluded these were 'Shanghai's own instruments wearing NBS's titles', dropped both as `wrong-target`, and wrote the rule AUTHORSHIP INSIDE THE SENTENCE DECIDES THE TARGET into PLAYBOOK-CORPUS §7a. **The instruments themselves say otherwise.** Both covers, read this round from the bureau's own catalogue, read 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制 — NBS formulated; Shanghai supplemented and printed. So do the covers of 建筑业统计报表制度 and 劳动工资统计报表制度, which round 39 DID wire to NBS nodes off 国家统计局制定的. The corpus was therefore treating four identically-authored instruments two different ways, and the yearbook's own prose is simply loose about which bureau 制定 the local edition it used. Thomas ruled 2026-09-09: wire both to the NBS nodes. The two round-39 `_dropped` entries are rewritten `resolved` in place. **What survives of round 39's rule, and it is worth keeping:** a sentence naming an issuer is still the thing to read, and a provincial instrument with a national title is still a real category — Shanghai's catalogue proves it, because the entries whose titles carry 上海市 (上海市核算综合统计报表制度, 上海市建设领域基本信息综合统计报表制度) say 上海市统计局制定 or 上海市统计局印制 with no NBS line at all. **The catalogue splits exactly along the title prefix.** What does NOT survive is inferring the issuer from the yearbook's sentence when the instrument itself is one fetch away. Read the instrument, not the citation, before recording a look-alike. **THE TWO TRADE HUBS ARE MINTED, after being named by four independent yearbooks across eleven rounds with no page ever found.** 《批发和零售业统计报表制度》 and 《住宿和餐饮业统计报表制度》 have been the standing parked lead since round 29 — named by the national, Guangdong, Shandong and Shanghai yearbooks, absent from NBS's 统计制度 listing and from round 30's article-id probe past its truncation. Shanghai's catalogue carries both, and both covers read 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制. Thomas ruled 2026-09-09: mint both off that edition, on rule 19's principle that authorship decides, not host. **ROUTE CAVEAT, recorded because the node URLs are not the issuer's own site:** each node is cited to its Shanghai landing page, which is first-party to a statistical bureau and carries the full instrument as a PDF attachment, but no NBS-hosted page for either has ever been found and this round did not find one either. If one turns up, move the URL and keep the node. **NOT DONE, and cheap:** Guangdong's yearbook names both hubs too and would be a fifth and sixth edge each, but it ships only as the CD zip and was not opened this round. Jiangsu's ch14 names them as well. Xi'an's zb21 names 《广播电视人口覆盖率统计技术标准和方法》 and its zb12/zb18 name 《小企业会计准则》 (MOF) — both nodeless, the first now with three independent citations. Fujian's zb layer was fetched and is **as unextractable as its sm layer** — 1-page iText wrappers with no font table and no image list, zero characters out of all five tested; the round-37 verdict stands for both layers and nobody should re-probe it.

reports.title: 关于工资总额组成的规定 (Provisions on the Composition of Total Wages)
title_aliases: 关于工资总额组成的规定
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The standing NBS instrument that defines what counts as 工资总额 (total wages) for every Chinese statistical and accounting return — approved by the State Council on 1989-09-30 and issued by the National Bureau of Statistics as 国家统计局令第1号 on 1990-01-01, effective from the date of issue. 第四条 fixes the six components (计时工资, 计件工资, 奖金, 津贴和补贴, 加班加点工资, 特殊情况下支付的工资) and 第二条 binds every enterprise, institution, joint venture, state organ, party organ and social organisation to it in their planning, statistical and accounting treatment of the wage bill. It is the definitional hub behind the employment-and-wage chapter of the national yearbook and of the provincial and city yearbooks, which cite it by title where they define 工资总额, and it is why those series are comparable across the whole system. Distinct from 《劳动工资统计报表制度》 (cn-nbs-wage-reporting-system), which is the annually reissued COLLECTION instrument; this is the standing definition the collection applies.
reports.cadence_note: A standing ministerial provision, in force unamended since 1990-01-01 rather than reissued on a cycle. The NBS page read for this round is the 2025 republication of the same text.

reports.title: 批发和零售业统计报表制度 (Wholesale and Retail Trade Statistical Reporting System)
title_aliases: 批发和零售业统计报表制度
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system governing China's wholesale and retail trade statistics — the instrument behind the 限额以上 (above-threshold) reporting units, the commodity-turnover and financial-position tables, the retail chain returns and the total retail sales of consumer goods that the national, provincial and municipal yearbooks all publish. The national yearbook's own chapter note sets the thresholds it implements: annual principal business revenue of 20 million yuan and above for a wholesale unit, 5 million and above for a retail unit. Reissued annually alongside the periodic reporting forms. FOUR independent yearbooks name it by title — the national, Guangdong, Shandong and Shanghai ones — which is why it is minted; NO NBS-HOSTED PAGE HAS EVER BEEN FOUND for it, on the 统计制度 listing or past that listing's truncation, so the node is cited to the Shanghai bureau's own catalogue entry, whose attached PDF carries the cover line 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制. Move the URL if an NBS-hosted page turns up.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually, covering one statistical year's annual report and the following year's periodic reporting forms; the edition read for this round covers the 2025 annual report and the 2026 periodic forms.

reports.title: 住宿和餐饮业统计报表制度 (Accommodation and Catering Statistical Reporting System)
title_aliases: 住宿和餐饮业统计报表制度
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system governing China's accommodation and catering statistics — the basic-condition, operating and financial tables for above-threshold accommodation and catering legal-person enterprises and self-employed operators, and the catering chain-headquarters returns. The national yearbook's chapter note gives the threshold it implements: annual principal business revenue of 2 million yuan and above. The twin of cn-nbs-wholesale-retail-reporting-system, issued and reissued alongside it, and named in the same sentence by the Shandong and Shanghai yearbooks. Minted on the same basis and with the same caveat: four independent yearbooks name it, no NBS-hosted page has ever been found, and the node is cited to the Shanghai bureau's catalogue entry whose attached PDF reads 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制 on its cover.

Round 39 read this sentence's 上海市统计局制定的 and dropped the edge `wrong-target`, reasoning that Shanghai had its own instrument wearing NBS's title. reports.title: 全国农业普查条例 (Regulations on the National Agricultural Census)
reports.publisher: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The State Council regulation governing China's decennial agricultural census, promulgated in August 2006. It fixes the census on a ten-year cycle in years ending in 6, sets the standard reference point at 24:00 on 31 December of the census year, and defines the census objects (rural households, urban agricultural production households, agricultural production and operation units, villagers' committees and township governments) and its industry scope (crop cultivation, forestry, animal husbandry, fishery and agricultural support activities). Three censuses have been run under or ahead of it — 1996, 2006 and 2016. It is the instrument provincial and national yearbooks name when they explain why their agricultural series were revised on census results rather than carried forward from annual returns. NBS publishes an authoritative account of its main provisions on its own 重大国情国力普查条例 listing, alongside 全国人口普查条例 and 全国经济普查条例; that page is the URL cited here. NODE CAVEAT: the issuing body is the State Council, not NBS, and the cited page is NBS's 主要内容 exposition rather than the promulgated text — move the URL if a gov.cn full-text page is located.
reports.cadence_note: A standing State Council regulation in force since 2006, not reissued on a cycle; the census it governs runs once every ten years in years ending in 6.

reports.title: 三次产业划分规定（2012） (Provisions on the Division of the Three Industrial Sectors (2012))
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS provision that assigns every 国民经济行业分类 (GB/T 4754) category to the primary, secondary or tertiary sector — the rule behind every 三次产业 split in China's GDP, employment and value-added tables. The 2012 text (根据《国民经济行业分类》（GB/T 4754—2011），制定本规定) defines the three sectors by enumeration and attaches the 门类/大类 mapping. It was REVISED IN PLACE by 国统设管函〔2018〕74号 (国家统计局关于修订《三次产业划分规定（2012）》的通知, 2018-03-23), which re-mapped its categories onto GB/T 4754—2017 and attached a new 三次产业分类; NBS did not retitle it, so this node is the 2012 instrument in its 2018-revised state and the 2018 notice is recorded here rather than as a separate node (Thomas, 2026-09-10). The revising notice: https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/202302/t20230213_1902764.html. EDITION RULE FOR CITATIONS: a yearbook that dates its citation to the 2018 revision (Guangdong: 执行国家统计局2018年修订的《三次产业划分规定》) names this node; a BARE 《三次产业划分规定》 with no year (national zb03, Jilin zbjs2, Xi'an zb03, Hunan zb02) remains refused, because it cannot distinguish the 2012 text from its revised state.
reports.cadence_note: A standing NBS statistical standard; 2012 text, revised once by notice in March 2018 to follow GB/T 4754-2017. Not reissued on a cycle.

reports.title: 小企业会计准则 (Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises)
reports.publisher: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Finance's simplified accounting standard for small enterprises, issued as 财会〔2011〕17号 on 2011-10-18 and in force from 2013-01-01, replacing the 2004 小企业会计制度. It sits beside the full 企业会计准则 as the second of the two accounting bases a Chinese enterprise may keep its books under, and that is exactly how statistical yearbooks name it: their 主要统计指标解释 for industrial, real-estate and service-enterprise financial indicators (资产总计, 负债合计, 管理费用, 研发费用, 营业利润, 固定资产) tell the reader which line of the enterprise's own 利润表 or 资产负债表 to take depending on whether the enterprise executes 企业会计准则 or 《小企业会计准则》. The cited page is the Ministry's own 会计司 policy-release page carrying the issuing notice in full. Minted round 42 off three independent yearbook citations (Xi'an, Suzhou, Guangdong) after round 40 opened the lead.
reports.cadence_note: A standing standard, issued once in 2011 and effective 2013; not reissued on a cycle.

reports.description: The transport-industry standard (交通行业标准, recommended) that classifies and codes goods carried by road, water, rail and air, JT/T 19-2001, issued 2001-04-10 and effective 2001-08-01, replacing JT 0019-1988; drafted by 交通部科学研究院 and 交通部综合规划司, last reviewed 2022-12-06 with the conclusion 修订. Statistical yearbooks name it in the definition of 港口货物吞吐量: cargo throughput is classified by goods category 根据现行的交通行业《运输货物分类和代码》标准. The cited page is the standard's own entry on the Ministry's 交通运输标准化信息平台 (jtst.mot.gov.cn), which records number, status, dates, drafters and the superseded standard. Minted round 42 off four independent yearbook citations (national zb16, Shanghai C1505, Hunan zb15, Nanjing chapter 8) after round 38 opened the lead.
reports.cadence_note: A standing industry standard, one edition (2001) in force; under review for revision since 2022.

reports.title: 全国文化文物和旅游统计调查制度 (National Statistical Survey System for Culture, Cultural Heritage and Tourism)
title_aliases: 全国文化文物和旅游统计调查制度
全国文物文化和旅游统计调查制度
reports.publisher: 文化和旅游部 (Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Culture and Tourism's departmental statistical survey system (部门统计调查制度), formulated by the Ministry under the Statistics Law and approved by NBS: a full-coverage annual reporting survey of culture and tourism enterprises and institutions under the Ministry's administration, plus sample surveys of domestic, Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan and inbound visitors, whose results are published in 中国文化和旅游统计年鉴 and 旅游抽样调查资料. Provincial and city yearbooks name it as the instrument under which their domestic-tourism series are compiled and revised (Yunnan tables 1-4-1 and 12-1; Jiangsu table 14-12; Nanjing table 11-6). The cited page is the instrument's own entry on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing (/fw/bmdcxmsp/bmzd/), the approving authority's register of every departmental system, which opens 文化和旅游部制定的《全国文化文物和旅游统计调查制度》 and carries its purpose, scope, content, method and organisation in full; the 2024-04-23 entry is the newest of the two on the listing. NODE CAVEAT: the issuing body is the Ministry and the cited page is on the approving body's host (rule 19: authorship, not host); the Ministry's own site carries only the 2013 predecessor 《全国文化文物统计报表制度》 — move the URL if an MCT page for the current title is located. TITLE VARIANT: Jiangsu and Nanjing both write 《全国文物文化和旅游统计调查制度》, the two middle nouns transposed; there is no instrument of that name and the alias is carried on the 2026-09-08 precedent of `hs` (商品名称和/及编码协调制度), Thomas ruled 2026-09-10 (round 43): KEEP the alias; both edges stand. Minted round 42.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued periodically as a departmental survey system approved by NBS; the listing carries a 2021-07-12 and a 2024-04-23 edition.

reports.title: 外商投资统计调查制度 (Foreign Investment Statistical Survey System)
title_aliases: 外商投资统计调查制度
reports.publisher: 商务部 (Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Commerce's departmental statistical survey system (部门统计调查制度) approved by NBS for foreign investment statistics, formulated under the Statistics Law and the Foreign Investment Law, covering foreign-invested enterprises, foreign financial branches and oil-and-gas projects in China. It is the instrument that fixes which figures a provincial statistical yearbook may print for utilised foreign capital: Jiangsu's 2025 yearbook cites its 2022 edition's rule that provincial commerce departments supplying foreign-investment data to statistics departments for yearbooks must use the figures fed back by the Ministry. The cited page is the newest (2025-07-02) edition's entry on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing, the approving authority's register, with purpose, objects, scope, content and method in full; the listing also carries a 2023-02-15 entry. One node for the reissued instrument, as with NBS's own annually reissued 统计报表制度 nodes; a dated citation reaches it. NODE CAVEAT: issuing body MOFCOM, page on the approving body's host (rule 19); move the URL if a mofcom.gov.cn page for the instrument is located. Minted round 42.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued periodically as a departmental survey system approved by NBS; editions of 2022 (cited by Jiangsu), 2023 and 2025 are known.

reports.title: 对外承包工程管理条例 (Regulations on the Administration of Foreign Contracted Projects)
title_aliases: 对外承包工程管理条例
reports.publisher: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The State Council regulation governing Chinese enterprises' contracting of construction projects abroad, promulgated as 国务院令第527号 on 2008-07-21 (in force 2008-09-01) and amended by the 2017-03-01 国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定. Its article 2 defines 对外承包工程 as 中国的企业或者其他单位承包境外建设工程项目的活动, and that definition is what the national, Hubei and Nanjing statistical yearbooks reproduce verbatim, prefaced 根据《对外承包工程管理条例》, as the scope of their 对外承包工程 series — a definitional use of a legal instrument, which is a legal_basis edge under the 2026-09-10 ruling (a document that defines a series' scope under a law names the law as its basis). The cited page is the amended text in the State Council Gazette (国务院公报 增刊2017·1) on gov.cn; the original 2008 promulgation is at https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2008/content_1065453.htm. One node for the regulation in its 2017-amended state, on the same reasoning as 三次产业划分规定（2012）: the amendment is a revising decision, not a retitled edition. Minted round 42 after round 38 opened the lead.
reports.cadence_note: A standing State Council regulation, promulgated 2008 and amended 2017; not reissued on a cycle.

reports.title: China Statistical Abstract (中国统计摘要)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: NBS's annual pocket compendium (国家统计局 编, 中国统计出版社 出版), the concise companion to the China Statistical Yearbook: a comprehensive digest of the previous year's main economic and social indicators with headline historical series since 1978, released each May — some four months before the Yearbook — across general, population, national accounts, employment and wages, prices, living standards, fiscal, resources and energy, investment, trade, agriculture, industry, construction, retail and tourism, transport, finance, science and education, health, culture, and the Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and international appendices. Because it is the earliest official source of national and all-province comparison figures, provincial and city yearbooks reprint their 'national share' and 'all provinces' appendices from it and name it by title with the edition year (Shandong ch23, Jiangsu ch21, Hubei appendix, Yunnan table 1-6, Nanjing table 1-15, Guangdong appendix). The cited page is the 2022 edition's entry on NBS's own 统计出版物 listing (/zs/tjwh/tjkw/tjzl/), which records compiler, publisher, ISBN, date and contents; the listing's newest Abstract entry is 2022, so the 2024 and 2025 editions the yearbooks cite have no NBS page of their own yet — one node for the annual publication, as with cn-statistical-yearbook, and a dated citation reaches it. Minted round 42 after being named by six yearbooks across rounds 29-42.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, published each May for the preceding year.

Suzhou's zb16 names the title BARE, and with the 2023 edition in force for the 2024 data year a bare title cannot say which edition it means — refused on the COICOP/三次产业划分规定 edition-inference ground, recorded below. ITEM 3 (国家危险废物名录): the national zb08 cites the 2016 EDITION by year — 按《国家危险废物名录》（2016）填报 — not the 2021 edition the handoff named. reports.title: 旅游饭店星级的划分与评定 (Classification and Accreditation for Star-rated Tourist Hotels), GB/T 14308-2010
title_aliases: 旅游饭店星级的划分与评定
reports.publisher: 中国国家标准化管理委员会 (Standardization Administration of China)
reports.description: The recommended national standard that defines China's one-to-five-star hotel grades and the accreditation procedure behind them, GB/T 14308-2010, issued 2010-10-18 and effective 2011-01-01, replacing GB/T 14308-2003 in full; drafted by 国家旅游局监督管理司 under technical committee TC210 (全国旅游标准化技术委员会), 主管部门 文化和旅游部; reviewed 2016-12-31 with the conclusion 修订, and superseded in full by GB/T 14308-2023 from 2024-03-01. Statistical yearbooks use it to define the 星级饭店 series: a star-rated hotel is one whose 设备、设施、服务符合《旅游饭店星级的划分与评定》（GB/T14308-2010）标准 and has been accredited by the tourism authority. This node is the 2010 EDITION, on the GB/T 4754-2017 shape — each edition carries its own standard number and its own platform page — so a citation naming the number or year reaches it and a bare title does not (Suzhou's zb16, refused this round, could as well mean the 2023 edition in force for its data year). The cited page is the standard's own entry on SAMR's 全国标准信息公共服务平台 (std.samr.gov.cn), the national standards register, recording number, status, dates, the replaced and replacing editions, committee, drafters and 主管部门; HANDOFF 084's URL for this instrument was the platform's page for the 2020 revision PROJECT (20201806-T-357), not the standard. Minted round 43.
reports.cadence_note: A standing national standard, revised roughly once a decade: 1993, 1997, 2003, 2010, 2023. This node is the 2010 edition.

reports.title: 国家危险废物名录 (2016) (National Catalogue of Hazardous Wastes, 2016 edition)
reports.publisher: 生态环境部 (Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China; issued as 环境保护部 jointly with 国家发展和改革委员会 and 公安部)
reports.description: The 2016 edition of China's statutory list of hazardous wastes, made under the 固体废物污染环境防治法 and promulgated as 环境保护部、国家发展和改革委员会、公安部令第39号 on 2016-06-14, in force from 2016-08-01, repealing the 2008 edition (环境保护部、国家发展和改革委员会令第1号): 46 categories and 479 wastes coded by GB/T 4754-2011 industry of origin, with a new 危险废物豁免管理清单 annex. It is the reference that decides what counts as 危险废物 in environmental statistics, and the national statistical yearbook's 指标解释 for 危险废物产生量 says so with the edition year — 按《国家危险废物名录》（2016）填报. Later editions are separate instruments retitled with their year (国家危险废物名录（2021年版）, 生态环境部等五部门令第15号, from 2021-01-01; 国家危险废物名录（2025年版）, 令第36号, from 2025-01-01), so this node is the 2016 edition only and a bare 《国家危险废物名录》 (Jiangsu nj0914, refused this round) does not reach it. NODE CAVEAT on the URL: the Ministry's own 2016 page (mee.gov.cn/gkml/hbb/bl/201606/t20160621_354852.htm) now redirects to MEE's 404 page and its 规章库 lists only the 2025 edition, so the cited page is the State Council Gazette's printing of 令第39号 (国务院公报 2016年第26号 on gov.cn, the text and signatures in full, attachments omitted) — the same route as cn-foreign-contracted-projects-regulations; move the URL if MEE restores a page for this edition. MEE's interpretation of the edition is at https://www.mee.gov.cn/gkml/sthjbgw/qt/201606/t20160621_354849.htm. Minted round 43.
reports.cadence_note: A standing ministerial list, reissued as a new 令 roughly every five years (2008, 2016, 2021, 2025). This node is the 2016 edition.

reports.title: 人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度 (Human Resources and Social Security Statistical Survey System)
title_aliases: 人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度
reports.publisher: 人力资源和社会保障部 (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security's departmental statistical survey system (部门统计调查制度), formulated by the Ministry under the Statistics Law and approved by NBS: eleven full-coverage reporting surveys — petitions, employment, the human-resources market, vocational skills, talent in publicly-owned enterprises, personnel of public institutions, labour relations, wages and welfare of government bodies and institutions, social insurance, mediation and arbitration, and labour inspection — filled in by local HRSS departments, with monthly headline figures released through the Ministry's 数字人社 pages, the annual 人力资源和社会保障事业发展统计公报 by end-June, and 中国劳动统计年鉴. The national statistical yearbook's employment chapter names it as the source of its registered-unemployment series: 城镇登记失业人员数据，是人力资源社会保障部根据其《人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度》整理提供. The cited page is the instrument's own entry on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing (/fw/bmdcxmsp/bmzd/), the approving authority's register, carrying purpose, content, scope, method, organisation and release arrangements in full; the 2025-06-04 entry is the newer of the two on the listing (the other is 2023-02-15). NODE CAVEAT: the issuing body is the Ministry and the cited page is on the approving body's host (rule 19: authorship, not host) — move the URL if a mohrss.gov.cn page for the instrument is located. Found round 43 by matching the listing's 512 titles against re-fetched yearbook text without requiring 《》; the sentence had been swept past since round 29.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued periodically as a departmental survey system approved by NBS; the listing carries a 2023-02-15 and a 2025-06-04 edition.

reports.title: 企业会计准则——基本准则 (Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises — Basic Standard)
title_aliases: 企业会计准则——基本准则
reports.publisher: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Finance's basic standard at the head of China's enterprise accounting system, promulgated as 财政部令第33号 on 2006-02-15 and in force from 2007-01-01, amended by 财政部令第76号 of 2014-07-23 (article 42(5), the fair-value definition, rewritten for convergence with IFRS). Its article 3 defines the system it heads — 企业会计准则包括基本准则和具体准则，具体准则的制定应当遵循本准则 — so the bare 《企业会计准则》 that statistical yearbooks name is the system, and the basic standard is its node (Thomas ruled 2026-09-10, round 43: one node, the basic standard). It is the full accounting basis beside the simplified 小企业会计准则, and yearbooks name the pair together: their 主要统计指标解释 for enterprise financial indicators (资产总计, 负债合计, 固定资产合计, 销售费用, 营业利润) tell the reader which line of the enterprise's own 资产负债表 or 利润表 to take 执行《企业会计准则》或《小企业会计准则》的企业. NODE CAVEAT on the URL: the Ministry's own pages for 令第76号 (tfs.mof.gov.cn/caizhengbuling/201407/t20140729_1119494.htm) and for the 2006 issue on kjs.mof.gov.cn answered 502 from the Ministry's CDN to the cloud container and to the built-in browser pane on 2026-09-10 (the kjs.mof.gov.cn page cited by cn-mof-small-enterprise-accounting-standards, read fine in round 42, 502'd the same way), so the cited page is the State Council Gazette's printing of 令第76号 with the amended 基本准则 in full (国务院公报 2014年第31号 on gov.cn) — the same route as cn-foreign-contracted-projects-regulations and cn-mee-hazardous-waste-list-2016; move the URL to the Ministry's page when it answers. MATCHER NOTE: the alias 企业会计准则 is a substring of 小企业会计准则, so a document naming only the small-enterprise standard would also satisfy namesTarget for this node — every edge here quotes a sentence naming both, and a future edge should do the same. Minted round 43 off three independent yearbook citations (Suzhou, Guangdong, Xi'an) after round 40 opened the lead.

The unbracketed instrument mentions are exactly two — ch11's 本篇资料根据国家统计局农业统计报表制度填报 and ch12's 本篇工业资料是根据国家统计局工业统计报表制度填报 — and both are the look-alike class already refused (NBS's instruments are 农业产值和价格综合统计报表制度 and 工业统计调查制度; compare characters, not eyes). The rest are generic (国家统计调查制度, 各有关专业统计报表制度, 国家统计局制定的报表制度). No departmental-listing title appears in any of the 47 pages. Nothing left in this layer.

THE 512-TITLE LISTING WAS MATCHED AGAINST EVERY YEARBOOK LAYER THE CONTAINER COULD RE-FETCH ON 2026-09-10, without requiring 《》. No text from earlier rounds' reads survives (their working files stayed in their sandboxes), so the layers were fetched again: national sm01-29 + zb01-27 (ALL 56 — zb10.pdf and zb27.pdf, recorded since round 38 as a corrupt xref and a 404, both came down clean on 2026-09-10 at 288,063 and 307,249 bytes and extract: zb10 is 固定资产投资, zb27 is 澳门特别行政区, and neither names a 《》 title or any listing title — that HANDOFF item is closed), Shandong sm01-25 + zb01-21 (http only), Hunan zb01-19 (bare IP), Suzhou zb01-19, Xi'an zb01-22 + sm16/sm17, and Guangdong's 47 CD-edition pages — 211 documents. ONE hit: national sm04 → 人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度 (minted and wired in this file). The five titles HANDOFF 084 called 'known unwired hits with a citing yearbook still to find' — 教育事业综合统计调查制度, 民政事业统计调查制度, 海关统计调查制度, 全国卫生健康监督统计调查制度, 交通运输综合统计调查制度 — appear in none of the 211 documents; they were only ever listing entries (round 42's note said 'worth a targeted grep WHEN a yearbook names them'), and no swept yearbook names them. NOT re-fetched this round, so still unscanned against the listing without 《》: Jiangsu (Knownsec-blocked to the container today; readable one page at a time in the browser pane), Nanjing, Jilin, Shanghai, Hubei and Yunnan (zips), Wuhan (one PDF). Their bracketed titles were all recorded by rounds 30-42 and none was a listing title, so the remaining exposure is unbracketed mentions only, which Guangdong's sweep above suggests are rare. The scan script matched each listing title's core (parentheticals stripped, ≥6 characters) as a substring of whitespace-stripped text.

meta.source: research round 2026-09-10 — CN round 44: HANDOFF 084 §3 [Agent] item 4 (does another provincial bureau publish a 年定报制度目录?) — answered YES for all three of Shandong, Jiangsu and Guangdong, and the answer opened NBS's own 统计制度 attachments
meta.note:
Round 44, Thomas's brief: 'check on Shandong/Jiangsu/Guangdong - lets finish up everything left in china'. RESULT: 12 nodes, 39 edges. THE ITEM-4 ANSWER IS YES FOR ALL THREE (recorded in the Guangdong _dropped note): Jiangsu's 统计制度 at /col/col85333/ is a fuller 年定报制度目录 than Shanghai's — 26 instruments for the 2025年报/2026定报 cycle, the whole instrument attached to each, plus the previous cycle; Guangdong splits national (/pc/) from local (/zxdc555/) survey projects and attaches the entire 一套表统计调查制度 as a 1.3MB .docx; Shandong's /col/col6112/ carries 14 of NBS's own 主要内容 summaries. Every cover read exactly as round 40 said it would.

BUT THE PROVINCIAL CATALOGUES ARE NOT WHERE THE ROUND WENT. Chasing 一套表统计调查制度 to its publisher led back to NBS's own 统计制度 listing, and there the seam was: EVERY ONE of its 24 instrument pages has a body of five characters — 具体内容见附件 — and the instrument itself hanging off it as an attachment that no round had ever opened. Those attachments carry, in a fixed house form, the three sentences this corpus wires on: 依照《中华人民共和国统计法》，制定本制度 (the legal basis), 本制度执行国民经济行业分类（GB/T 4754—2017）等统一的国家统计分类和编码标准 (the classification), and 统计资料的报送和公布, which names the publications the results are released through. Twelve of the corpus's NBS instrument nodes — minted across rounds 29-38 and every one of them with ZERO out-edges until today — were sitting one attachment away from their own basis.

WHY NOBODY HAD OPENED THEM, and it is a tooling answer, not a research one: the attachments are legacy binary Compound-File .doc served as application/msword. The fetcher read PDF, xlsx, docx and general zips, and a CFB file is none of those, so it fell through to the raw-text branch and graded empty. TWO ADDITIVE FETCHER BRANCHES, both narrow by construction and neither able to move an existing grade (checked: the corpus has two .doc URLs, both node `url` fields, zero evidence_url): (1) an archive carrying `word/document.xml` is read as docx whatever the ctype and URL say — NBS saves some of these as Word 2007+ under a .doc name; (2) a CFB body is converted with `soffice --headless --convert-to docx` and handed to the docx reader, the same defence round 42's .xls pass took, and the fourth branch of that shape.

FIVE PUBLICATION NODES GAINED A title_aliases ENTRY and the reason is a known trap, not a convenience: namesTarget strips ASCII parentheses before matching, so a node titled 'China Rural Statistical Yearbook (中国农村统计年鉴)' is invisible to a Chinese-only document naming it in full. cn-statistical-abstract has carried 中国统计摘要 as an alias since round 42 for exactly this. Added: 中国统计年鉴, 中国农村统计年鉴, 中国县域统计年鉴, 中国城市统计年鉴, 中国能源统计年鉴. The bilingual provincial yearbooks matched on their English titles, which is why this never bit before; NBS's instruments are Chinese-only.

TWO NODES CAME FROM PROVINCIAL PRINTINGS BECAUSE NBS PUBLISHES NO PAGE FOR THEM, on the round-40 precedent Thomas ruled: 一套表统计调查制度 (Guangdong's .docx; Jiangsu prints the identical document) and 农业产值与增加值核算统计报表制度 (Jiangsu's catalogue). Both covers read 国家统计局制定, both nodes carry the caveat. The second closes a title that had been on the nodeless list since round 30 and wires Jiangsu's chapter-10 citation.

TWO OLD LEADS RESOLVED: round 31's Xi'an mint-lead note (part 15's 《一套表统计调查制度》 is now wired; its part-12 《企业一套表统计调查制度》 and 《工业统计报表制度》 stay refused as different titles, and the note says so rather than being retagged, per the endpoint-free-note rule). The national yearbook's own sm16 sentence naming the integrated system — the single hit in the 211 documents round 43 saved — is wired too.

REFUSED, with reasons in the _dropped notes: four of the 24 listed instruments (their publication targets have no node), 劳动力调查制度's legal basis (国办发〔2004〕72号, not the Statistics Law directly), and Xi'an's two look-alike industry titles. Six NBS publications are named by sentences already read and stored and have no node — three citations for 《第三产业统计年鉴》, four for 《国家统计局主要统计信息发布日程表》 — each an immediate edge the moment its page is found; that list is the cheapest thing left in CN and it is recorded here rather than in HANDOFF.

reports.title: 一套表统计调查制度 (Integrated (One-Set-of-Forms) Statistical Survey System)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS instrument behind China's 联网直报 'one set of forms' reporting — the single survey system that collects the annual and periodic returns of every above-threshold unit in industry, construction, wholesale and retail trade, accommodation and catering, real-estate development, services and other investing units, through one integrated form set filed directly to NBS's cloud reporting platform. It carries its own 分类目录 section, which is where the classification standards the whole above-threshold system runs on are bound into it. Reissued annually; the edition read here covers the 2025 annual report and the 2026 periodic returns, cover dated 2025年11月. ISSUER: the cover reads 国家统计局制定 with no provincial line, and 本制度由国家统计局负责解释 — this is an NBS instrument, read on a provincial publisher's copy under PLAYBOOK §7a's read-the-instrument-not-the-citation rule and rule 19's authorship-not-host principle. CAVEAT: NBS's own 统计制度 listing (24 instruments, article ids 1962929-1962952) does NOT carry it and no page for it was found on stats.gov.cn, so the URL is Guangdong's 国家统计调查项目 page, which publishes the whole instrument as a .docx; Jiangsu's 统计制度 catalogue publishes the identical document (art_85333_11737396) with the same cover. Minted round 44.

meta.source: research round 2026-09-10 — CN round 45: HANDOFF 084 §3 [Agent] item 1 (the six NBS publications one page away from an edge each), plus the Guangzhou yearbook, found published complete after four rounds of being called Chrome-only
meta.note:
Round 45, Thomas's brief: 'take another round at china, fetch whatever from wherever you want to look. the chrome browser is open too mate.' RESULT: 8 nodes, 18 edges.

TWO SEAMS, AND THE SECOND ONE IS THE ONE WORTH REMEMBERING.

FIRST, THE ITEM-1 LIST. NBS's 统计出版物 listing was enumerated in FULL this round — 16 pages (index, index_1 … index_15), 271 entries, where round 42 had read only the first page and round 44 assumed four. Two of round 44's six resolved on it and are minted (中国第三产业统计年鉴, three citations, the most-cited nodeless publication in the China layer; 中国基本单位统计年鉴). Two more publications named by the national yearbook's chapter notes resolved there too (中国劳动统计年鉴, 中国教育经费统计年鉴), and one more, 中国医疗保障统计年鉴. Four of round 44's six are NOT on the listing under any spelling and stay nodeless with reasons; 《国家统计局主要统计信息发布日程表》 is a live release calendar, not a volume, and the listing's 《统计数据发布日程手册2022》 is a different title — do not conflate.

THE NATIONAL YEARBOOK'S CHAPTER NOTES NAME THE MINISTRY PUBLICATION BEHIND EACH CHAPTER, under a heading that says so: 二、本篇的资料来源, then 详细资料（分别）见《X》（编者）. sm21 names two, sm22 four, sm23 three, sm24 three, sm25 two. That is a dozen first-party citations of publications the corpus mostly does not have, and it had never been read as a class. **They are wired as `cites`, not `uses_data_from`, and that is a deliberate call:** the yearbook says the detail is to be found there, not that its own figures came from there — both publications draw on the same ministry's returns, and a data dependency would be an inference the document does not make. EIGHT of the twelve are blocked on the same thing and are recorded in `_dropped`: no reachable first-party page. moe/mca/cdpf/nppa/mct all return 000 to this container and acftu returns 412; nrta answers but its statistics portal is a 720-byte Vue shell. The quotes are read and stored — those eight need a browser or another network, nothing more.

SECOND, AND THE REAL FIND: **GUANGZHOU PUBLISHES ITS WHOLE YEARBOOK AS A DOWNLOAD, AND FOUR ROUNDS RECORDED IT AS 'Chrome-only, zTree JS viewer'.** The zTree viewer at /datav/admin/home/www_nj/ is real and is a dead end — its year links carry no href and clicking one navigates nowhere. But that page says, in one line of grey text, 历史统计年鉴下载请访问【官网首页 > 统计业务 > 资源下载 > 统计年鉴电子资源】, and THAT page publishes the 2025 edition twice: a 6.6 MB zip of 367 per-table .xls workbooks and the complete 34.7 MB PDF. **Seven edges, and the node had none in either direction since the August 2026 import.** The generalisable part is not the URL: *the viewer a bureau builds is not the only way it publishes, and the download link may be one sentence inside the viewer telling you so.* Guangzhou is the fifth CN city wired.

A THIRD FETCHER CHANGE, and it is round 42's lesson widened by exactly one word. Round 42 gave archives a 600-second ceiling and three `curl -C -` resumes, keyed on the URL's extension. Guangzhou's yearbook is one 34.7 MB **PDF**, and `TIMEOUT_S` cuts it at 30.2 MB every time — measured twice — so seven live citations off a document that reads perfectly would have graded C `network:curl-28`. Raising the global budget slows every dead host; keying on `.pdf` would re-grade 600 PDFs. What is actually true is narrower than either: **a transfer that stopped with bytes already on disk was making progress, and a dead host leaves no partial body at all.** The resume now runs on an archive extension OR a non-empty partial body, still bounded at three attempts, with `--speed-limit/--speed-time` still killing anything genuinely stalled.

REFUSED, with reasons in the notes: Guangzhou's bare 《三次产业划分规定》 (fifth yearbook declined on the edition ground) and its bare 《国家危险废物名录》 (four editions exist; the same refusal Jiangsu got in round 43); 《城市（县城）建设统计报表制度》, which is NOT the 《城市（县城）和村镇建设统计调查制度》 minted here. **Beijing failed a fifth time, in Thomas's own Chrome** — three rounds, both routes; and Hangzhou, Chengdu, Hebei, Chongqing, Hainan, Guangxi and Jiangxi all failed again the same day in both. That set is not to be re-probed as a batch without a new route.

meta.note: Wires the Shandong Statistical Yearbook 2025 off its per-chapter 简要说明, and records Henan as blocked. NO NODES MINTED — this is pure wiring, as the round was scoped. THE METHOD FINDING, which contradicts what the round was told to expect: Shandong's chapter notes are NOT the Jiangsu/Guangdong template. The handoff said 建筑业 and 农业 'have named an NBS 统计报表制度 by title in every yearbook checked so far' and sent this round to open those two first — in Shandong BOTH are agency-level and name no instrument. 建筑业 (sm15) says only 本篇资料来源于建筑业统计年报，由省统计局投资处整理提供 — a generic report description plus an internal division, the ordinary §7a refusal; 农业 (sm13) names five provincial DEPARTMENTS (自然资源厅, 农业农村厅, 水利厅, 山东调查总队) and 农村综合统计年报, again no titled instrument. All 25 chapter notes were fetched and swept for 《…》 rather than sampled, and only FOUR chapters name a titled artefact at all: sm04, sm18, sm23 and sm24. So the productive chapter varies by province and the two-chapter shortcut should not be trusted as a starting rule — sweep all the notes, it is one fetch each. SHAPE: Shandong is a fourth physical shape, not one of round 31's four. Its tables are 387 .jpg scans with no text layer (unreadable, and irrelevant), but its 25 chapter notes are separate single-page TEXT PDFs at html/smNN.pdf with embedded Identity-H CID fonts — so the yearbook is image-only and text-bearing at the same time, depending which part you ask for. Its 编辑说明 is html/note.jpg, an image, and is therefore refused the way Suzhou's was. Frameset at tjnj/nj2025/zk/indexch.htm, TOC at left.htm, reachable over HTTP ONLY (https is connection-refused).

meta.source: research round 2026-09-09 (round 39) — Shanghai, the first of the eight province-level divisions that had a node and no edges; five edges, all A
meta.note: SHANGHAI IS THE RICHEST PROVINCIAL YEARBOOK FOUND IN ELEVEN ROUNDS — 23 chapter 简要说明 plus 主要统计指标解释, 214 readable note pages, and eight NBS instruments named by title. It had a node since the August 2026 import and had never been opened. THREE THINGS THAT PAY FORWARD. (1) **THE PATH IS CASE-SENSITIVE AND THE PUBLISHER'S OWN TOC GETS IT WRONG.** The TOC writes d1=2025tjnj/zbhtml/C0001.htm; the server serves only 2025tjnj/ZBHTML/C0001.htm and returns a 404 PAGE WITH HTTP 200 for the lowercase form. All 216 notes were fetched once, all 216 came back 1085 bytes, and every one of them was that 404 page — a uniform small body across a whole batch is the same signal as round 37's single small body, and it means READ ONE. (2) **AUTHORSHIP INSIDE THE SENTENCE DECIDES THE TARGET, NOT THE TITLE.** Shanghai names 《固定资产投资统计报表制度》 and 《房地产开发统计报表制度》 — both exact title matches for live NBS nodes — but says 上海市统计局制定的 for both, and 国家统计局制定的 for the wage and construction instruments. The first two are SHANGHAI's own instruments wearing NBS's titles and are NOT wired here; the ruling that provincial-bureau instruments are nodes makes them a mint lead, not an NBS edge. This is the 农业产值 look-alike trap in a new form: same title, different issuer, and the sentence says which. (3) **A MIS-DECLARED CHARSET THAT THE GUARD HAPPENS TO SURVIVE.** Every page declares gb2312 in its meta and is served as UTF-8 with an HTTP header that says so; decodeDeclared reads the META and ignores the header, so it decodes as gb18030 — and is saved only by its U+FFFD tie-break, because gb18030 accepts almost any byte sequence and produces mojibake with ZERO replacement characters, losing the < comparison and falling back to UTF-8. Verified by running decodeDeclared over the real bytes rather than reasoning about it. No change made; recorded because the guard is passing for a reason nobody designed.

_dropped.why: RESOLVED 2026-09-09 (round 40) — the edge is now LIVE in cn-round40-2026-09-09.json and this refusal was wrong. The refusal turned on the yearbook's 上海市统计局制定的 and inferred that Shanghai had its own instrument wearing NBS's title. Round 40 read the instrument itself, in the Shanghai bureau's own 年定报制度目录 (https://tjj.sh.gov.cn/ndbzdml/index.html, entry 14, attached PDF /cmsres/72/72cc7d80469645fa889100373984637a/e06d1b5695b00a87480b26a8bc9e00b5.pdf): its cover reads 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制 — NBS formulated it, Shanghai supplemented and printed it. The covers of 建筑业统计报表制度 and 劳动工资统计报表制度, which THIS ROUND wired to NBS nodes off 国家统计局制定的, read identically, so the corpus was treating four identically-authored instruments two different ways. Thomas ruled 2026-09-09: wire to the NBS node. The general lesson kept: read the instrument before recording a look-alike, because the citing sentence is loose about which bureau 制定 the local edition. Original entry follows, untouched. --- [wrong-target] SAME TITLE, DIFFERENT ISSUER — and the sentence says so. The 城市建设 chapter's 简要说明 (ZBHTML/C0010.htm) reads 城市基础设施建设、公共事业和市政建设投资统计资料依据上海市统计局制定的《固定资产投资统计报表制度》收集整理提供: 上海市统计局制定的, drawn up by the SHANGHAI municipal bureau, not 国家统计局制定的 as the wage and construction chapters of the same yearbook say. The live node cn-nbs-fixed-investment-reporting-system is NBS's instrument, off its own stats.gov.cn landing page (article 1962939, minted round 31), so wiring this sentence to it would assert a dependency on a document Shanghai did not name. THIS IS A MINT LEAD, NOT A DEAD END: provincial-bureau methodology instruments ARE nodes (Thomas, 2026-09-09) and the bar is a page on the issuing bureau's own site — nobody has looked for Shanghai's version on tjj.sh.gov.cn. Same shape as the three 农业产值 spellings, except that here the titles are identical and only the issuer differs, which is harder to catch by eye.

RESOLVED 2026-09-09 (round 40) — the edge is now LIVE in cn-round40-2026-09-09.json, on the same finding as the 固定资产投资 entry above. Shanghai's 年定报制度目录 entry 8 (attached PDF /cmsres/e1/e11c4eb55ff24471a8d91358c9711e40/1af5de41ca659bcb989fa99c3394d664.pdf) carries the cover line 国家统计局制定 / 上海市统计局补充、印制, so 《房地产开发统计报表制度》 is NBS's instrument in a Shanghai-supplemented printing, not a Shanghai instrument. Thomas ruled 2026-09-09: wire to the NBS node. Original entry follows, untouched. --- [wrong-target] SAME TITLE, DIFFERENT ISSUER — the identical refusal as the fixed-investment one above, and found in the same sweep. The 房地产业 chapter's 简要说明 (ZBHTML/C0018.htm) reads 根据上海市统计局制定的《房地产开发统计报表制度》调查汇总提供. 上海市统计局制定的, so it is Shanghai's own instrument and not the NBS node minted round 29. Also a mint lead for a Shanghai provincial instrument rather than an answer.

NAMES THE MANUAL, NOT AN EDITION. The 对外经济贸易和旅游 chapter's 简要说明 (ZBHTML/C0007.htm) says services trade is compiled 根据国际货币基金组织公布的《国际收支手册》中的相关标准 — the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual, named by title and publisher with no edition and no number. imf-bpm6 is edition-bound. Supplying the sixth edition ourselves is exactly the inference the generic-COICOP ruling of 2026-09-08 settled, and the same refusal Jilin's bare 《三次产业划分规定》 got in round 37. Re-openable only against a Shanghai edition that names the edition.
