reports.title: Отчет об исполнении федерального бюджета
reports.description: The Federal Treasury's recurring budget-execution reporting -- the executed counterpart to `ru-federal-budget-law-2026`, and the deepest recurring series located in this branch, with an archive reaching back to 1997. The report-type selector on the Treasury's own page states the cadences verbatim: «Вид отчета … Выберите из списка годовой квартальный ежемесячный оперативный» ("Report type … select from list: annual, quarterly, monthly, operational"). The year selector confirms the archive depth: «Год Выберите год 2026 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 2015 2014 2013 2012 2011 2010 2009 2008 2007 2006 2005 2004 2003 2002 2001 2000 1999 1998 1997». The publication lag is visible in the latest instances: «на 1 июня 2026 zip 1 июля 2026 09:00» and «на 1 апреля 2026 zip 9 июня 2026 09:00» -- a report as at the first of month M published at the start of month M+1 at 09:00. Sibling recurring sections confirmed live on the same host and available as future nodes: «Консолидированный бюджет РФ и бюджетов государственных внебюджетных фондов», «Консолидированные бюджеты субъектов РФ и бюджетов территориальных государственных внебюджетных фондов», the illustrated «Исполнение федерального бюджета и бюджетов бюджетной системы РФ», and «Статистика государственных финансов РФ». Fetched TIER A (HTTP 200 / 166,884 bytes after one retry; the first attempt returned `curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer`, which is roskazna.gov.ru rate-limiting rather than a block). PATH TRAP worth recording for future sessions: the correct slug is `federalnyj-byudzhet` (single -j, no trailing slash); the plausible variants `federalnyy-byudzhet` (double -y) and a trailing slash both return a genuine 404 of exactly 2,622 bytes -- a small-bodied 404 that a status-code-only check reads correctly but a body-length heuristic might not. NOTE: only the section metadata was verified this round; the report ZIPs themselves were not opened, which is why no edge is minted from this node (see `_dropped`).
reports.cadence_note: Four simultaneous cadences, stated verbatim by the Treasury's own report-type selector: «годовой квартальный ежемесячный оперативный» (annual, quarterly, monthly, operational). `releases_per_year` is set to 12 for the monthly series, whose publication rhythm is directly observable in the file listing («на 1 июня 2026 … 1 июля 2026 09:00»); the operational series is more frequent still and the quarterly and annual roll-ups run alongside.

dependencies.basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A on Rosstat's own host. Приказ № 915 is the instrument that approves the official statistical methodology the CPI is computed under, in its own words: «Утвердить Официальную статистическую методологию наблюдения за потребительскими ценами на товары и услуги и расчета индексов потребительских цен (далее – Методология) (приложение № 1).» It supplies genuine method rather than a bare publication mandate -- it fixes the index formula («Расчет ИПЦ к предыдущему месяцу осуществляется в соответствии с модифицированной формулой Ласпейреса»), the observation cadence («ежемесячно по состоянию на конец месяца … еженедельно по состоянию на пятницу») and the weights basis («веса – мера относительной значимости товаров (услуг) в рамках сводного индекса цен, определяемая на основе потребительских расходов домашних хозяйств»). `methodology_depends_on` rather than `cites` on exactly the distinction `br-fiscal-responsibility-law.json` draws for `br-rreo -> br-lc-101-2000`: an instrument that defines the method the release relies on, not one that merely compels its publication.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Утвердить Официальную статистическую методологию наблюдения за потребительскими ценами на товары и услуги и расчета индексов потребительских цен (далее – Методология) (приложение № 1).

dependencies.basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, and unusually literally: the methodology is not merely cited by this publication, it is PHYSICALLY BUNDLED INSIDE IT. `Dotatsii_na_vyravnivanie.zip` contains 84 per-region `.xls` workbooks plus `Методика распределения дотаций на выравнивание.pdf`, the consolidated operative text of Постановление 670. The methodology's own text defines both the calculation this data feeds and the obligation that produces the data: «В целях реализации статьи 131 Бюджетного кодекса Российской Федерации Правительство Российской Федерации постановляет: 1. Утвердить прилагаемую методику распределения дотаций на выравнивание бюджетной обеспеченности субъектов Российской Федерации.» and «2. Федеральной службе государственной статистики и Федеральной налоговой службе обеспечивать ежегодно, до 1 августа, представление в Министерство финансов Российской Федерации информации, необходимой для осуществления расчетов в соответствии с методикой, утвержденной настоящим Постановлением.» The core formula the data serves is «БОi = ИНПi / ИБРi», where ИНПi is the index of tax potential and ИБРi the index of budget expenditure. `methodology_depends_on` rather than `cites`: this is the method the input data is assembled to satisfy, not a background reference.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY (OCR-derived quotation -- the source PDF is an image-only scan, so this text is ~99% accurate, not byte-exact). Постановление 2038 names its amendment target explicitly in its own operative clause: «1. Утвердить прилагаемые изменения, которые вносятся в методику распределения дотаций на выравнивание бюджетной обеспеченности субъектов Российской Федерации, утвержденную постановлением Правительства Российской Федерации от 22 ноября 2004 г. № 670 "О распределении дотаций на выравнивание бюджетной обеспеченности субъектов Российской Федерации"…» `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on`: 2038 modifies 670 rather than depending on it for a method of its own -- this corpus has no `amends` relationship type, and `cites` is the honest fit for a named-document reference that is not a computational input. The relationship is recorded in this direction because that is the direction 2038's own text states it.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY (OCR-derived quotation, ~99% accurate, not byte-exact). Постановление 2038 sets a floor under each region's 2026 equalization grant that is defined by reference to a number published in the budget law: «объем дотации на выравнивание бюджетной обеспеченности субъекта Российской Федерации на 2026 год не может быть менее утвержденного на 2025 год объема такой дотации … увеличенного на прогнозируемый уровень инфляции на конец 2026 года, учтенный при формировании федерального бюджета на 2026 год и плановый период 2027 и 2028 годов». The figure that clause points at is recoverable verbatim from the budget law's own Article 1: «уровня инфляции, не превышающего 4,0 процента (декабрь 2026 года к декабрю 2025 года)». `uses_data_from` rather than `calculated_from`: the inflation forecast is a direct published input to the floor amount, but the resolution states a minimum condition rather than a complete mechanical derivation of the grant. TENSE CHECK: «не может быть менее» is present-tense and prospective for the 2026 cycle -- a live obligation, not a past arrangement.

_dropped.edge: ru-resolution-670-equalization-methodology -> ru-rosstat-cpi (the price input to the index of budget expenditure)
_dropped.why: A real, fully evidenced dependency on a Rosstat price statistic -- but on a DIFFERENT release than the CPI node this file mints, so no edge is drawn to `ru-rosstat-cpi`. The methodology's Приложение № 2 §6 defines the regional price-level coefficient as «к iц = (Б i / Б) × (1 + к iтд × А i / А) × к iр / к ц», where «Бi - стоимость фиксированного набора потребительских товаров и услуг в субъекте Российской Федерации; Б - расчетная стоимость фиксированного набора потребительских товаров и услуг в среднем по субъектам Российской Федерации», and the named-provider table in Приложение № 1 к Правилам assigns that indicator to Rosstat explicitly: «37. Стоимость фиксированного набора потребительских товаров и услуг по субъектам Российской Федерации (рублей) — Росстат». The «стоимость фиксированного набора потребительских товаров и услуг» is a distinct Rosstat product from the consumer price index -- a basket COST level used for inter-regional purchasing-power comparison, not a price INDEX -- and pointing this edge at `ru-rosstat-cpi` would assert a dependency on a release the document does not name. The correct target was confirmed to exist and to be live: it is listed on the same Rosstat price page reached this round, as «ЕМИСС / 1.29.6 / Стоимость фиксированного набора потребительских товаров и услуг для межрегиональных сопоставлений покупательной способности населения» and «Витрина данных / Стоимость фиксированного набора потребительских товаров и услуг», but no title-and-periodicity fetch of that specific release was completed, so no node exists for it yet. This is the single most concrete, highest-value lead for the next Russian round: one page fetch would mint the node and immediately close a CONFIRMED edge into the equalization formula.

_dropped.edge: ru-resolution-670-equalization-methodology -> Росстат and Федеральная налоговая служба (the annual data-supply obligation)
_dropped.why: AGENCY ONLY. This is the strongest dependency STATEMENT anywhere in the Russian branch, and it names agencies rather than publications, so it cannot become an edge on its own. Verbatim from the methodology: «2. Федеральной службе государственной статистики и Федеральной налоговой службе обеспечивать ежегодно, до 1 августа, представление в Министерство финансов Российской Федерации информации, необходимой для осуществления расчетов в соответствии с методикой, утвержденной настоящим Постановлением.» The named-provider table goes further and lists individual indicators against their supplying agency -- «1. Численность постоянного населения субъекта Российской Федерации на конец года (тыс. человек) — Росстат», «38. Величина прожиточного минимума по субъектам Российской Федерации (рублей) — Росстат», «39. Доля населения с денежными доходами ниже границы бедности … — Росстат», «41. Среднемесячная начисленная заработная плата наемных работников … — Росстат», «40. Площадь территории субъекта Российской Федерации … — Росреестр» -- but still never names a titled release for any of them, and adds a footnote confirming the data arrives through statistical forms rather than publications: «<*> Показатель формируется на основании формы федерального статистического наблюдения, утверждаемой Федеральной службой государственной статистики.» TENSE NOTE: «обеспечивать» is imperative and standing (a continuing obligation the Government places on Rosstat and the FNS), not a past-tense acknowledgement, so the relationship is live -- only the target is missing. The Federal Tax Service has no corpus node at all yet. Indicators 1, 38, 39 and 41 are each a separate findable Rosstat release and each a real lead.

_dropped.edge: ru-budget-code-art131 -> ru-resolution-670-equalization-methodology (caveat: the citation is mutual — 670's own enabling clause states the converse)
_dropped.why: An annotation on the edge `ru-budget-code-art131 -> ru-resolution-670-equalization-methodology`, minted at BRICS/G.1 and retained unchanged. This round verified that the citation runs BOTH ways between these two documents, which is worth recording rather than silently resolving in one direction. G.1 minted the edge in the direction art. 131 states it, the Budget Code delegating the distribution method to a Government-approved methodology. This round found 670's own enabling clause stating the converse in its own voice, TIER A on minfin.gov.ru: «В целях реализации статьи 131 Бюджетного кодекса Российской Федерации Правительство Российской Федерации постановляет: 1. Утвердить прилагаемую методику распределения дотаций на выравнивание бюджетной обеспеченности субъектов Российской Федерации.» («For the purpose of implementing Article 131 of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, the Government resolves: 1. To approve the attached methodology…»). A second edge was NOT minted, because a mutual statutory cross-reference between a delegating article and its implementing methodology is one relationship documented from two sides, not two independent dependencies, and minting both would put a two-node cycle into a graph whose whole semantic is directional influence. The existing G.1 edge is the better of the two directions to keep: it points from the higher-authority instrument to the operative method, matching how this corpus types statute-to-instrument relationships elsewhere. Recorded here so a future session does not re-discover 670's enabling clause and add the reverse edge as if it were new.

The budget law cites the Budget Code repeatedly and unambiguously in its own text, but never article 131. The citations actually present, all OCR-derived from the image-only official PDF: «В соответствии с пунктом 2 статьи 184-1 Бюджетного кодекса Российской Федерации утвердить нормативы распределения доходов между бюджетами бюджетной системы Российской Федерации…», «…в соответствии со статьей 242-3 Бюджетного кодекса Российской Федерации распределенные в федеральный бюджет…», «…в соответствии со статьей 242-7 Бюджетного кодекса Российской Федерации казначейскому сопровождению подлежат следующие целевые средства…», and «…бюджетные инвестиции юридическим лицам, предоставляемые в соответствии со статьей 80 Бюджетного кодекса Российской Федерации…». An edge to the Budget Code AS AN INSTRUMENT would be solid; an edge specifically to art. 131 is not evidenced by the law's own text and is not asserted. The corpus currently has only the article-scoped node `ru-budget-code-art131` and no node for the Budget Code as a whole, so there is no correct target to point at. Minting a whole-Code node is a clean, easy lead for a future round -- at which point this edge becomes available immediately, with four separate verbatim citation lines already in hand.

NOT FOUND, and verified as a negative rather than assumed. The Bank of Russia's key-rate press releases discuss inflation constantly and are obviously informed by Rosstat's CPI in substance, but they never say so. A search of the full extracted text of the 24.07.2026 press release returned 0 hits for `Росстат`, 0 for `росстат` and 0 for `статистик`. The release's inflation language is generic and unsourced: «Оценка показателей устойчивой инфляции остается в диапазоне 4–5% в пересчете на год…». This is the same shape as the China finding in `cn-cpi-transfers.json`, where the Government Work Report uses NBS's CPI figures without ever naming the National Bureau of Statistics -- a monetary or fiscal authority treating the national statistical office's output as ambient fact rather than as a cited source. Under this project's evidence standard the dependency does not go in the graph, however obvious it is in substance. Note this is a DIFFERENT negative from the round-1 position: G.1 minted `ru-cbr-monetary-policy-guidelines` precisely because that document DOES name Rosstat's ИПЦ; it is the key-rate release series, not the Bank of Russia generally, that is silent.

_dropped.edge: «Доклад о денежно-кредитной политике» (Bank of Russia Monetary Policy Report) as a live node
_dropped.why: DISCONTINUED, and therefore not minted, under this project's standing no-discontinued-programmes rule. The Bank of Russia's own publication page states it verbatim: «С февраля 2024 года публикация Доклада о денежно-кредитной политике прекращена. Вместо данного материала после каждого решения по ключевой ставке публикуется Резюме обсуждения ключевой ставки, дополнительно по итогам опорных раундов — Комментарий к среднесрочному прогнозу Банка России. Среднесрочный прогноз Банка России публикуется в составе Материалов по итогам заседаний Совета директоров Банка России по ключевой ставке.» («Since February 2024, publication of the Monetary Policy Report has been discontinued. Instead, after each key rate decision, a Summary of the key rate discussion is published…»). The archive confirms the terminal issues: «Выпуск № 4 (44) • Ноябрь» for 2023, and a final «Среднесрочный прогноз Банка России 16.02.2024». This is recorded rather than passed over because the Monetary Policy Report is the obvious thing a future session would go looking for as Russia's quarterly monetary-policy publication, and it would find a real, substantial, and dead series. `ru-cbr-key-rate-decision` is the live successor and is minted in its place.

_dropped.edge: ru-subsistence-minimum-law-134fz -> ru-rosstat-cpi (a CPI-indexation edge for the subsistence minimum or the minimum wage)
_dropped.why: DENIED by the primary text, and the most corpus-significant finding of this round. Russia's benefit-indexation chain does NOT run through the consumer price index. Since 2021 both quantities are fixed shares of Rosstat MEDIAN-INCOME and MEDIAN-WAGE statistics: «Соотношение величины прожиточного минимума на душу населения в целом по Российской Федерации и величины медианного среднедушевого дохода за предыдущий год с 2021 года устанавливается в размере 44,2 процента» for the subsistence minimum, and «С 2021 года соотношение минимального размера оплаты труда и медианной заработной платы устанавливается в размере 42 процентов» for the minimum wage. This directly contradicts the CPI-to-benefits pattern this corpus documents across the AF branch and elsewhere, and it is precisely the kind of assumption a future session might import from a sibling country and get wrong. Note the near-miss that must NOT be read as a CPI edge: the 2026 budget law sets a separate indexation coefficient of «1,04» for certain court-ordered compensation payments, numerically equal to the same law's «не превышающего 4,0 процента» inflation forecast -- but the law never connects the two, and no edge may be drawn from the coincidence. Reason `denied` rather than `no-document` because a document positively states the mechanism to be something other than the proposed one.

_dropped.edge: ru-subsistence-minimum-law-134fz -> a titled Rosstat median-income / median-wage release
_dropped.why: The real dependency, with no available target. The statute defines what it depends on -- «медианный среднедушевой доход - величина денежного дохода, относительно которой половина населения … ежегодно исчисляется федеральным органом исполнительной власти, осуществляющим функции по формированию официальной статистической информации…» and «исчисляется исходя из величины медианной заработной платы, рассчитанной федеральным органом исполнительной власти…» -- but names no titled release, and does not even name the agency. A search of the OCR text returned 0 hits for `Росстат` and 0 for `статистик` as a standalone agency name; the law uses only the long statutory periphrasis. That periphrasis designates Rosstat by way of Постановление Правительства РФ от 2 июня 2008 г. № 420, which this round corroborated independently at TIER A because Rosstat's own Приказ № 915 opens by citing that same Положение -- so the identification is sound, but it is an INFERENCE ACROSS TWO DOCUMENTS rather than a naming, and no edge is minted on it. Two things would close this: a node for Rosstat's median-income publication, and a node for Постановление 420 itself, which would let the periphrasis-to-agency identification be represented as evidence rather than as reasoning in a note. Cross-reference worth keeping: the subsistence minimum re-enters the equalization calculation from the other side, since Постановление 670's provider table lists «38. Величина прожиточного минимума по субъектам Российской Федерации (рублей) — Росстат» as a regional input.

Structurally near-certain, textually unstated, and therefore not minted. The input-data archive is by construction the input to the per-region «уровень расчетной бюджетной обеспеченности» table, and both are published in the same Minfin `mb2026_2028` section for the same budget cycle. But no sentence in the distribution table's own text names the input-data publication, and this project's evidence standard does not accept structural inevitability as a substitute for a citation. Recorded as PLAUSIBLE rather than upgraded. The chain is not lost: the relationship is fully represented through Постановление 670, which both documents do cite -- `ru-minfin-2026-equalization -> ru-resolution-670-equalization-methodology` was minted at BRICS/G.1, and `ru-minfin-equalization-input-data -> ru-resolution-670-equalization-methodology` is minted in this file -- so the two Minfin publications are connected through the methodology that governs them both, which is the honest topology.

NOT FOUND in the right direction. An execution report of the budget a law approves is structurally a report against that law, but the Treasury's section landing page contains no sentence naming the budget law, and the report ZIPs themselves were not opened this round -- only section metadata was verified. The one relevant citation found runs the WRONG WAY: the budget law names the Treasury, not the reverse, in its Article 11: «Установить, что в 2026 - 2028 годах Федеральное казначейство в рамках осуществления операций по управлению остатками средств на едином счете федерального бюджета вправе предоставить бюджетам субъектов Российской Федерации бюджетные кредиты…». That is the law naming an executing agency, which is neither the direction nor the document-to-document shape this edge needs. Opening a single monthly report ZIP would very likely settle it -- a cheap, concrete lead for the next round.

_dropped.edge: ru-rosstat-cpi-methodology-915 -> выборочное обследование бюджетов домашних хозяйств (the household budget survey supplying the CPI weights)
_dropped.why: A named, real input with no node yet. Приказ № 915 states the weights source in its own text: «Для формирования Набора анализируются итоги выборочного обследования бюджетов домашних хозяйств, проводимого на территории всех субъектов Российской Федерации, в группировке Классификатора индивидуального потребления домашних хозяйств по целям (далее – КИПЦ-ДХ).» and «веса – мера относительной значимости товаров (услуг) в рамках сводного индекса цен, определяемая на основе потребительских расходов домашних хозяйств». The survey is named by title in Russian but was not separately located as a published release this round, so there is nothing to point at. Note the incidental supranational hook worth checking in a future round: «КИПЦ-ДХ» is the Russian rendering of COICOP, the UN classification of individual consumption by purpose, and this corpus already carries `un-coicop-2018` as a node -- if Приказ 915 or its annexes cite the COICOP version by year, that would be a documented supranational-to-national dependency of exactly the kind REPORTS.md's own secondary objective is looking for.

_dropped.edge: Budget Code art. 131's own text on a government-operated host (to replace the third-party mirror `ru-budget-code-art131` is sourced to)
_dropped.why: STILL UNRESOLVED, but far more precisely characterised than at BRICS/G.1, which recorded only that no working .gov.ru host was found. The official consolidated Budget Code IS on a government host and IS reachable: pravo.gov.ru's ИПС «Законодательство России» serves it at `http://pravo.gov.ru/proxy/ips/?doc_itself=&nd=102054721&rdk=249` (HTTP 200, 673,972 bytes). The blocker is that the ИПС viewer HARD-TRUNCATES its output at exactly 673,972 bytes, mid-Article 63 -- short of Article 131. Nine different pagination parameters were tried and every response was byte-identical, so this is a fixed server-side cap rather than a paging problem to be solved with the right query string. The `actual.pravo.gov.ru:8000` API was unreachable, and duma.gov.ru, government.ru and docs.cntd.ru all fail TLS even with the Russian national CA bundle that fixes Rosstat and Minfin. Two further access notes for whoever retries: pravo.gov.ru serves over HTTP only (`https://pravo.gov.ru/` fails outright), and its output is windows-1251 encoded, which renders as mojibake if decoded as UTF-8 and can easily be mistaken for a failed fetch. WHAT DID CHANGE: art. 131's ROLE is now corroborated at TIER A from a government host, because Постановление 670's enabling clause names it directly -- «В целях реализации статьи 131 Бюджетного кодекса Российской Федерации» -- so the node's substance no longer rests on the mirror alone, only its article text does.

_dropped.edge: The total дотации на выравнивание appropriation in the 2026 federal budget law (Приложения 28 and 30)
_dropped.why: NOT EXTRACTED, recorded honestly rather than left unmentioned. Article 10 of the budget law points at the annexes that carry the numbers -- «Утвердить бюджетные ассигнования на предоставление межбюджетных трансфертов бюджетам субъектов Российской Федерации и бюджету города Байконура на 2026 год … согласно приложению 28 … 3. Утвердить распределение межбюджетных трансфертов … согласно приложению 30» -- but those annexes sit inside a 5,381-page, ~196 MB image-only PDF with no text layer and no in-document index. Locating the equalization total would require OCR'ing a large fraction of the scan. The PER-REGION distribution is not affected and is available at TIER A from Minfin: `ru-minfin-2026-equalization` (BRICS/G.1) and `ru-minfin-equalization-input-data` (this file) both carry it.

_dropped.edge: Rosstat mirror and legacy hosts: gks.ru, fedstat.ru, showdata.gks.ru, eng.rosstat.gov.ru
_dropped.why: Genuinely unreachable, and recorded per-host with a distinct reason for each rather than as one blanket claim -- the difference matters, because the main `rosstat.gov.ru` failure that looked identical from the outside turned out to be fixable and these do not. `gks.ru`: TCP connection reset. `fedstat.ru`: HTTP 403, a WAF rejection rather than a transport failure. `showdata.gks.ru` and `eng.rosstat.gov.ru`: certificate failures that the Russian national CA bundle does NOT fix -- distinct from the main host's trust-store gap, and the reason it would be wrong to record "Rosstat is reachable now" without qualification. None of these blocks costs the branch anything at present, since the primary host serves the CPI product page, the definitions PDF, the methodology order and the live data files.

_status: NEW 2026-08-17. Russia's third slice, and the one that connects the Russian branch to the rest of the graph for the first time. After BRICS/G.2, Russia had twelve corpus nodes and ZERO edges to any non-Russian node -- a fully disconnected island. This round therefore asks REPORTS.md's own secondary-objective question of Russia directly: which supranational bodies issue a standard that a Russian statistic is documented as methodologically dependent on? The answer is: four of them, in seven documented edges, every one with the edition named in the Russian document's own text. Six new Russian source nodes are minted to carry those edges -- Rosstat's household-sector national-accounts methodology, Rosstat's GDP dissemination procedure, the Bank of Russia's balance-of-payments and IIP methodological commentaries, the Bank of Russia's SDDS section, Minfin's numbered government-finance-statistics order, and Minfin's GFSM correspondence table. The seventh edge runs from an EXISTING node, `ru-rosstat-cpi-methodology-915` (BRICS/G.2), straight to the IMF/ILO Consumer Price Index Manual, which means Russia's CPI chain is now attached to the international layer without any new node at all. Four deliberate refusals are recorded in `_dropped` and are as important as the positives: every COICOP citation Rosstat makes is unversioned, and in one case the dating positively argues AGAINST the edge the corpus could have drawn. `sna-2008` also had to be refused twice from documents that mention the System of National Accounts without a year, even though the same edge is minted from other Rosstat orders that do name it.
_note: ACCESS AND VERIFICATION. All sources TIER A -- plain curl, genuine HTTP 200, real document bytes on the issuing agency's own host. The Russian national-CA trust-store fix from BRICS/G.2 was reused and is confirmed working, with two corrections to that round's write-up: (1) the root is at `https://gu-st.ru/content/lending/russian_trusted_root_ca_pem.crt` -- the `root_ca_ssl_rsa2022.crt` path recorded at G.2 now 404s; (2) the 2024 sub-CA's Subject Key Identifier is confirmed in full as `77:3D:D9:39:AF:42:BD:DC:5B:CA:76:EA:EE:FD:CE:3E:61:29:30:5F`. A new practical detail: the root and sub-CA must be concatenated with explicit newlines between files or curl fails with error 77. TWO NEW HOST BEHAVIOURS found this round. `minfin.gov.ru` now returns HTTP 503 («Доступ к сайту временно ограничен владельцем веб-ресурса») to a bare curl on any sub-path -- the fix is to fetch `https://minfin.gov.ru/ru/` first with a real browser User-Agent, save cookies, then reuse them with a matching `Referer`; WebFetch fails entirely on this host because its robots.txt itself 503s. And the Bank of Russia has MOVED its balance-of-payments section: the `cbr.ru/statistics/macro_itm/svs/` path returns 404, the current location is `cbr.ru/statistics/macro_itm/external_sector/pb/`. reports.title: Приказ Росстата от 18.05.2023 № 233 «Об утверждении Официальной статистической методологии построения нефинансовых счетов сектора домашних хозяйств в Системе национальных счетов Российской Федерации»
reports.description: Rosstat's approved official statistical methodology for compiling the household sector's non-financial accounts within Russia's system of national accounts -- and the document that finally pins Russia's national accounts to a NAMED edition of the international standard. Its opening provisions state the derivation directly: «Цель данной методологии – разработка алгоритма формирования показателей нефинансовых счетов сектора домашних хозяйств в системе национальных счетов Российской Федерации на основе Руководства «Система национальных счетов 2008»¹ (далее – СНС 2008).» ("The purpose of this methodology is to develop the algorithm for compiling the indicators of the non-financial accounts of the household sector in the system of national accounts of the Russian Federation ON THE BASIS OF the Manual 'System of National Accounts 2008' (hereinafter SNA 2008).") The edition is pinned twice, the second time by a full bibliographic footnote naming all five sponsoring organisations: «¹ Система национальных счетов 2008: Пер. с англ. / Еврокомиссия, МВФ, ОЭСР, ООН, Всемирный банк. – Нью-Йорк, 2012.» and again in the terminology note: «При подготовке документа использована терминология, зафиксированная в русскоязычном издании СНС 2008 года, опубликованном Секретариатом ООН в 2012 году.» «СНС 2008» is stated 44 times in this single document. This node was selected as the representative Rosstat national-accounts instrument from a family of at least six that name the 2008 edition in their opening clause -- see `_dropped` for the full list, several using an even stronger conformance verb («в соответствии с требованиями» = "in accordance with the requirements of") than this one. Fetched TIER A from Rosstat's own host via the national-CA bundle.
reports.cadence_note: A standing methodological instrument approved by Rosstat order, amended rather than reissued on a cadence -- the same convention this corpus applies to `ru-rosstat-cpi-methodology-915` and to statutes elsewhere. Many instruments in this Rosstat family carry live amendment notes such as «(с изменениями, внесенными приказом Росстата от 26.08.2025 № 426)», confirming they are current rather than archival.

reports.title: Порядок разработки и представления данных по валовому внутреннему продукту (Procedure for compiling and releasing gross domestic product data)
reports.description: Rosstat's own procedure governing when and how Russian GDP data are released -- and the document in which a Russian statistical release timetable is stated to be determined by an IMF standard. Verbatim: «Сроки представления данных по ВВП публикуются в «Федеральном плане статистических работ» и соответствуют срокам публикации этого показателя, определенным Специальным стандартом распространения данных МВФ, к которому присоединилась Россия 31 января 2005 года.» ("The release dates for GDP data are published in the 'Federal Plan of Statistical Works' and correspond to the publication deadlines for this indicator ESTABLISHED BY the IMF's Special Data Dissemination Standard, to which Russia acceded on 31 January 2005.") The same document also cites the IMF's Quarterly National Accounts Manual by year for its time-series methods -- «на основе методов, изложенных в «Руководстве по квартальным национальным счетам», разработанным под эгидой МВФ в 2001 году» -- an instrument the corpus does not yet hold; see `_dropped`. Note the document's own SNA reference is UNVERSIONED and is deliberately not used for an edge (see `_dropped`). Fetched TIER A from Rosstat's own host, linked from the national-accounts methodology index page.
reports.cadence_note: A standing procedural document rather than a recurring release; it governs the cadence of GDP publication rather than having one of its own. PROVENANCE WEAKNESS, recorded plainly: unlike the Rosstat приказы in this file it is undated on its face and carries no order number, so it is a Rosstat web publication rather than a numbered legal instrument -- Rosstat-authored and Rosstat-hosted, but a weaker tier of provenance.

reports.title: Методологический комментарий к платежному балансу Российской Федерации (Methodological commentary on the balance of payments of the Russian Federation)
reports.description: The Bank of Russia's methodological statement for the Russian balance of payments, and about as explicit a methodological-dependency claim as this corpus contains. Its opening line: «Концептуальной и методологической основой является шестое издание Руководства по платежному балансу и международной инвестиционной позиции МВФ (РПБ6).» ("The conceptual and methodological basis IS the SIXTH EDITION of the IMF's Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6).") The dependency runs through the presentation as well as the concepts: «Основные агрегаты представляют собой набор главных компонентов платежного баланса, рекомендованных в РПБ6…» and a section headed «Интерпретация знаков платежного баланса (согласно РПБ6)». Corroborated twice more, both times with BPM6's publication YEAR also named, in the Bank's own IMF-SDDS metadata sheets: the external-debt sheet states «Методологической и концептуальной основой статистики внешнего долга является шестое издание «Руководства по платежному балансу и международной инвестиционной позиции» (РПБ6) Международного Валютного Фонда, 2009…», and the balance-of-payments sheet states «Методологической и концептуальной основой статистики платежного баланса является шестое издание «Руководства по платежному балансу и международной инвестиционной позиции» Международного Валютного Фонда (РПБ6).» A parallel commentary exists for the international investment position with identical wording; it is treated as corroboration rather than minted separately (see `_dropped`). Fetched TIER A from cbr.ru -- note the section has MOVED from the path recorded at G.2, see this file's `_note`.
reports.cadence_note: A standing methodological commentary accompanying the Bank of Russia's quarterly balance-of-payments statistics, revised as methodology changes rather than issued on a cadence. PROVENANCE WEAKNESS, stated plainly: it is a web methodological commentary rather than a numbered CBR normative act (указание/положение), though it is first-party Bank of Russia content on the Bank's own host.

reports.title: Специальный стандарт МВФ на распространение данных (ССРД МВФ) — раздел Банка России
reports.description: The Bank of Russia's SDDS section -- functionally Russia's National Summary Data Page entry point, and the single document that shows the SDDS obligation reaching across all three Russian statistical producers at once. Verbatim: «Специальный стандарт МВФ на распространение данных (ССРД МВФ) … Календарь предварительных сроков публикации данных, распространяемых Банком России в соответствии с требованиями Специального стандарта Международного валютного фонда на распространение данных (ССРД МВФ). Рубрика содержит данные, распространяемые Банком России в соответствии с требованиями ССРД МВФ. Применительно к требованиям ССРД МВФ распространяются также: Данные Росстат, Данные Минфина России, Доска объявлений ССРД МВФ, Информация о ССРД МВФ» ("…Advance release calendar for data disseminated by the Bank of Russia IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE REQUIREMENTS of the IMF's Special Data Dissemination Standard… Also disseminated in relation to the IMF SDDS requirements: ROSSTAT data, MINISTRY OF FINANCE data…"). That last clause is independent Russian-side corroboration of the Rosstat GDP-to-SDDS edge minted in this file from a completely different document. TWO WEAKNESSES recorded rather than glossed: the page footer reads «Последнее обновление страницы: 27.09.2023», and the page makes no statement about Russia's SDDS participation after 2022 -- so the edge asserts what the Bank of Russia's page claims, not independently verified live SDDS subscription. Fetched TIER A from cbr.ru.
reports.cadence_note: A standing website section rather than a recurring publication; it hosts an advance release calendar whose entries follow the SDDS timeliness requirements. Minted because it is the Russian-hosted, Russian-authored statement of the SDDS obligation, which is what the evidence standard requires -- an IMF-side claim of Russian coverage would not qualify.

reports.title: Приказ Минфина России от 09.09.2021 № 128н «Об утверждении Порядка формирования информации по статистике государственных финансов»
reports.description: Minfin's numbered, Minjust-registered order establishing how Russian government finance statistics are compiled -- and the strongest form of international dependency found anywhere in the Russian branch, because the IMF standard is not merely referenced but recited as part of the LEGAL AUTHORITY under which the order is issued. Preamble, verbatim: «В соответствии с абзацем двадцать четвертым статьи 165 и абзацем двадцать вторым пункта 1 статьи 166.1 Бюджетного кодекса Российской Федерации …, а также в рамках реализации Федерального закона от 3 октября 2014 г. № 279-ФЗ … постановления Верховного Совета Российской Федерации от 22 мая 1992 г. № 2815-1 "О вступлении Российской Федерации в Международный валютный фонд…" …, постановления Правительства Российской Федерации от 26 сентября 1997 г. № 1226 "О присоединении Российской Федерации к Специальному стандарту распространения данных МВФ" …, в целях совершенствования методологии формирования информации по статистике государственных финансов п р и к а з ы в а ю:» The accompanying Порядок adds the operative obligations: §2 requires compilation «с учетом соответствия показателей Информации по СГФ Российской Федерации требованиям специальных стандартов по распространению данных о государственных финансах…», and §22 requires the Federal Treasury to transmit the data «в Международный валютный фонд» on a fixed month/quarter/year timetable. Note that the Порядок's own references to GFS MANUALS are unversioned and plural («руководствами по распространению (раскрытию) данных…»), so no GFSM edge is drawn from this document -- that edge is carried by the correspondence table below, which does name the edition. Preamble read from the native `.doc` inside `128n_reg.zip` (UTF-16LE text, not OCR) and independently confirmed by OCR of page 1 of the scanned PDF.
reports.cadence_note: A standing normative order, amended rather than reissued on a cadence. The Порядок it approves drives a fixed monthly/quarterly/annual transmission timetable to the IMF, which is the recurring activity; the order itself is not a recurring release.

reports.title: Таблица соответствия кодов классификации доходов и статей (подстатей) КОСГУ кодам Классификации доходов, установленным Руководством по статистике государственных финансов (СГФ-2014)

dependencies.basis: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A, and the most valuable edge in this file because it runs from an EXISTING Russian node straight into the international layer with no new node required -- it is what connects Russia's CPI chain to the rest of the graph. Приказ Росстата № 915's Приложение № 1, п. 2 states its own derivation: «Методология подготовлена с учетом международных рекомендаций, изложенных в «Резолюции об индексах потребительских цен», принятой 17-ой Международной конференцией статистиков труда, и «Руководстве по индексу потребительских цен: Концепции и Методы»¹, разработанном Межсекретариатской рабочей группой по статистике цен (МРГСЦ), включая Евростат, Международной организацией труда (МОТ), Международным валютным фондом (МВФ), Организацией экономического сотрудничества и развития (ОЭСР), Европейской экономической комиссией Организации Объединенных Наций (ЕЭК ООН) и Всемирным банком.» THE EDITION IS PINNED IN FOOTNOTE 1, printed in English in the Russian original: «¹ Consumer price index manual: Concepts and Methods / 2020 / International Labour Organization/International Monetary Fund/Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development/Statistical Office of the European Union (Eurostat)/United Nations Economic Commission for Europe/The World Bank. https://www.imf.org/en/Data/Statistics/cpi-manual.» That is the 2020 edition, naming all six sponsoring organisations and the IMF-hosted URL, and it matches the `cpi-manual` node, whose own description identifies it as the 2020 edition updating the 2004 ILO-managed predecessor -- checked before minting, because had the node been the 2004 edition this edge would have had to be refused. WEAKNESS STATED: «с учетом» means "taking into account", which is softer than «в соответствии с» ("in accordance with"); this is an acknowledged-guidance dependency rather than a mandatory conformance claim. `methodology_depends_on` is still correct -- the manual supplies the method the Russian instrument is built on -- but the hedge is real and is recorded here rather than smoothed away.

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A, with the edition named unambiguously and repeatedly. The methodology's stated purpose is derivation from the standard: «Цель данной методологии – разработка алгоритма формирования показателей нефинансовых счетов сектора домашних хозяйств в системе национальных счетов Российской Федерации на основе Руководства «Система национальных счетов 2008»¹ (далее – СНС 2008).» The footnote gives a full bibliographic citation -- «¹ Система национальных счетов 2008: Пер. с англ. / Еврокомиссия, МВФ, ОЭСР, ООН, Всемирный банк. – Нью-Йорк, 2012.» -- and a terminology note confirms which edition's language is used: «При подготовке документа использована терминология, зафиксированная в русскоязычном издании СНС 2008 года, опубликованном Секретариатом ООН в 2012 году.» «СНС 2008» appears 44 times in the document. `methodology_depends_on` rather than `cites`: «на основе Руководства…» ("on the basis of the Manual") is a derivation claim in a legally approved official statistical methodology, not a background mention. SCOPE WEAKNESS, stated: this is a SECTORAL methodology (household non-financial accounts), so the edge is narrower than "Russian national accounts depend on SNA 2008" in general -- but at least five sibling Rosstat orders make the same citation for other parts of the accounts, several with a stronger conformance verb, and they are listed in `_dropped` so a future round can broaden the coverage without re-researching it.

SELF-DECLARED: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A. Rosstat states that its GDP release timetable is determined by the IMF standard: «Сроки представления данных по ВВП публикуются в «Федеральном плане статистических работ» и соответствуют срокам публикации этого показателя, определенным Специальным стандартом распространения данных МВФ, к которому присоединилась Россия 31 января 2005 года.» ("The release dates for GDP data … correspond to the publication deadlines for this indicator ESTABLISHED BY the IMF's Special Data Dissemination Standard, to which Russia acceded on 31 January 2005.") NO EDITION PROBLEM: the SDDS is a single named standard rather than an edition series, the corpus holds one `imf-sdds` node, and the Russian text names it in full («Специальный стандарт распространения данных МВФ») and pins the accession date. `methodology_depends_on` because the dependency is real and operative, with the scope stated honestly: it is a dependency on the SDDS's TIMELINESS dimension -- what must be published when -- not on GDP concepts, which come from the SNA. Independently corroborated from a different institution's document: the Bank of Russia's own SDDS page states that the same requirements cover «Данные Росстат».

VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A, and the most explicit methodological-dependency statement found in the Russian branch. The commentary's opening line: «Концептуальной и методологической основой является шестое издание Руководства по платежному балансу и международной инвестиционной позиции МВФ (РПБ6).» ("The conceptual and methodological basis IS the sixth edition of the IMF's Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6).") The dependency governs presentation as well as concepts -- «Основные агрегаты представляют собой набор главных компонентов платежного баланса, рекомендованных в РПБ6…» and «Интерпретация знаков платежного баланса (согласно РПБ6)». EDITION NAMED unambiguously as «шестое издание» plus the abbreviation РПБ6, matching `imf-bpm6` exactly; two Bank of Russia SDDS metadata sheets corroborate with the publication YEAR as well, e.g. «…шестое издание «Руководства по платежному балансу и международной инвестиционной позиции» (РПБ6) Международного Валютного Фонда, 2009…». WEAKNESS STATED: it is a web methodological commentary rather than a numbered CBR normative act, though first-party and Bank-hosted.

SELF-DECLARED: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A. The Bank of Russia states the conformance in its own words: «Календарь предварительных сроков публикации данных, распространяемых Банком России в соответствии с требованиями Специального стандарта Международного валютного фонда на распространение данных (ССРД МВФ). Рубрика содержит данные, распространяемые Банком России в соответствии с требованиями ССРД МВФ.» («в соответствии с требованиями» = "in accordance with the requirements of", a conformance claim covering both the advance release calendar and the data coverage). `methodology_depends_on` on that conformance wording; `cites` would be the conservative fallback and the difference is worth noting rather than hiding. TWO WEAKNESSES recorded: the page was last updated 27.09.2023, and it says nothing about Russia's SDDS participation after 2022 -- this edge asserts what the Bank of Russia's own page claims, not independently verified live subscription.

SELF-DECLARED: VERIFIED DIRECTLY, TIER A, and structurally the strongest dependency in the Russian branch even though it is typed conservatively. The SDDS appears in the ENABLING PREAMBLE of a numbered, Minjust-registered Minfin order -- part of the legal authority under which the government-finance-statistics procedure is issued, not a methodological reference: «…постановления Правительства Российской Федерации от 26 сентября 1997 г. № 1226 "О присоединении Российской Федерации к Специальному стандарту распространения данных МВФ" …, в целях совершенствования методологии формирования информации по статистике государственных финансов п р и к а з ы в а ю:». The standard's full Russian name appears verbatim in the order's own text, so the requirement that the dependent document name the standard itself is satisfied, even though the immediate instrument cited is the 1997 Government Resolution effecting accession. `cites` rather than `methodology_depends_on` DELIBERATELY: the SDDS here supplies legal authority and a transmission obligation (the Порядок §22 requires Treasury transmission «в Международный валютный фонд» on a fixed timetable), while the compilation METHOD the order actually prescribes is described only by unversioned reference to «руководствами по распространению (раскрытию) данных» -- so a methodology-typed edge would overstate what this document says. A TENSE/EVENT NOTE worth preserving: Постановление № 1226 is dated 1997 while Rosstat's GDP procedure gives Russia's SDDS accession as 31 January 2005. These are two different events -- the 1997 resolution authorises accession, 2005 is the subscription date -- and they are not contradictory.

The table's own title states that Russia's revenue and KOSGU classification codes are mapped onto the classification «установленным Руководством по статистике государственных финансов (СГФ - 2014)» ("established by the Government Finance Statistics Manual (GFSM 2014)"). «СГФ - 2014» is GFSM 2014, matching the `imf-gfsm` node exactly. `methodology_depends_on`: the Russian classification codes are made to conform to the GFSM 2014 revenue classification for reporting purposes, which is method rather than citation. TWO WEAKNESSES STATED PLAINLY, and the reason this is minted from the table rather than from Приказ 128н: (a) the citation is in the TITLE of a methodological correspondence table, not in the operative text of a numbered order -- the operative text of 128н and its Порядок were searched and name only unversioned, plural «руководствами», which is why no GFSM edge is drawn from that node; (b) the workbook is republished annually at a year-stamped URL that will move, though the «(СГФ - 2014)» wording has been stable across the 2024, 2025 and 2026 editions.
dependencies.evidence_quote: установленным Руководством по статистике государственных финансов (СГФ - 2014)

_dropped.why: REFUSED ON THE EDITION RULE, and this is the clearest case in the round of a refusal that is affirmatively right rather than merely cautious. Приказ 915 does discuss COICOP substantively -- «12.1 Классификация индивидуального потребления по целям (Classification Of Individual Consumption By Purpose – COICOP) является одной из четырех функциональных классификаций Системы национальных счетов…» -- and names «КИПЦ-ДХ» as the classifier used to build the CPI weights. But a full-text search of all 96 pages returned ZERO occurrences of `2018`, `1999`, `COICOP 2018` or `КИПЦ 2018`; every mention is unversioned. Since the corpus holds `un-coicop-2018` and `un-coicop-hbs-1999` as separate nodes, choosing between them would assert something the document does not say. TWO ADDED HAZARDS worth recording. First, Rosstat uses TWO distinct classifiers -- «КИПЦ» (the CPI aggregation classifier, §12.1) and «КИПЦ-ДХ» (the household-budget-survey classifier behind the weights, §§21, 42, 43) -- which are plausibly descended from the main COICOP and from COICOP-HBS respectively, but the document never says so and guessing the mapping is exactly the fabricated-edge failure this project guards against. Second, and decisively: a sibling Rosstat instrument states that «КИПЦ-ДХ» was approved by Rosstat order № 304 of 2 AUGUST 2013 -- which PREDATES COICOP 2018 -- so an edge to `un-coicop-2018` would be not merely unsupported but affirmatively likely to be WRONG. Recorded at length so a future session does not read the strong derivation wording quoted in the next entry and mint it anyway.

_dropped.edge: ru-rosstat-osm-233-household-accounts -> un-coicop-2018 (the strongest COICOP derivation wording found, still unusable)
_dropped.why: REFUSED, despite carrying the strongest COICOP derivation language located anywhere in Russian primary text. §3.6.22 of the household-accounts methodology reads: «…используется Классификатор индивидуального потребления домашних хозяйств по целям (КИПЦ-ДХ), утвержденный приказом Росстата от 2 августа 2013 г. № 304. Классификация КИПЦ разработана на основе функциональной классификации Classification Of Individual Consumption By Purpose (COICOP) и соответствует СНС 2008.» ("The КИПЦ classification WAS DEVELOPED ON THE BASIS OF the functional classification COICOP and conforms to SNA 2008.") «разработана на основе … COICOP» is a textbook `methodology_depends_on` phrasing -- and it is still unusable, because the year in that sentence («2008») attaches to СНС, not to COICOP, and COICOP itself is bare. Note the same sentence independently CORROBORATES the `sna-2008` edge minted from this node, so the document is doing real work in the graph regardless. A future round wanting this edge should look for Rosstat order № 304 of 02.08.2013 itself, which may name the COICOP edition it was built from -- though see the preceding entry: a 2013 instrument cannot descend from COICOP 2018.

REFUSED TWICE on the edition rule, from two different documents, even though the same edge IS minted in this file from a third document that names the year -- which is the edition rule behaving exactly as designed rather than inconsistently. (1) Приказ 915 §12.1 mentions «Системы национальных счетов» with no year; «СНС» does not appear anywhere in the document and there is no `2008`/`1993`/`2025` in the text. It is in any case an incidental descriptive mention rather than a dependency claim. (2) The GDP dissemination procedure says «ВВП формируется в соответствии с методологическими положениями по построению национальных счетов России, утвержденными Росстатом на основе концепций системы национальных счетов, разработанных под эгидой ООН…» -- "on the basis of the concepts of the system of national accounts developed under the auspices of the UN", again with no year. `sna-2008` and `sna-2025` are separate nodes and neither sentence can select between them. The Russian national-accounts dependency on SNA 2008 is real and is carried by `ru-rosstat-osm-233-household-accounts`, whose text names the edition 44 times.

_dropped.edge: Five further Rosstat official statistical methodologies naming «СНС 2008» explicitly, as additional nodes
_dropped.why: NOT A GAP -- a deliberately deferred expansion, recorded so a future round does not have to re-find them. `ru-rosstat-osm-233-household-accounts` was minted as ONE representative instrument from a family of at least six Rosstat orders that each name the 2008 edition in their opening clause, all verified at HTTP 200 this round: Приказ № 959 от 27.12.2021 (land valuation, `met_959-27122021.pdf`) «…в соответствии с требованиями Системы национальных счетов 2008 года (СНС 2008)¹»; Приказ № 216 от 16.04.2021 (current market value of fixed assets, `met_216-16042021.pdf`), same wording; Приказ № 816 от 28.12.2019 (balance sheet of assets and liabilities and accumulation accounts, `met_816-28122019.pdf`), same wording; Приказ № 471 от 10.09.2025, Приложения 5-6 (generation of income account, `met471-10092025_(pril_5_6).pdf`) «Методология базируется на методологических принципах международного стандарта «Система национальных счетов» 2008 года» -- notable for explicitly calling SNA 2008 an INTERNATIONAL STANDARD, the cleanest phrasing for this project's purposes; Приказ № 172 от 09.04.2026 (production account, financial corporations sector, `met170_09042026.pdf`) «Концептуальной основой Методологии являются положения Системы национальных счетов 2008 года¹…»; and Приказ № 547 от 07.09.2018 (stocks of consumer durables, `met_547-07092018.pdf`). NOTE that three of these use «в соответствии с требованиями» ("in accordance with the REQUIREMENTS of") -- a STRONGER conformance verb than the «на основе» of the minted node -- so a future round may wish to promote one of them to be the primary carrier of this edge. All are live instruments, several carrying 2025 amendment notes.

_dropped.edge: ru-cbr-iip-methodological-commentary -> imf-bpm6, as a separate node
_dropped.why: VERIFIED but deliberately not minted, to avoid a duplicate node carrying an identical edge. The Bank of Russia's international-investment-position commentary (`cbr.ru/statistics/macro_itm/external_sector/iip/meth_com_iip/`, HTTP 200 47941) opens with wording essentially identical to the balance-of-payments commentary: «Концептуальной и методологической основой является шестое издание Руководства по платежному балансу и международной инвестиционной позиции Международного валютного фонда (РПБ6).» Since BPM6 is a single manual covering both the balance of payments and the IIP, and the corpus already carries the BoP commentary as a node with that edge, this is recorded as corroboration. A future round that wants the Russian external-sector statistics represented at finer grain has a ready, verified second node here.

NOT FOUND, tested exhaustively rather than assumed. A full-text search of the 96-page Приказ 915 returned ZERO occurrences of every one of: `МСОК`, `ISIC`, `КДЕС`, `NACE`, `ОКПД`, `Гармонизированн`, `SDMX`, `СДМХ`, `SDDS`, `ОСРД`. The document does invoke Russia's own activity classifier -- «Общероссийский классификатор видов экономической деятельности ОКВЭД 2 (ОК 034-2014)», п.12.3 -- but says nothing about ОКВЭД's NACE or ISIC derivation, so no ISIC edge can be drawn from it. Two unattributed appeals to «международные стандарты» ("international standards") appear with no standard named and are not usable. An ОКВЭД-to-ISIC edge is likely to exist somewhere in Rosstat's classifier documentation and is a clean lead for a future round -- just not in this document.

_dropped.edge: Minfin / Russian public-sector accounting standards -> ipsas
_dropped.why: NOT FOUND, and recorded prominently because the claim that Russia follows IPSAS is common in secondary literature and is NOT supported by primary Minfin text. Four Minfin documents were fetched and searched (all HTTP 200 via the cookie-plus-User-Agent method), three of them image-only scans OCR'd with tesseract `-l rus`: the public-sector accounting hub page; Приказ № 54н от 25.04.2023 approving the 2023-2026 programme for developing federal public-finance accounting standards -- ZERO occurrences of «МСФО», «общественного сектора» or «международн», its enabling clause citing only ФЗ № 402-ФЗ and ПП РФ № 329; Приказ № 256н от 31.12.2016, the СГС «Концептуальные основы» standard -- ZERO occurrences of the same terms; and Письмо Минфина № 02-07-07/83463 on the leases standard, whose only relevant wording is the UNNAMED «…предусмотрено с учетом международной практики дополнительное раскрытие…» ("taking into account international practice"), with no standard named and no IPSAS number. WHAT MINFIN DOES HAVE, and why it still is not an edge: Minfin publishes the official Russian translation of IPSAS («Сборник "Международные стандарты финансовой отчетности общественного сектора". Официальный перевод на русский язык», 18.07.2012) and a 2011 procurement record for translating the 2010 version. That is Minfin HOSTING and TRANSLATING IPSAS, not a Russian instrument declaring a Russian standard methodologically dependent on it. A translation programme is not a dependency statement.

_dropped.edge: ru-rosstat-cpi-methodology-915 -> ICLS 17th Resolution concerning consumer price indices (2003)
_dropped.why: A fully evidenced edge with no node to point at, and one that must NOT be forced onto the node that looks closest. Приказ 915 names it in the same sentence as the CPI Manual: «…международных рекомендаций, изложенных в «Резолюции об индексах потребительских цен», принятой 17-ой Международной конференцией статистиков труда…» ("…the international recommendations set out in the 'Resolution concerning consumer price indices' adopted by the 17th International Conference of Labour Statisticians…"). The citation names the CONFERENCE NUMBER (17th), which pins the instrument unambiguously, so this would be a `methodology_depends_on` edge at STRONG confidence the moment a node exists. CRITICAL WARNING: the corpus's existing `icls-work-statistics-resolution` node is the 19th ICLS resolution of 2013 on statistics of WORK, EMPLOYMENT AND LABOUR UNDERUTILIZATION -- a different instrument, from a different conference, on a different subject. Pointing this edge at it would be a wrong-target error of exactly the kind the edition rule exists to prevent. The correct target is the ILO's *Resolution concerning consumer price indices*, 17th ICLS, Geneva 2003 (`https://www.ilo.org/resource/conference-paper/resolution-concerning-consumer-price-indices`), which needs minting as its own node.

_dropped.edge: ru-rosstat-gdp-dissemination-procedure -> IMF Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2001)
_dropped.why: A fully evidenced, EDITION-NAMED citation of an international manual the corpus does not hold. Rosstat's GDP procedure states: «Динамические ряды ВВП и его компонентов строятся на основе методов, изложенных в «Руководстве по квартальным национальным счетам», разработанным под эгидой МВФ в 2001 году¹⁾ и с учетом национальной практики.» ("Time series of GDP and its components are constructed on the basis of the methods set out in the 'Quarterly National Accounts Manual', developed under the auspices of the IMF IN 2001, and taking into account national practice.") Target would be the IMF's *Quarterly National Accounts Manual: Concepts, Data Sources, and Compilation* (2001 edition), `https://www.imf.org/external/pubs/ft/qna/2000/textbook/`. Would be `methodology_depends_on` at STRONG confidence. Minting this international node would also likely serve other branches -- most national statistical offices producing quarterly accounts cite it.

_dropped.edge: Постановление Правительства РФ от 26.09.1997 № 1226 «О присоединении Российской Федерации к Специальному стандарту распространения данных МВФ» as an intermediate node
_dropped.why: The ideal shape for Russia's SDDS chain, not yet available. This is the Russian legal instrument of SDDS accession, recited by name in Приказ 128н's own preamble and published in СЗ РФ 1997, № 40, ст. 4594. With it minted, the chain becomes `ru-minfin-prikaz-128n-gfs-procedure` → ПП-1226 → `imf-sdds`, which represents the actual legal architecture more faithfully than the direct edge minted in this file. Its full text was not retrieved this round (pravo.gov.ru's ИПС viewer has the hard-truncation problem documented in `ru-g2-rosstat-equalization.json`). NOTE the date discrepancy already reconciled and recorded on the minted edge: ПП № 1226 is dated 1997 while Rosstat gives Russia's SDDS accession as 31 January 2005 -- the resolution authorises accession, 2005 is the subscription; not a contradiction.

reports.title: Постановление Правительства РФ от 2 июня 2008 г. № 420 «О Федеральной службе государственной статистики»
reports.description: The Russian Government resolution establishing Rosstat's statutory mandate as the federal executive body responsible for official statistical information — the instrument that Rosstat's own orders (e.g. Приказ №915) cite as their basis, and that the periphrasis used elsewhere in Russian statistical law ('the federal executive body responsible for forming official statistical information') refers back to.

reports.title: Federal Law No. 282-FZ of 29 November 2007 “On Official Statistical Accounting and the System of State Statistics in the Russian Federation”
reports.publisher: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation / State Duma
reports.description: Foundational federal law establishing the legal basis for official statistical accounting and the system of state statistics in the Russian Federation. Defines subjects of official statistical accounting (including Rosstat and the Bank of Russia), the obligation to apply official statistical methodology, the Federal Plan for Statistical Works, confidentiality of primary data, and the production and dissemination of official statistical information. Multiple subsequent amendments (latest relevant revisions through 2024–2025). All Rosstat series and methodologies cite this law as the primary legal foundation.

reports.title: Government Decree No. 420 of 2 June 2008 “On the Federal State Statistics Service” (Statute on Rosstat)
reports.description: Statute defining the status, functions and powers of the Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat) as the federal executive body responsible for forming official statistical information on social, economic, demographic, environmental and other processes in the Russian Federation. Implements and operationalises Federal Law 282-FZ. Subsequent amendments maintain its force.

reports.title: National Accounts of the Russian Federation — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.description: System of national accounts compiled by Rosstat in accordance with SNA 2008. Includes GDP at current and constant prices by production, expenditure and income approaches, value-added by sector, and related accounts and tables. Methodology and dissemination are governed by Federal Law 282-FZ and the Statute on Rosstat. Russian national-accounts data are a core input to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication national-accounts chapter.

reports.title: Population Statistics — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.description: Official population statistics of the Russian Federation produced by Rosstat, including current population estimates, vital statistics and related demographic indicators. Disseminated under the framework of Federal Law 282-FZ and the Federal Plan for Statistical Works. Population data are regularly contributed to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication.

reports.title: Employment and Unemployment Statistics — Official Statistical Information of Rosstat
reports.description: Official labour-market statistics covering employment, unemployment, wages and related indicators. Produced by Rosstat under the legal framework of Federal Law 282-FZ. Labour-force and employment data appear in the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication and in Rosstat SDDS metadata.

reports.title: Federal Plan for Statistical Works (approved by Government Order No. 671-r of 6 May 2008, as amended)
reports.description: Government-approved plan that schedules the production and dissemination of official statistical information by all subjects of official statistical accounting (Rosstat, Bank of Russia and others). Specific items (e.g., 1.29.3 for CPI) determine publication frequency and timeliness. The Plan is the operational instrument that implements Federal Law 282-FZ for the annual and monthly statistical work programme.

reports.title: Bank of Russia Annual Report
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Annual report of the Bank of Russia prepared pursuant to Federal Law No. 86-FZ of 10 July 2002 “On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)”. Contains analysis of the economic situation, monetary policy, financial market, balance of payments, international reserves, payment systems, and the Bank’s own financial statements. Recent editions (including 2024) reference BRICS payment-cooperation work and the BRICS Cross-Border Payments Initiative.

reports.title: Balance of Payments, International Investment Position and External Debt of the Russian Federation — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Official statistics on the balance of payments, international investment position and external debt compiled and disseminated by the Bank of Russia. Form part of the external-sector statistical framework used in CRA-related analysis and appear in the Bank of Russia Annual Report and related publications. Relevant to Russia’s commitments and analytical support under the BRICS Contingent Reserve Arrangement.

reports.title: International Reserves of the Russian Federation — Bank of Russia
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
reports.description: Weekly and monthly data on the international (gold and foreign-exchange) reserves of the Russian Federation published by the Bank of Russia. Constitute a core external-sector indicator relevant to liquidity and CRA-related analysis. Disseminated on the Bank of Russia website and summarised in the Annual Report.

reports.title: Russia: Statistical Pocketbook (annual)
reports.description: Annual statistical pocketbook published by Rosstat providing concise official data and infographics on the socio-economic situation of the Russian Federation (demography, labour market, living standards, prices, trade, finance, foreign economic activity, etc.). Serves as a widely disseminated summary of core Rosstat series.

reports.title: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast Statistical Yearbook (Статистический ежегодник «Нижегородская область»)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Nizhegorodstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Volga Federal District). Multi-year data on population, labour, living standards, industry, construction, trade, investment and social sphere. Electronic editions (PDF/RAR) published regularly; latest cover windows up to 2025.

reports.title: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast in Figures (Нижегородская область в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Nizhegorodstat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook with a compact presentation of key socio-economic indicators.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Nizhegorodstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational report on the socio-economic situation of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast. High-frequency counterpart to the annual yearbook series.

reports.title: Samara Statistical Yearbook (Самарский статистический ежегодник)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Samara Oblast (Samarastat)
reports.description: Principal annual statistical publication for Samara Oblast (Volga Federal District, major industrial and automotive centre). Covers population, labour, living standards, industry, trade, investment and social indicators. Long electronic series available.

reports.title: Samara Oblast in Figures (Самарская область в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Samara Oblast (Samarastat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for Samara Oblast. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Samara Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Samara Oblast (Samarastat)
reports.description: Recurring (monthly) report on the socio-economic situation of Samara Oblast. High-frequency layer feeding the annual yearbook.

reports.title: Statistical Yearbook of Chelyabinsk Oblast (Статистический ежегодник по Челябинской области)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Chelyabinsk Oblast (Chelyabinskstat)
reports.description: Most complete annual statistical publication for Chelyabinsk Oblast (Urals Federal District, major industrial and metallurgical centre). Multi-year data on population, labour, industry, construction, trade and social sphere. Electronic editions published regularly; appendix of socio-economic indicators also issued.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Chelyabinsk Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Chelyabinsk Oblast (Chelyabinskstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational publications and monthly reports on the socio-economic situation of Chelyabinsk Oblast. High-frequency counterpart to the annual yearbook.

reports.title: Irkutsk Oblast Statistical Yearbook (Статистический ежегодник. Иркутская область)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Irkutsk Oblast (Irkutskstat)
reports.description: Full annual statistical yearbook for Irkutsk Oblast (Siberian Federal District). Covers population, labour, living standards, industry (including resource and energy profile), construction, trade and social indicators. Provides additional Siberian industrial coverage alongside Krasnoyarsk and Novosibirsk.

reports.title: Irkutsk Oblast in Figures (Иркутская область в цифрах)
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Irkutsk Oblast (Irkutskstat)
reports.description: Concise annual statistical handbook for Irkutsk Oblast. Complements the full Statistical Yearbook.

reports.title: Socio-economic Situation of Irkutsk Oblast — Periodic Report
reports.publisher: Territorial Body of the Federal State Statistics Service for Irkutsk Oblast (Irkutskstat)
reports.description: Recurring operational report on the socio-economic situation of Irkutsk Oblast. High-frequency layer feeding the annual yearbook series.

reports.title: Industrial Production in Russia (Промышленное производство в России)
reports.description: Official statistical collection characterising mining, manufacturing, electricity, gas and water supply. Covers production volumes, indices, financial results, employment and other indicators by type of economic activity. From 2014 published electronically; subject-level data for all federal subjects are issued as a separate electronic appendix. Continues the earlier series «Industry of Russia». Principal national sectoral source for industrial statistics with full regional breakdown.

reports.title: Industrial Production in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Electronic appendix to the collection «Industrial Production in Russia» containing detailed indicators in the breakdown of federal subjects. Enables direct comparison of industrial structure and performance across the subjects already covered in the regional layer (Sverdlovsk, Chelyabinsk, Krasnoyarsk, Tatarstan, etc.).

reports.title: Main Indicators of Agriculture in Russia (Основные показатели сельского хозяйства в России)
reports.description: Statistical bulletin presenting the principal indicators of Russian agriculture: sown areas, livestock, crop and livestock production, structure of output by category of farm, financial results, prices, investment and capacities. Selected indicators are given by federal district and by subject of the Federation. Core national agricultural statistical product with regional dimension.

reports.title: Agriculture in Russia (Сельское хозяйство в России) — Statistical Collection
reports.description: Fuller statistical collection on agriculture in the Russian Federation, covering production, structure by farm type, resources, financial performance and related indicators. Complements the more frequent main-indicators bulletin and supplies the national agricultural frame used by subject-level agricultural tables in regional yearbooks (especially relevant for Krasnodar, Rostov, Bashkortostan, etc.).

reports.title: Construction in Russia (Строительство в России)
reports.description: Official statistical collection on the construction complex: volume of work under the activity «Construction», financial indicators of construction organisations, employment and wages, investment in fixed capital, commissioning of fixed assets, residential and social-facility construction, business activity surveys. Subject-level information is published as a separate electronic appendix. Primary national source for construction and housing statistics with full regional coverage.

reports.title: Construction in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Electronic appendix to «Construction in Russia» containing detailed construction, investment and housing indicators broken down by federal subject. Directly links national construction statistics to the subject yearbooks already in the graph.

reports.title: Transport in Russia (Транспорт в России)
reports.description: Statistical collection on the state of transport in the Russian Federation: railway, road, water, air, pipeline and other modes; length of networks; rolling stock; freight and passenger traffic; financial and labour indicators; accidents. Subject-level data are issued as a separate electronic appendix. National sectoral transport frame used by regional transport tables.

reports.title: Transport in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Electronic appendix to «Transport in Russia» providing transport indicators by federal subject. Supports cross-subject comparison of transport infrastructure and activity.

reports.title: Main Indicators of Environmental Protection (Основные показатели охраны окружающей среды)
reports.description: Statistical bulletin presenting the principal indicators of the impact of economic activity on the natural environment in the Russian Federation: atmospheric emissions (stationary and mobile), water abstraction and losses, waste generation and treatment, and related measures. Multi-year series; forms the core environmental statistical product of Rosstat.

reports.title: Environmental Protection in Russia (Охрана окружающей среды в России)
reports.description: Full statistical collection on the state of the environment and the use and protection of natural resources. Covers atmospheric air, water, land, forest and hunting resources, waste management, specially protected natural areas, and expenditure on environmental protection. Published biennially in electronic form. National environmental frame that underpins regional environmental tables in subject yearbooks.

reports.title: Commissioning of Residential Buildings and Housing Statistics (series)
reports.description: Recurring official statistical series and analytical notes on the commissioning of residential buildings (by region, by form of ownership, by material of walls, storey height, etc.), average construction cost per square metre, and related housing indicators. Closely linked to the Construction in Russia collection and to subject-level housing tables.

reports.title: Healthcare in Russia (Здравоохранение в России)
reports.description: Principal official statistical collection on the state of healthcare in the Russian Federation. Covers med-demographic indicators of population health, organisation and accessibility of medical and spa-resort care, labour market and staffing in healthcare, production of medical goods, and related indicators. Prepared from federal statistical observation of legal entities and the population, sample surveys, and data from the Ministry of Health and other agencies. Published annually in electronic form (series since 2001). Subject-level data for 2015 onward are issued as a separate electronic appendix, enabling systematic inter-regional comparison.

reports.title: Healthcare in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
reports.description: Electronic appendix to «Healthcare in Russia» containing detailed healthcare, morbidity, staffing and medical-organisation indicators broken down by federal subject for multi-year periods (e.g. 2015–2024). Primary vehicle for regional health statistics under the national methodological framework.

reports.title: Medical Organisations, Hospital Beds and Medical Staff — Official Series
reports.description: Recurring official statistical series on the number of medical organisations (hospital and outpatient), hospital beds by specialisation, and medical personnel (physicians of all specialties, mid-level staff).
